instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned.
Add the onion, garlic, carrots, and potatoes, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the diced tomatoes, beef broth, paprika, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper.
Simmer the goulash for 30 minutes.

title: Pierogi Ruskie
instructions: Boil the grated potatoes in salted water until they float to the surface.
Drain the potatoes and mash them with the flour, eggs, sour cream, milk, salt, black pepper.
Shape the dough into small dumplings.
Fry the dumplings in butter until they are golden brown.
Serve with farmer's cheese.

title: Zemiakové placky
instructions: Combine the rye flour, all-purpose flour, caraway seeds, salt, and sugar in a bowl.
Add the warm water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Cut the dough into small squares and fry in oil until golden brown.

title: Kapustové pierogy
instructions: Combine the shredded cabbage and salt in a bowl.
Squeeze out the excess liquid from the cabbage.
Mash the cabbage with the flour, eggs, sour cream, milk, and black pepper.
Shape the dough into small dumplings.
Fry the dumplings in butter until they are golden brown.

title: Sarmale (Stuffed Cabbage Rolls)
ingredients: 1 large head of cabbage, blanched and leaves removed
1 pound ground pork, mixed with 1/2 pound ground beef
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and blanch the cabbage head for 5 minutes.
Remove the cabbage leaves and set aside.
Mix the ground meat with onion, rice, paprika, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper.
Place a tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of each cabbage leaf and roll up.
Place the rolls seam-side down in a large pot and add the vegetable oil.
Cover the pot and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Mămăligă (Polenta)
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot.
Gradually add the cornmeal, whisking continuously.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the salt and vegetable oil, and stir well.

title: Cârnații (Romanian Meatballs)
instructions: Mix the ground pork with onion, egg, breadcrumbs, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Form into small balls and place on a baking sheet.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 15-20 minutes.
Serve hot with a side of polenta or mashed potatoes.

title: Borș (Sour Beef Soup)
ingredients: 2 pounds beef shank, cut into large pieces
instructions: Brown the beef pieces in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onions, garlic, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the beef broth, paprika, salt, and pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 hours.
Stir in the sour cream and serve hot.

title: Papanasi (Cheese Doughnuts)
instructions: Mix the flour, milk, and salt in a bowl.
Add the vegetable oil, egg, and farmer's cheese, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes and let it rise for 1 hour.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan and fry the doughnuts until golden brown.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve hot.

title: Zurek (Sour Rye Soup)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onions and garlic, cook until softened.
Add pork and sausage, cook until browned.
Add rye flour, cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add water, whisking continuously.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat.
Add vinegar, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh dill if desired.

title: Pierogi Ruskie (Potato and Cheese Dumplings)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine flour and warm water in a bowl.
Knead dough until smooth.
Divide dough into small balls.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of mashed potatoes and cheese in the center.
Fold dough over filling, press edges to seal.
Boil dumplings in salted water until floating.
Serve with melted butter and sour cream if desired.

title: Bigos (Polish Hunter's Stew)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add pork and kielbasa, cook until browned.
Add onions and garlic, cook until softened.
Add sauerkraut, beef broth, and red wine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat.
Simmer for 10 minutes.
Add caraway seeds, salt, and pepper.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.

title: Placki ziemniaczane (Polish Potato Pancakes)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine potatoes, onion, eggs, and flour in a bowl.
Mix well, but do not overmix.
Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop potato mixture into oil.
Cook until golden brown, about 4-5 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels, serve hot.

title: Gołąbki (Stuffed Cabbage Rolls)
ingredients: 1 head cabbage, blanched and leaves removed
instructions: Combine ground pork, beef, onion, rice, egg, salt, pepper, and paprika in a bowl.
Mix well, but do not overmix.
Place a tablespoon of the meat mixture onto the center of each cabbage leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Place rolls seam-side down in a large pot.
Add enough water to cover rolls, bring to a boil, then reduce heat.
Simmer for 20 minutes, serve hot.

title: Borscht
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in a large pot until softened.
Add grated beets and carrots and cook for 5 minutes.
Add cabbage and cook until wilted.
Add diced tomatoes, beef broth, sugar, vinegar, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning.
Serve hot with a dollop of sour cream and garnish with fresh dill.

title: Chicken Kiev
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Flatten each chicken breast to 1/4 inch thickness.
Spread a tablespoon of butter on each breast, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle garlic, paprika, thyme, salt, and pepper over the butter.
Roll each breast into a log shape and secure with toothpicks.
Dredge the logs in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the logs in eggs, then coat in breadcrumbs.
Heat oil in a large skillet and fry the logs until golden brown.
Transfer the logs to a baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.

title: Holubtsi (Stuffed Cabbage Rolls)
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and blanch the cabbage head for 5 minutes.
Remove the cabbage leaves from the head and set aside.
Combine pork, beef, onion, garlic, rice, egg, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Place a tablespoon of the meat mixture onto the center of each cabbage leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package.
Place the rolls seam-side down in a large pot or Dutch oven.
Add the tomato paste and diced tomatoes to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and simmer for 30-40 minutes, or until the cabbage is tender.

title: Pampushky (Ukrainian Doughnuts)
instructions: Combine flour, sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
Add the softened butter and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the milk and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and use a doughnut pan or a glass to shape into a ring.
Fry the doughnuts in hot oil until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Varenyky (Ukrainian Dumplings)
ingredients: Filling of your choice (e.g. cherry, blueberry, or apple)
instructions: Combine flour, warm water, and salt in a large bowl.
Mix until a dough forms, then knead for 5-7 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and use a rolling pin to flatten into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Fry the dumplings in hot oil until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve with melted butter and sugar.

title: Blini with Sour Cream and Caviar
instructions: Combine flour, salt, and sugar in a large bowl.
Add oil and mix until crumbly.
Gradually add warm water to form a smooth dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes.
Rest the dough for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Cook the blini in a hot skillet for 1-2 minutes on each side.
Serve the blini with sour cream, dill, and caviar.

title: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook the egg noodles according to package instructions.
Season the beef with salt and pepper.
Cook the beef in a hot skillet until browned.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add mushrooms and cook until tender.
Add beef broth, tomato paste, mustard, and paprika to the skillet.
Simmer the sauce for 5 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the beef and sauce over cooked egg noodles.
Garnish with parsley.

title: Pirozhki with Meat and Onions
instructions: Combine flour and salt in a large bowl.
Add oil and mix until crumbly.
Gradually add warm water to form a smooth dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes.
Rest the dough for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Mix the beef and onion in a bowl.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto one half of the dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with beaten egg.

title: Pelmeni with Mushroom Sauce
instructions: Combine flour and salt in a large bowl.
Add oil and mix until crumbly.
Gradually add warm water to form a smooth dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes.
Rest the dough for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Mix the beef and onion in a bowl.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto one half of the dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges to seal.
Cook the pelmeni in a hot skillet for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Melt butter in a saucepan and add mushrooms.
Cook until the mushrooms are tender.
Add beef broth to the saucepan and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve the pelmeni with mushroom sauce.

title: Kulich with Honey and Raisins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Combine flour and salt in a large bowl.
Add sugar and mix until crumbly.
Gradually add warm milk to form a smooth dough.
Beat in eggs until well combined.
Add honey and mix until smooth.
Stir in raisins.
Pour the dough into a greased and floured bundt pan.
Bake for 45-50 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool for 10 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

title: Drunk Chicken (Kurka na Medu)
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, 2-3 lbs, cut into 8 pieces
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Dredge the chicken in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured chicken in eggs and then in milk, making sure they're fully coated.
Dip the milk-coated chicken in flour again and shake off excess.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the chicken until golden brown, about 5-7 minutes per side.
Remove the chicken from the oil and set aside.
In the same oil, sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the wine, broth, thyme, and rosemary to the skillet.
Return the fried chicken to the skillet and simmer in the sauce until cooked through.

title: Potato and Mushroom Pierogi (Pirozhki)
instructions: Combine flour, warm water, and vegetable oil to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into small pieces and roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a spoonful of potato mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Boil the pierogi in a large pot of salted water until they float to the surface.
Serve with melted butter and chopped fresh dill.

title: Braised Red Cabbage with Apples (Krupnyi Kapustnik)
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sauté the onion until softened.
Add the cabbage, apples, caraway seeds, sugar, and vinegar to the skillet.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer the mixture, stirring occasionally, until the cabbage is tender and the apples are caramelized.

title: Braised Buckwheat Groats (Kasha)
instructions: Rinse the buckwheat groats and soak them in water for at least 4 hours.
Drain and rinse the buckwheat groats.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture.
Add the buckwheat groats to the skillet and stir to combine with the mushroom mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer the kasha, stirring occasionally, until the liquid is absorbed and the groats are tender.

title: Rye Bread with Caraway Seeds (Ryezanka)
instructions: Combine the rye flour, all-purpose flour, salt, sugar, and yeast in a large bowl.
Gradually add the warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10-12 minutes until smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place until doubled in size.
Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Punch down the dough and shape it into a round loaf.
Brush the loaf with beaten egg and sprinkle with caraway seeds.
Bake the bread for 35-40 minutes until golden brown.

title: Goulash
ingredients: 2 pounds beef, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add broth, wine, paprika, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
Add potatoes and cook until tender, about 20 minutes.

title: Paprikás Csirke
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and cook until heated through.
Garnish with parsley.

title: Rétes (Hungarian Strudel)
instructions: Combine flour and salt in a bowl. Add lard or shortening and mix until crumbly.
Gradually add warm water and mix until dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes. Divide into 2 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece of dough to a thin sheet.
Mix spinach, dill, and feta cheese in a bowl.
Spread mixture evenly over dough, leaving a 1-inch border.
Roll up dough tightly and cut into 1-inch thick slices.

title: Halászlé (Hungarian Fisherman's Soup)
ingredients: 2 pounds carp or catfish, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and hot pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add fish and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add broth, water, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Dobos Torte
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Combine flour and sugar in a bowl. Add butter and mix until crumbly.
Beat in eggs and vanilla extract.
Pour batter into a greased and floured pan.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler. Stir in heavy cream.
Drizzle chocolate mixture over cake.

title: Braised Pork Knuckle with Sauerkraut (Smažný Sámek s Kvašnou)
instructions: Heat lard in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Sear the pork knuckle until browned on all sides.
Remove the pork and set aside. Add the onion and garlic to the pot and sauté until softened.
Add the sauerkraut, pork broth, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the pork knuckle to the pot, cover, and transfer to the oven.
Braise for 2 1/2 hours or until the meat is tender and falls off the bone.
Remove from the oven and stir in the butter until melted.

title: Czech Stuffed Cabbage Rolls (Kapustníkove Rolády)
instructions: Remove the cabbage leaves from the head and blanch in boiling water until softened.
In a large bowl, combine the ground pork, ground beef, onion, rice, egg, salt, pepper, and paprika.
To assemble the rolls, lay a cabbage leaf flat and place a tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the leaf to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat with the remaining leaves and filling.
In a large pot, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the cabbage rolls seam-side down and cook until browned.
Add enough water to the pot to cover the rolls and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the cabbage is tender.

title: Czech-Style Meat and Vegetable Soup (Polévkova Polévka)
ingredients: 1 pound beef, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 pound pork, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and sauté until softened.
Add the beef and pork to the pot and cook until browned.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, water, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours or until the meat is tender.

title: Czech Apple Strudel (Ovocná Trdelník)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, lard or shortening, and sugar until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a small bowl, mix together the eggs, vanilla extract, and cinnamon.
Brush the edges of the dough with the egg mixture, then sprinkle with sugar.
Arrange the apples, raisins, and walnuts down the center of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a long, thin roll.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Czech-Style Fried Cheese (Smažný Sýr)
ingredients: 1 pound cheese, cut into 1-inch cubes (such as Edam or Gouda)
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, breadcrumbs, and Parmesan cheese.
In a separate dish, beat the egg and mix with the milk.
Dip each cheese cube into the egg mixture, then coat in the flour mixture.
Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Fry the cheese cubes until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

title: Bryndzové Halušky
instructions: Boil potatoes and grate them.
Mix grated potatoes with flour, egg, salt, and pepper.
Shape potato mixture into small dumplings.
Boil halušky in salted water until they float.
Drain halušky and top with bryndza cheese and chopped herbs.

title: Guláš
ingredients: 2 pounds beef, cut into small pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Brown beef pieces until browned, then remove from pot.
Soften onion and garlic in pot, then add tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes, beef broth, red wine, caraway seeds, paprika, salt, and pepper to pot.
Return browned beef to pot and bring to a boil.
Simmer guláš for 1 1/2 hours or until beef is tender.

title: Paprikás Csirke
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken, cut into small pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Brown chicken pieces until browned, then remove from pot.
Soften onion and garlic in pot, then add paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Return browned chicken to pot and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and cook until sauce thickens.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Kulen
instructions: Mix ground pork with milk, egg, flour, salt, and pepper.
Knead mixture until smooth.
Shape mixture into small logs.
Fry kulen in hot oil until browned.
Drain kulen on paper towels.

title: Šiška
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Soften onion in pot, then add caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute.
Add shredded cabbage to pot and cook until wilted.
Add sliced sausage and ground pork to pot, then cook until browned.
Add beef broth and bring to a boil.
Simmer šiška for 30 minutes or until cabbage is tender.

title: Sarmale (Stuffed Cabbage Rolls)
ingredients: 1 head of cabbage, blanched and removed from the leaves
1 pound ground pork, mixed with 1/2 pound ground beef and 1 onion, finely chopped
instructions: In a bowl, mix the ground meat with rice, egg, salt, pepper, and paprika.
Remove the thick stem from the cabbage leaves and cut them into large pieces.
Place a tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of each leaf and roll up the leaf to form a neat package.
Place the rolled cabbage in a large pot, seam side down, and add enough water to cover them.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Mămăligă (Polenta)
instructions: Bring the water to a boil in a large pot.
Gradually add the cornmeal, whisking constantly to prevent lumps.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the butter and salt, and stir until melted.
If using cheese, stir it in until melted and well combined.

title: Cârnații (Romanian Meatballs)
instructions: In a bowl, mix the ground meat with onion, garlic, egg, breadcrumbs, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small balls.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the meatballs.
Cook for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until browned and cooked through.

title: Tocană (Romanian Beef Stew)
ingredients: 2 pounds beef, cut into large pieces
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat and brown the beef.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until softened.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, red wine, paprika, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Papanasi (Romanian Doughnuts with Cheese Filling)
ingredients: 1/2 cup cheese, crumbled (such as feta or ricotta)
instructions: In a bowl, mix the flour, warm milk, and salt to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes, then cover and let rise for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and roll it out to a thickness of 1/4 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter.
Fry the doughnuts in hot oil until golden brown, then drain on paper towels.

title: Bigos
instructions: Brown the sausage and bacon in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the onions, carrots, and potatoes, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the beef broth, sauerkraut, and caraway seeds, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot.

title: Pierogi Ruskie
ingredients: Filling ingredients: 2 cups farmer's cheese, 1/2 cup potatoes, mashed
instructions: Combine the flour, warm water, and egg in a bowl, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 2 equal pieces, and roll out each piece into a thin sheet.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each dough circle, and fold the dough over to form a half-moon shape.
Press the edges together to seal the pierogi, and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with melted butter, and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Zurek
instructions: Combine the rye flour, sourdough starter, and warm water in a bowl, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a warm place, and let it rise for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Punch down the dough, and shape into a round loaf.
Place the loaf on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and brush with melted butter.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 30-40 minutes, or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, combine the pork broth and chopped ham in a pot, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the liquid has thickened slightly.
Serve the zurek hot, garnished with chopped fresh dill.

title: Gołąbki
instructions: Combine the ground pork, ground beef, cooked rice, parsley, salt, and pepper in a bowl, and mix until just combined.
Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the cabbage leaves, and cook until softened and pliable.
Spoon a tablespoon of the meat mixture onto the center of each cabbage leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, and then fold in the sides and roll up the leaf to form a tight package.
Place the gołąbki seam-side down in the skillet, and cook until browned on both sides and cooked through.

title: Kielbasa i Kapusta
instructions: Brown the sausage in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the onions and potatoes, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the sauerkraut and caraway seeds, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot.

title: Borscht
instructions: Cook beets, carrots, and onions in a large pot until tender.
Add garlic, tomatoes, broth, sugar, salt, and pepper.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in sour cream.
Garnish with dill.

title: Chicken Varenyky
instructions: Mix flour and water to form dough.
Knead for 5 minutes.
Divide dough into small pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a spoonful of chicken, onion, garlic, and potatoes in the center.
Fold dough in half to form a half-moon shape.
Seal edges with a fork.
Fry in oil until golden brown.
Serve with sour cream and parsley.

title: Holubtsi
instructions: Mix cabbage, pork, onion, garlic, and rice.
Form into small patties.
Heat oil in a large skillet.
Add patties and cook until browned on both sides.
Serve with tomato sauce and parsley.

title: Kulich
instructions: Mix flour and yeast in a large bowl.
Add warm water, sugar, milk, eggs, melted butter, salt, cardamom, and vanilla.
Knead for 10 minutes.
Place in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap.
Let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 375°F.
Bake for 35-40 minutes.
Let cool on a wire rack.

title: Syrnyk
instructions: Mix sour cream and sugar in a large bowl.
Add flour, baking powder, and salt.
Beat in eggs and vanilla extract.
Fold in berries and walnuts.
Pour into a greased and floured 9-inch round cake pan.
Bake at 350°F for 35-40 minutes.
Let cool on a wire rack.

title: Borscht
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened, 5 minutes.
Add beets, carrots, and potatoes, cook for 10 minutes.
Add broth, water, tomato paste, sugar, salt, and pepper, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in sour cream and dill, serve hot.

title: Pelmeni
instructions: Combine beef, onion, and garlic in a bowl, mix well.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, egg, milk, water, salt, pepper, and nutmeg, mix until a dough forms.
Knead dough for 10 minutes, until smooth.
Roll out dough thinly, cut into circles.
Place a tablespoon of beef mixture in the center of each circle, fold and press edges to seal.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil, cook pelmeni for 5-7 minutes, serve with butter.

title: Shashlik
ingredients: 1 pound lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Combine lamb or beef, garlic, oil, lemon juice, parsley, dill, paprika, salt, and pepper in a bowl, mix well.
Thread lamb or beef onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Cook shashlik for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.

title: Holodets
instructions: Combine pork, beef, carrots, celery, onion, and garlic in a large pot.
Add broth, water, tomato paste, sugar, salt, and pepper, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours, or until meat is tender.
Strain broth through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean pot, discard solids.

title: Pirozhki
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Combine beef, onion, and garlic in a bowl, mix well.
Add peas and carrots, cabbage, and cheese, mix well.
Roll out puff pastry thinly, cut into circles.
Place a tablespoon of beef mixture in the center of each circle, brush edges with egg.
Fold pastry over filling, press edges to seal, and bake for 20-25 minutes.

title: Zurek (Sour Rye Soup)
ingredients: 1 pound pork or beef, finely chopped
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Soak rye flour in water overnight.
Grind soaked rye mixture into a fine paste.
Mix in all-purpose flour, sour cream, and caraway seeds.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté onion and garlic.
Add ground meat and cook until browned.
Add rye mixture and bring to a boil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Kibinai (Meat Pies)
instructions: Mix flour and salt in a bowl.
Add oil and warm water to make a dough.
Knead dough for 10 minutes.
Divide dough into small balls.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of meat mixture in the center.
Fold dough in half and press edges together.
Brush tops with egg and melted butter.

title: Babka (Poppy Seed Cake)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix flour and baking powder in a bowl.
Add sugar, oil, eggs, poppy seeds, vanilla extract, and milk.
Pour batter into a greased and floured loaf pan.
Bake for 45-50 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Pierogi (Dumplings)
instructions: Mix flour and warm water to make a dough.
Knead dough for 10 minutes.
Divide dough into small balls.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of filling in the center.
Fold dough in half and press edges together.
Boil in water for 5-7 minutes or until they float.

title: Kasha (Buckwheat Porridge)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Rinse buckwheat groats and soak in water for 4 hours.
Drain and rinse buckwheat again.
Heat oil in a large pot and sauté onion and garlic.
Add buckwheat and cook for 5 minutes.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until buckwheat is tender.

title: Goulash
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Brown beef in batches, then set aside.
Add more oil if needed, then sauté onions, garlic, carrots, and celery until tender.
Add paprika, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper; cook for 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes and beef broth, then return the browned beef to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 hours.

title: Paprikás csirke
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Brown chicken pieces in batches, then set aside.
Add more oil if needed, then sauté onions and garlic until tender.
Add paprika, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper; cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken broth, then return the browned chicken to the pot.
Simmer for 20 minutes, then stir in heavy cream and butter.
Serve with boiled noodles or dumplings.

title: Halászlé (Fisherman's Soup)
ingredients: 1 pound whitefish (such as pike or carp), cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Brown fish in batches, then set aside.
Add more oil if needed, then sauté onions, garlic, bell peppers, and tomatoes until tender.
Add diced tomatoes, fish broth, paprika, salt, and pepper; cook for 10 minutes.
Return the browned fish to the pot, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve hot, with a dollop of sour cream if desired.

title: Lángos (Hungarian Fried Dough)
instructions: Combine flour and salt in a bowl.
Gradually add warm water, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes, then let rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 4-6 pieces, depending on desired size.
Roll each piece into a ball, then flatten slightly into a disk.
Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Fry the dough disks for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve hot with sour cream and cheese, if desired.

title: Rétes (Hungarian Strudel)
instructions: Combine flour and salt in a bowl.
Gradually add warm water, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes, then let rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 4-6 pieces, depending on desired size.
Roll each piece into a ball, then flatten slightly into a disk.
Place a spoonful of sour cream, cheese, and ham or bacon onto the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling, then seal the edges with a fork.
Brush the tops with beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 20-25 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Beef Goulash
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onions and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add bell peppers and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, paprika, caraway seeds, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.

title: Svíčková (Beef in Cream Sauce)
ingredients: 1 pound beef in cream sauce-cut to 1/4 inch thick slices
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Gradually add cream, whisking until smooth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add beef broth, wine, tomato paste, sugar, paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Simmer for 10 minutes, or until sauce thickens.
Dredge beef in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip in beaten eggs, then coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil until golden brown.
Serve with sauce and garnish with parsley.

title: Kulajda (Mashed Potato Soup)
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender, about 15 minutes.
Mash with butter and milk until smooth.
Stir in heavy cream, dill, salt, and pepper.
Serve hot, topped with diced eggs and chives.

title: Karlovarský Šunkový Koláč (Ham and Cheese Pie)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Roll out puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a bowl, mix together butter, sugar, eggs, parsley, cheese, ham, salt, and pepper.
Spread mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border.
Fold the other half over and press edges to seal.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Ovocné Knedlíky (Fruit Dumplings)
ingredients: Fruit of your choice (such as strawberries, blueberries, or cherries)
instructions: In a bowl, mix together flour, milk, oil, and egg until a dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes, until smooth.
Divide dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly.
Place a spoonful of fruit in the center of each dough circle.
Fold dough over fruit and press edges to seal.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F.
Fry dumplings until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and dust with cinnamon sugar.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 pound chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, for 1 minute.
Add the artichoke hearts, peas and carrots, chicken broth, water, saffron, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Stir to combine, then bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the potatoes and onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are golden brown, about 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs and mix in the Manchego cheese, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked potatoes and onions to the bowl and mix to combine.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and add a small amount of oil.
Pour in the egg mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, until the edges start to set.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the tortilla towards the center.
Continue cooking and folding until the tortilla is almost set, then remove from heat and let rest for 2 minutes before serving.

title: Gazpacho
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, bell pepper, cucumber, onion, parsley, basil, and garlic in a blender.
Blend until smooth, then transfer to a large bowl.
Add the olive oil, red wine vinegar, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper to the bowl and mix to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional parsley and basil if desired.

title: Churros con Chocolate
instructions: Combine the flour, sugar, salt, and cinnamon in a bowl.
Add the milk, eggs, and melted butter to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F.
Pipe the dough through a star tip into the oil and fry, 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Drain the churros on paper towels and dust with powdered sugar.
Dip the churros in melted chocolate and serve immediately.

title: Empanada Gallega
instructions: Combine the flour and lard in a bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Gradually add the water and mix until the dough is smooth and elastic.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of cheese, a sprinkle of parsley, and a sprinkle of chorizo in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges to seal.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook the empanadas, 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 pound chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 pound rabbit or pork, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
2 cups mixed vegetables (artichoke hearts, red bell pepper, carrots)
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo and cook until browned, about 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and rabbit or pork and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the rice and stir to coat with oil and mix with the meat and vegetables.
Add the chicken broth, saffron, and smoked paprika, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and garnish with parsley.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and cook until they are tender, about 10-12 minutes.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Add the cooked potatoes and onion to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the grated cheese (if using) and stir to combine.
Heat a non-stick skillet or cast-iron pan over medium heat.
Add a small amount of oil to the pan and pour in the egg mixture.
Cook until the edges start to set, about 2-3 minutes.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the tortilla towards the center.
Continue cooking and folding the tortilla for an additional 5-7 minutes, until the eggs are set and the tortilla is golden brown.
Serve warm, garnished with chopped parsley (if desired).

title: Gazpacho
ingredients: 1/2 cup bread, torn into small pieces
instructions: Combine the diced tomatoes, bell pepper, cucumber, and red onion in a blender or food processor.
Add the chopped cilantro, garlic, and bread to the blender and blend until smooth.
With the blender running, slowly pour in the olive oil and sherry vinegar.
Add the smoked paprika and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional cilantro (if desired).

title: Pollo al Ajillo (Garlic Chicken)
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the chicken breasts and cook until browned on both sides, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the white wine, chicken broth, and smoked paprika to the skillet.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the chicken is cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and garnish with chopped parsley (if desired).

title: Crema Catalana
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a medium saucepan, combine the sugar, heavy cream, and vanilla extract.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and a pinch of salt.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm cream mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Return the mixture to the saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and coats the back of a spoon, about 10-12 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the cinnamon and nutmeg.
Pour the mixture into small ramekins or custard cups.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, drizzle with caramel sauce (if using).

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo and cook until browned, about 2 minutes.
Add the rabbit and chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, onion, and bell pepper and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, broth, water, saffron, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes.
Stir in the rice and continue to simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the potatoes and onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender and golden brown, about 10-12 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk the eggs and season with salt and black pepper.
Add the cooked potatoes and onions to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the garlic and cheese (if using) and stir to combine.
Heat a small amount of oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and cook until the edges start to set, about 2-3 minutes.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the tortilla towards the center.
Continue cooking and folding the tortilla for 5-7 minutes, or until it is set and golden brown.

title: Pollo al Ajillo
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken pieces (such as thighs and legs)
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the wine, broth, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley (if using).

title: Churros con Chocolate
ingredients: 1 cup dark chocolate or chocolate chips
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together the sugar, milk, eggs, and flour mixture.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F.
Using a piping bag, pipe the dough into long, thin strips.
Fry the churros until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the churros on paper towels.
Serve hot with the chocolate sauce (see below).
To make the chocolate sauce, melt the chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Whisk in the heavy cream until smooth.

title: Crema Catalana
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F.
In a medium saucepan, combine the sugar, cream, milk, and vanilla extract.
Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and cinnamon and nutmeg.
Gradually add the hot cream mixture to the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled and set.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 pound chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the rice and stir to coat with the oil and mix with the vegetables.
Add the chicken broth, water, saffron, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed, about 20-25 minutes.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they begin to brown, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and ham and cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender and golden, about 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Add the cooked potato mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Heat a small amount of oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggs are set, about 10-15 minutes.

title: Gazpacho
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, onion, and parsley in a blender or food processor.
Add the garlic, oil, vinegar, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Blend until smooth, then taste and adjust the seasoning.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Empanada Gallega
ingredients: Filling: 1 pound chorizo, sliced; 1 pound chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces; 1 onion, diced; 2 cloves garlic, minced
instructions: Combine the flour and salt in a large bowl.
Add the lard or shortening and, using a pastry blender or your fingers, work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the warm water, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Knead the dough on a floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 5-10 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a spoonful of the filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops with egg wash and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) until golden, about 20-25 minutes.

title: Pollo al Ajillo
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 1-2 minutes.
Add the wine, broth, and smoked paprika.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 15-20 minutes.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 2 pounds mixed chicken, rabbit, and pork, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 cup mixed vegetables (artichokes, carrots, and green beans)
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic; cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the chicken, rabbit, and pork; cook until browned.
Add the chorizo, shrimp, mixed vegetables, paprika, thyme, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Add the rice to the pan, stirring to coat with the oil and mix with the other ingredients.
Add the chicken broth and saffron; stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil; reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Remove the pan from the heat; let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic; cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the potatoes; cook until they are tender.
In a large bowl, whisk the eggs; season with salt and pepper.
Add the cooked onion, potatoes, parsley, and cheese to the bowl; stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet; cook over medium heat until the edges start to set.
Transfer the skillet to the oven; bake at 375°F for 15-20 minutes, or until the tortilla is set.
Remove the skillet from the oven; let it cool for a few minutes before serving.

title: Empanada Gallega
instructions: Combine the flour and salt in a large bowl.
Add the lard or shortening; use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the flour.
Gradually add the warm water; stir to combine.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface; knead until smooth.
Divide the dough into 4-6 pieces; roll each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon or two of the filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling; press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with the beaten egg.

title: Gazpacho Andaluz
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, onion, and garlic in a blender or food processor.
Blend the mixture until smooth.
Stir in the parsley, basil, oil, vinegar, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the broth to the blender or food processor; blend until well combined.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Chill the gazpacho in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.

title: Churros con Chocolate
instructions: Combine the flour, sugar, salt, and cinnamon in a large bowl.
Add the milk and eggs to the bowl; stir to combine.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F.
Pipe the dough through a star tip into the hot oil; fry until golden brown.
Drain the churros on paper towels; dust with powdered sugar.
Serve the churros with hot chocolate.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 pound chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 pound rabbit, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced chorizo and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and rabbit, cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika, saffron, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth and water, bring to a boil.
Add the Calasparra rice, stir to combine.
Cook, uncovered, over medium heat for 20-25 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced chorizo and morcilla, cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk the eggs and smoked paprika.
Add the cooked potato mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9-inch round cake pan.
Cook over low heat, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the eggs are set.
Remove from heat, let cool, then serve.

title: Gazpacho Andaluz
instructions: Combine the diced tomatoes, bell pepper, cucumber, red onion, and cilantro in a blender.
Add the minced garlic and blend until smooth.
With the blender running, slowly add the olive oil and vinegar.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Blend until combined.
Add the water and blend until smooth.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Serve cold, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.

title: Pollo al Ajillo
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped parsley and oregano, cook for 1 minute.
Add the lemon juice, white wine, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Simmer, uncovered, over medium heat for 10-15 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.

title: Crema Catalana
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
In a medium saucepan, combine the heavy cream, granulated sugar, and salt. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved.
In a small bowl, whisk the egg yolks and vanilla extract. Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm cream mixture into the bowl, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Drizzle with caramel sauce before serving.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook until golden brown.
In a large bowl, whisk the eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Add the cooked potatoes and onion mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture back into the frying pan and cook until the eggs are set.
Use a spatula to gently loosen the tortilla from the pan and serve hot.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 pound chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the sliced chorizo and cook until browned.
Add the chicken and cook until browned.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink.
Add the rice and stir to combine with the vegetables and meat.
Add the chicken broth, water, smoked paprika, and saffron.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Gazpacho Andaluz
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine the diced tomatoes, red bell pepper, cucumber, and red onion in a blender or food processor.
Add the chopped parsley, basil, and garlic to the blender.
Blend until smooth.
With the blender running, slowly add the red wine vinegar and olive oil.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and black pepper.
Chill in the refrigerator before serving.

title: Empanada Gallega
instructions: Combine the flour and salt in a bowl.
Add the lard or shortening and use a pastry blender to work into the flour until crumbly.
Gradually add the warm water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-10 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the ground beef mixture in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press edges to seal.
Brush the tops with the beaten egg and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Crema Catalana
instructions: Combine the heavy cream, granulated sugar, egg yolks, vanilla extract, and salt in a saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 25-30 minutes, or until set.
Let cool to room temperature, then refrigerate until chilled.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of granulated sugar over the top of each ramekin and caramelize with a kitchen torch.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chorizo and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and bell pepper and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, broth, paprika, and saffron mixture. Stir to combine.
Add the rice and stir to coat with the sauce.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook, uncovered, for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the shrimp are pink.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the potatoes and onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender, about 10-12 minutes.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Add the cooked potatoes and onions to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the cheese and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggs are set, about 10-12 minutes.
Use a spatula to carefully loosen the edges of the tortilla and flip it over in the skillet.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the other side is lightly browned.

title: Gazpacho
instructions: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, onion, parsley, and mint in a blender or food processor.
Blend until coarsely chopped.
Heat the oil in a large bowl over medium heat.
Add the garlic and paprika and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the vinegar, salt, and pepper and stir to combine.
Add the vegetable broth and stir to combine.
Add the blended vegetable mixture and stir to combine.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.

title: Croquetas de Pollo
instructions: In a bowl, combine the chicken, flour, cheese, and parsley.
Beat the eggs and milk in a separate bowl.
Add the egg mixture to the chicken mixture and stir to combine.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the croquetas until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Drain the croquetas on paper towels and serve hot.

title: Churros con Chocolate
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir to combine.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Using a piping bag, pipe the dough into long, thin strips, about 4-5 inches long.
Fry the churros until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Drain the churros on paper towels and dust with powdered sugar.
Melt the chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Serve the churros with the melted chocolate for dipping.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook until they are tender, about 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked onion and potatoes to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook over medium heat until the edges start to set.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the tortilla towards the center.
Cook for another 2-3 minutes, until the tortilla is almost set.
Use the spatula to carefully slide the tortilla onto a large plate and serve.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 pound chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced chorizo and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the rice, chicken broth, water, smoked paprika, and saffron to the pan.
Stir to combine, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Gazpacho
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the diced tomatoes, bell pepper, cucumber, red onion, cilantro, and garlic.
Blend until smooth, then season with salt and black pepper to taste.
With the blender or food processor running, slowly add the sherry vinegar and olive oil.
Continue blending until well combined.
With the blender or food processor running, slowly add the water.
Continue blending until the gazpacho is smooth and well combined.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve chilled, garnished with a few ice cubes and a sprinkle of cilantro, if desired.

title: Croquetas de Pollo
instructions: In a bowl, combine the shredded chicken, flour, chopped onion, parsley, and Manchego cheese.
Mix well to combine.
Add the beaten egg and milk to the bowl and mix until the mixture is well combined.
Shape the mixture into small oval shapes, about 1 1/2 inches long and 1 inch wide.
Coat each shape in breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the croquetas until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Drain the croquetas on paper towels and serve hot.

title: Crema Catalana
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a medium saucepan, combine the granulated sugar, heavy cream, whole milk, and salt.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and vanilla extract.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm cream mixture into the bowl, whisking constantly.
Return the mixture to the saucepan and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and coats the back of a spoon.
Remove from heat and stir in the ground cinnamon and nutmeg.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, drizzle with caramel sauce and serve chilled.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 pound chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 pound rabbit, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and rabbit, cook until browned, 5 minutes.
Add chorizo and cook until browned, 2 minutes.
Add onion and garlic, cook until onion is translucent, 5 minutes.
Add rice and cook, stirring constantly, 2 minutes.
Add chicken broth, water, saffron, and smoked paprika.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer, 20 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook, uncovered, until pink, 5 minutes.
Let rest, 5 minutes, before serving.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add potatoes and onion, cook until potatoes are tender, 10 minutes.
Add garlic, chorizo, and morcilla, cook until chorizo is browned, 2 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Add cooked potato mixture to eggs and stir to combine.
Pour mixture into a greased skillet and cook until edges are set, 5 minutes.
Sprinkle Manchego cheese over top and cook until melted, 2 minutes.
Let rest, 5 minutes, before slicing and serving.

title: Pollo al Ajillo
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, 5 minutes.
Remove chicken and set aside.
Add garlic to skillet and cook until fragrant, 1 minute.
Add white wine and chicken broth, bring to a boil.
Return chicken to skillet and cook until cooked through, 10 minutes.
Stir in parsley, oregano, and smoked paprika.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, before serving.

title: Churros con Chocolate
ingredients: 1 cup dark chocolate, broken into pieces
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, salt, and cinnamon.
In a large bowl, whisk together milk and eggs.
Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and stir to combine.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F.
Pipe dough into long strips and fry until golden, 2-3 minutes.
Drain churros on paper towels and dust with powdered sugar.
Melt chocolate in a double boiler and serve with churros.

title: Empanada Gallega
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour and salt.
Add lard or shortening and, using a pastry blender or fingers, work into flour until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add warm water and stir until dough comes together.
Knead dough on a floured surface until smooth, 5 minutes.
Divide dough into 2 equal pieces and roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place ham and cheese in center of each circle and fold dough over filling, pressing edges to seal.
Brush tops with beaten egg for glaze and bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes, or until golden.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 pound chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the rice and cook, stirring occasionally, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, water, smoked paprika, and saffron, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Add the shrimp and cook, uncovered, for 2-3 minutes, or until pink and cooked through.
Season the paella with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are golden brown, about 10-12 minutes.
Remove the potatoes from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are softened and golden brown, about 10-12 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the cooked potatoes, onions, and garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the grated cheese, if using, and stir to combine.
Heat a small amount of oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggs are set, about 5-7 minutes.

title: Gazpacho
instructions: Combine the diced tomatoes, red bell pepper, cucumber, red onion, parsley, cilantro, and garlic in a blender or food processor.
Blend the mixture until smooth.
With the blender or food processor running, slowly pour in the olive oil and continue blending until the mixture is smooth and creamy.
Add the red wine vinegar, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper, and blend until well combined.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover and refrigerate the gazpacho for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the gazpacho chilled, garnished with additional parsley or cilantro, if desired.

title: Pollo al Ajillo
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breasts and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on both sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a baking dish and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the parsley, oregano, lemon juice, and smoked paprika to the skillet and stir to combine.
Pour the garlic mixture over the chicken breasts and bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with additional parsley or oregano, if desired.

title: Crema Catalana
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine the sugar, heavy cream, whole milk, egg yolks, vanilla extract, and cinnamon in a medium saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Strain the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake the crema catalana in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until set and lightly golden brown on top.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let them cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate the crema catalana for at least 2 hours, or until chilled and set.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 pound chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 pound rabbit meat, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and rabbit and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, water, saffron, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Tortilla de Patatas

instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the potatoes and onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender, about 15-20 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk. Season with salt and pepper.
Add the cooked potatoes and onions to the bowl and stir to combine.
Heat a small amount of oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, until the eggs are almost set.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 375°F for 10-15 minutes, or until the eggs are fully set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Empanada Gallega
instructions: To make the dough, combine the flour and salt in a large bowl.
Add the lard or shortening and, using a pastry blender or your fingers, work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the warm water and stir until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 5-10 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon or two of the filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat and fry the empanadas until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.

title: Pollo al Ajillo
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook, turning occasionally, until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the paprika and saffron and cook for 1 minute.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley or lemon wedges.

title: Crema Catalana
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F.
In a medium saucepan, combine the sugar, cream, and vanilla extract.
Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened slightly.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and cinnamon and nutmeg.
Gradually add the warm cream mixture to the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.

title: Tortilla de Patatas

Salt and black pepper, to taste

Use a spatula to carefully loosen the tortilla from the pan and slide it onto a plate.

1 pound rabbit, cut into bite-sized pieces

Salt and black pepper, to taste

title: Gazpacho Andaluz

With the blender or food processor running, slowly pour in the olive oil through the top.

title: Empanada Gallega

title: Churros con Chocolate

title: Gazpacho Andaluz

Remove from the oven and sprinkle with cinnamon.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and rabbit; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, paprika, saffron, and tomato paste; cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute.
Add the rice; cook, stirring constantly, 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and water; bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed, about 20-25 minutes.
Remove from heat; let rest, covered, 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley, if desired.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 3-4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 10-12 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk the eggs; season with paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked potato mixture to the eggs; stir to combine.
Heat a small non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture; cook, tilting the pan, until the edges start to set, about 2-3 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, until the tortilla is set and the eggs are cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley, if desired.

title: Pollo al Ajillo
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken breast or thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken; cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the garlic; cook, stirring constantly, 1-2 minutes.
Add the paprika and saffron; cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley, if desired.

title: Gazpacho
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the tomatoes, bell pepper, cucumber, onion, and garlic.
Blend until coarsely chopped.
With the blender or food processor running, slowly add the oil and vinegar.
Season with paprika, salt, and pepper to taste.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve chilled, garnished with parsley, if desired.

title: Churros con Chocolate
ingredients: 1 cup dark chocolate, broken into pieces
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt.
Add the milk, eggs, and cinnamon; whisk until smooth.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Using a piping bag, pipe the dough into long, thin strips.
Fry the churros, 2-3 at a time, until golden and puffed, about 2-3 minutes.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve hot with chocolate sauce (see below).
To make the chocolate sauce, heat the chocolate and cream in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, until smooth.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 pound chicken thighs, boneless and skinless
1 pound rabbit meat, cut into 1-inch pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chorizo and cook until browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the chicken and rabbit and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and red bell pepper and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the tomatoes, broth, paprika, and saffron and stir to combine.
Add the rice and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and cook until they are tender, about 10-12 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and garlic.
Add the cooked potatoes and onion to the bowl and stir to combine.
