Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9-inch round skillet.
Cook over medium heat until the edges start to set, about 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 375°F for 15-20 minutes or until the tortilla is set and golden brown.

title: Pollo al Ajillo
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the wine, broth, and lemon juice and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the chicken garnished with parsley.

title: Churros con Chocolate
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, salt, and cinnamon.
In a large bowl, whisk together the milk and eggs.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir to combine.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Using a piping bag, pipe the dough into long, thin strips.
Fry the churros until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the churros on paper towels and dust with cinnamon sugar.
Melt the chocolate in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval.
Serve the churros with the melted chocolate and whipped cream.

title: Crema Catalana
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and sugar until pale and thick.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the cream, milk, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt.
Add the cream mixture to the egg yolk mixture and stir to combine.
Pour the mixture into 6 (1/2 cup) ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake at 300°F for 25-30 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Drizzle with caramel sauce and serve chilled.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender and golden brown, about 20 minutes.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs and season with smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the cooked potato mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Heat a small amount of olive oil in the skillet over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and cook until the bottom is set, about 5 minutes.
Use a spatula to carefully flip the tortilla and cook the other side until set, about 5 minutes.
Serve warm, sliced into wedges.

title: Pollo al Ajillo
instructions: Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken breasts until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the minced garlic to the skillet.
Cook, stirring constantly, until the garlic is fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the white wine and chicken broth to the skillet, scraping up any browned bits.
Return the chicken to the skillet and simmer until cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Stir in the butter until melted.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with chopped parsley.

title: Fabada Asturiana
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced chorizo, morcilla, and pork sausage to the pot.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the sausage is browned, about 10 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Spanish rice to the pot and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and simmer until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed, about 20-25 minutes.
Stir in the paprika and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the fabada hot, garnished with chopped parsley.

title: Chopitos Fritos
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Pour the buttermilk into a separate shallow dish.
Dip the squid rings into the buttermilk, coating completely, then roll in the flour mixture to coat.
Heat a large skillet or deep fryer with about 2-3 inches of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Fry the coated squid rings in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per batch.
Drain the fried squid on paper towels and serve hot.

title: Crema Catalana
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a medium saucepan, combine the heavy cream, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks.
Gradually add the hot cream mixture to the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Return the mixture to the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens and coats the back of a spoon, about 10-12 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in the ground cinnamon.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake until set, about 25-30 minutes.
Serve the crema catalana warm, caramelized with a blowtorch if desired.

title: Fabada Asturiana
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add chorizo, morcilla, and panceta; cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onions and garlic; cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add paprika; cook for 1 minute.
Add wine and broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low; simmer, covered, until beans are tender, about 1 hour.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley.

title: Pollo al Ajillo
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken; cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove chicken; set aside.
Add garlic to skillet; cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add wine and broth; bring to a boil.
Return chicken to skillet; add paprika and saffron.
Reduce heat to low; simmer, covered, until chicken is cooked through, about 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 2 pounds potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add potatoes and onion; cook until potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
Beat eggs in a bowl; add flour and milk.
Pour egg mixture over potatoes; cook until eggs are set, about 5 minutes.
Invert tortilla onto a plate; serve hot, garnished with parsley.

title: Gazpacho
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine tomatoes, bell pepper, cucumber, onion, parsley, cilantro, and garlic in a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Heat oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add paprika; cook for 1 minute.
Add vinegar to skillet; cook for 1 minute.
Stir vinegar mixture into gazpacho.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve chilled.

title: Churros con Chocolate
instructions: Combine flour, baking powder, and sugar in a bowl.
Add milk, eggs, and oil to bowl; mix until smooth.
Heat oil in a deep fryer to 375°F.
Pipe dough into long strips; fry until golden, about 2 minutes.
Drain churros on paper towels.
Melt chocolate in a double boiler.
Whisk cream and cinnamon into chocolate.
Serve churros with chocolate sauce.

title: Fabada Asturiana
ingredients: 2 cups mixed shellfish (clams, mussels, and cockles)
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chorizo and morcilla and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the cod, shellfish, white wine, chicken broth, and smoked paprika.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.

title: Polvo a la Vasca
ingredients: 1 lb cuttlefish, cleaned and cut into 1-inch pieces
1 cup mixed bell peppers (red, yellow, and green)
2 cups mixed mushrooms (such as button and cremini)
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the cuttlefish and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the bell peppers and mushrooms and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the white wine, fish broth, and smoked paprika.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 2 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the potatoes and onion and cook until the potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Pour the eggs over the potatoes and onion in the skillet.
Cook until the eggs are set, about 5 minutes.
Loosen the edges with a spatula and slide the tortilla onto a plate.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.

title: Fabes con Bacalao
ingredients: 1 lb dried white beans (such as fabes or cannellini)
instructions: Rinse the beans and soak them in water for at least 8 hours.
Drain and rinse the beans, then transfer them to a large pot.
Add the cod, olive oil, onion, garlic, and white wine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.

title: Arroz con Mariscos
ingredients: 1 cup mixed shellfish (clams, mussels, and cockles)
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the shellfish and cook until the shells open, about 5 minutes.
Add the rice and cook until coated in oil, about 2 minutes.
Add the fish broth, white wine, and smoked paprika.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Add the potatoes and cook until golden brown.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Add the cooked potatoes and onion mixture to the bowl and mix well.
Pour the mixture into the frying pan and cook until the eggs are set.
Flip the tortilla and cook for another 2-3 minutes.
Serve warm, garnished with parsley if desired.

title: Gazpacho Andaluz
instructions: Combine the diced vegetables, parsley, and garlic in a blender.
Blend until smooth.
With the blender running, slowly pour in the olive oil.
Add the sherry vinegar and smoked paprika (if using) and blend until combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Serve cold, garnished with additional parsley if desired.

title: Pollo al Ajillo
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on both sides.
Add the white wine, chicken broth, and smoked paprika.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley if desired.

title: Fabada Asturiana
ingredients: 1 cup dried white beans, soaked overnight and drained
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chorizo, morcilla, and panceta and cook until browned.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beans, chicken broth, and smoked paprika.
Simmer until the beans are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley if desired.

title: Crema Catalana
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C).
In a medium saucepan, whisk together the sugar, flour, and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add the milk, whisking until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and vanilla extract.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm milk mixture into the eggs, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Serve cold, topped with caramel sauce if desired.

title: Escalivada
ingredients: 2 large red bell peppers, seeded and cut into 1-inch pieces
2 large red onions, cut into 1-inch pieces
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss the eggplant, bell peppers, and onions with the olive oil, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Transfer the vegetables to a baking sheet and roast for 30-40 minutes, or until tender and lightly charred.
Remove the vegetables from the oven and let cool slightly.
Mash the roasted vegetables in a large bowl with the garlic until well combined.

title: Pa amb tomàquet
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill the baguette slices until lightly toasted.
Rub the grilled bread with the garlic and then with the diced tomatoes.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt to taste.

title: Fideuà
ingredients: 1 pound mixed seafood (such as shrimp, mussels, and clams)
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook the fideuà noodles according to package instructions.
Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the seafood and chorizo and cook until the seafood is pink and the chorizo is browned.
Add the fish broth, water, and saffron, and bring to a boil.
Add the cooked fideuà noodles to the pan and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Crema Catalana
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a medium saucepan, combine the sugar, heavy cream, whole milk, and vanilla extract.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and a pinch of salt.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the hot cream mixture into the eggs, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until set.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Pan con tomate y aceite
instructions: Rub the diced garlic over the toasted bread.
Rub the diced tomatoes over the garlic.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt to taste.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook until they are tender, about 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs and mix in the smoked paprika.
Add the cooked potato and onion mixture to the bowl and mix well.
Pour the mixture back into the frying pan and cook until the eggs are set.
Serve hot, sliced into wedges.

title: Pintxos de Txuleta
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over high heat.
Add the sliced steaks and cook for 1-2 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking.
Meanwhile, toast the baguette slices until crispy.
Assemble the pintxos by placing a slice of steak on each toasted baguette slice.
Top each pintxo with a spoonful of garlic, an anchovy fillet, and a sprinkle of parsley.
Serve immediately.

title: Pan con Tomate y Aceite
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chopped tomatoes and garlic.
Using a fork, mash the tomato mixture until it's smooth.
Drizzle the olive oil over the mashed tomatoes and mix well.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve the tomato mixture on toasted baguette slices.

title: Bacalao en Salmorejo
ingredients: 1 pound dried cod, soaked and flaked
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the flaked cod and cook until heated through.
Stir in the parsley, cilantro, sherry vinegar, and smoked paprika.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.

title: Gazpacho Andaluz
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the diced tomatoes, red bell pepper, cucumber, parsley, cilantro, and garlic.
Blend until smooth.
With the blender or food processor running, slowly pour in the olive oil and sherry vinegar.
Stir in the smoked paprika.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro if desired.

title: Pulpo a la Gallega
ingredients: 1 large octopus, cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add garlic and onion; cook until softened, 5 minutes.
Add octopus; cook until lightly browned, 5 minutes.
Add wine, fish stock, and paprika; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low; simmer, covered, 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper; serve.

title: Polbo á Feira
ingredients: 1 large octopus, cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion; cook until softened, 5 minutes.
Add garlic and octopus; cook until lightly browned, 5 minutes.
Add water and paprika; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low; simmer, covered, 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper; serve.

title: Empanada Gallega
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine flour and salt in a bowl.
Gradually add warm water; mix until dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes.
Roll out dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Spread garlic, cheese, and ham over dough.
Fold dough in half; press edges to seal.
Brush with oil; bake for 25-30 minutes.

title: Caldo Gallego
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Roast bones for 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chorizo and morcilla; cook until browned, 5 minutes.
Add potatoes, carrots, celery, and onion; cook until vegetables are tender, 10 minutes.
Add broth, paprika, and roasted bones; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low; simmer, covered, 20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper; serve.

title: Torta de Aceite
instructions: Combine flour, oil, water, salt, and sugar in a bowl.
Mix until dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes.
Shape dough into a round; press into a greased skillet.
Cook over medium heat until golden brown, 5-7 minutes per side.
Serve warm.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 lb rabbit meat, cut into small pieces
2 teaspoons saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and rabbit and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the morcilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, water, saffron, and smoked paprika. Stir to combine.
Add the Calasparra rice to the pan and stir to coat with the liquid.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.

title: Fabada Asturiana
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the morcilla, chorizo, and panceta and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the white wine and cook until the liquid has been almost completely reduced, about 2 minutes.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, smoked paprika, and saffron. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Season the fabada with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the fabada hot, garnished with chopped parsley and chives.

title: Arroz con Costra (Crust Paella)
ingredients: 1 pound rabbit meat, cut into small pieces
2 teaspoons saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and rabbit and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the Calasparra rice to the pan and stir to coat with the oil.
Add the chicken broth, water, saffron, and smoked paprika. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Sprinkle the Manchego cheese over the top of the paella and return it to the heat for 1-2 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.

title: Crema Catalana (Catalan Cream)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).

In a medium saucepan, combine the heavy cream, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks. Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm cream mixture into the bowl, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 6-8 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let them cool to room temperature.
Cover the ramekins with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
Just before serving, sprinkle the tops of the crema catalana with a pinch of cinnamon and nutmeg.

title: Tortilla de Patatas (Spanish Omelette)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and cook until they are golden brown, about 10-12 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Add the cooked potato mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into the skillet and cook over medium heat until the edges start to set.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the tortilla towards the center, allowing the uncooked egg to flow to the edges.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the tortilla is almost set.
Use the spatula to carefully slide the tortilla out of the skillet onto a plate.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.

title: Pollo al Ajillo (Garlic Chicken)
ingredients: 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 8 pieces
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 1 minute.
Add chicken and cook until browned, 5 minutes.
Add paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add lemon juice and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 10 minutes.

title: Fabada Asturiana (Asturian Bean Stew)
ingredients: 2 cups mixed beans (such as chorizo, garbanzo, and lima beans)
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, 5 minutes.
Add garlic, morcilla, chorizo, and panceta. Cook until browned, 5 minutes.
Add white wine and cook until reduced, 2 minutes.
Add broth and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer, 20 minutes.
Add beans and cook until heated through, 10 minutes.

title: Tortilla de Patatas (Spanish Omelette)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add potatoes and cook until tender, 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl, beat eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Pour eggs over potatoes and cook until edges start to set, 2 minutes.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold edges towards the center, allowing uncooked egg to flow underneath.
Cook until eggs are almost set, 5 minutes.
Slide tortilla onto a plate and serve hot.

title: Chopitos Fritos (Fried Baby Squid)
ingredients: 1 pound baby squid, cleaned and patted dry
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together flour, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Dredge squid in flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add squid and cook until golden brown, 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove squid from oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Add garlic to oil and cook for 1 minute.
Return squid to oil and cook for an additional minute.
Serve hot with lemon wedges.

title: Gazpacho Andaluz (Andalusian Cold Soup)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine tomatoes, bell pepper, cucumber, onion, and garlic.
Blend until smooth.
With blender running, slowly add bread and blend until well combined.
Heat olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add vinegar, paprika, salt, and pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Stir vinegar mixture into gazpacho and refrigerate until chilled, at least 30 minutes.
Serve cold, garnished with croutons or a dollop of sour cream, if desired.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook until they start to brown, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and smoked paprika, and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt.
Pour the egg mixture over the potatoes and onion in the skillet.
Cook until the eggs are set, about 10-12 minutes.
Slide the tortilla onto a plate and serve warm.

title: Pollo al Ajillo
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken pieces and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the white wine, chicken broth, and lemon juice.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-12 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with parsley.

title: Fabada Asturiana
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the pancetta and cook until crispy, about 5 minutes.
Add the chorizo and morcilla, and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic, and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the rice, chicken broth, and white wine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve hot.

title: Chuletón de Buey
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Rub the beef roast with the olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Heat a large skillet over high heat, and sear the beef roast until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the beef roast to a large baking dish, and add the red wine.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes per pound, or until the beef reaches your desired level of doneness.
Let the beef rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Crema Catalana
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a medium bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and granulated sugar until pale and thick.
Add the heavy cream, whole milk, and salt, and whisk until well combined.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish, and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove from the water bath, and let cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled and set.

title: Fabada Asturiana
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chorizo, morcilla, and panceta, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the smoked ham, white wine, chicken broth, and smoked paprika.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Arroz con Mariscos
ingredients: 1 pound squid, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mussels, clams, shrimp, and squid, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the Arborio rice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the fish broth, white wine, and saffron, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Pulpo a la Gallega
ingredients: 2 pounds octopus, cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the octopus and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the white wine, water, smoked paprika, and saffron.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
ingredients: 4 large potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the potatoes and cook until golden brown, about 10 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, flour, and milk.
Pour the egg mixture over the potatoes and cook until set, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Fabada Pintada
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the blood sausage, chorizo, morcilla, and panceta, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the white wine, chicken broth, and smoked paprika.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Escalivada
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss eggplant, bell pepper, and onion slices with olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Roast in the oven for 30-40 minutes or until tender.
Mash garlic and mix with roasted vegetables.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Pa amb tomàquet
ingredients: Extra virgin olive oil for serving
instructions: Grill or toast bread slices until crispy.
Rub garlic cloves on toasted bread.
Top with diced tomatoes and a pinch of salt.
Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil.

title: Fideuà
instructions: Cook fideuà noodles according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet and sauté onion and garlic.
Add mixed seafood and cook until pink.
Add fish stock and bring to a simmer.
Combine cooked noodles and seafood mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Crema Catalana
instructions: Combine sugar, flour, and a pinch of salt in a saucepan.
Whisk in milk and heavy cream.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg yolks and vanilla extract.
Temper egg yolks by slowly pouring the hot milk mixture into the eggs.
Return mixture to the saucepan and cook until thickened.
Chill in the refrigerator until set.
Serve with caramel sauce.

title: Pan con xarcuteria
instructions: Grill or toast bread slices until crispy.
Slice cured meats into thin strips.
Serve toasted bread with cured meats and a drizzle of olive oil.
Season with salt to taste.

title: Pintxos de Aceitunas y Chorizo
instructions: Preheat the broiler.
Brush the baguette slices with olive oil and toast until crispy.
Top each toasted slice with a piece of chorizo, a few slices of green and black olives, and a sprinkle of Manchego cheese.
Sprinkle with smoked paprika and serve immediately.

title: Txuleta de Buey con Patatas
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Season the steak with salt and pepper.
Grill the steak for 3-4 minutes per side or until cooked to desired doneness.
While the steak is cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until caramelized.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook until tender.
Stir in the garlic, beef broth, and smoked paprika.
Serve the steak with the potato and onion mixture.

title: Piperrada de Espinacas
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook until tender.
Add the chopped tomato and cook until the mixture is heated through.
Stir in the smoked paprika and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Add the fresh spinach leaves and cook until wilted.
Serve hot, topped with crumbled Idiazabal cheese if desired.

title: Gazpacho Andaluz
instructions: Combine the diced tomato, bell pepper, cucumber, and red onion in a blender.
Add the minced garlic and blend until smooth.
With the blender running, slowly pour in the olive oil.
Stir in the sherry vinegar and smoked paprika.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve chilled, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.

title: Tortilla de Patatas y Cebolla
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add a tablespoon of olive oil and cook the diced onion until softened.
Add the diced potatoes and cook until tender.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the cooked potato and onion mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Heat a tablespoon of olive oil in the skillet over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and cook until the edges start to set.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the tortilla towards the center.
Continue cooking and folding until the tortilla is set and golden brown.

title: Polbo á Feira
ingredients: 1 large octopus, cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 1 tablespoon hot water
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Add the octopus and cook until browned.
Add the wine, water, paprika, and saffron.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot with lemon wedges on the side.

title: Empanada Gallega
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Roll out the pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
In a pan, cook the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the chorizo and shrimp and cook until browned.
Mix in the fish broth and paprika.
Spread the mixture onto one half of the pastry.
Fold the other half over and press edges to seal.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Fabada Asturiana
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sausage, chorizo, and morcilla and cook until browned.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Add the wine and broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with paprika, salt, and pepper to taste.

title: Torta de Aceite
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a bowl, mix together the flour, oil, anise seeds, rosemary, and honey.
Add the salt and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes.
Shape into a ball and flatten slightly.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Pulpo a la Gallega
ingredients: 1 large octopus, cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 1 tablespoon hot water
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Add the octopus and cook until browned.
Add the wine, water, paprika, and saffron.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Paella Valenciana
ingredients: 1 pound boneless chicken thighs, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, 5 minutes.
Add the sausage and cook until browned, 3 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, 5 minutes.
Add the rice and stir to coat the rice in oil and mix with the vegetables.
Add the chicken broth, water, smoked paprika, and saffron.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, 20 minutes.
Increase heat to high and cook, uncovered, until the rice is golden and crispy at the bottom (the socarrat), 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest, covered, 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley if desired.

title: Fideuà
ingredients: 1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, 2 minutes.
Add the mussels and clams and cook until they open, 3 minutes.
Add the sausage and cook until browned, 3 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, 5 minutes.
Add the noodles and stir to coat the noodles in oil and mix with the vegetables.
Add the fish broth, water, and saffron.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, 10 minutes.
Increase heat to high and cook, uncovered, until the noodles are tender and the liquid has been absorbed, 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest, covered, 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley if desired.

title: Escalivada
ingredients: 2 large red bell peppers, cut into 1/2-inch slices
2 large red onions, cut into 1/2-inch slices
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss the eggplant, bell peppers, and onions with oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the oven, turning occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and lightly charred, 30 minutes.
Heat the garlic in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the roasted vegetables to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are caramelized, 10 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Tortilla de Patatas
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the potatoes and cook until they are tender, 10 minutes.
Add the onions and cook until they are translucent, 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk the eggs and season with salt and pepper.
Add the cooked potatoes and onions to the bowl and stir to combine.
Heat a small amount of oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour in the egg mixture and cook until the edges start to set, 2 minutes.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the tortilla towards the center, allowing the uncooked egg to flow to the edges.
Cook until the tortilla is set and golden brown on the bottom, 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and let rest, covered, 5 minutes.
Serve hot, sliced into wedges.

title: Crema Catalana
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C).
In a medium saucepan, combine the sugar and 1/2 cup of the heavy cream.
Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling, 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk the egg yolks and vanilla extract.
Gradually add the hot sugar mixture to the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly, 25-30 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate until chilled, at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, sprinkle with cinnamon and caramelize with a kitchen torch, if desired.

title: Coq au Vin
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds chicken thighs, bone-in and skin-on
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the chicken on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it's softened and caramelized.
Add the garlic, cognac, and red wine to the pot.
Scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Add the chicken broth, tomato paste, and thyme.
Return the chicken to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Add the sliced carrots and celery to the pot and braise for another 10-15 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the pot and braise for 5 minutes, or until they're tender.
Serve the Coq au Vin hot, garnished with fresh parsley.

title: Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 2 pounds fish and seafood (such as mussels, clams, and shrimp)
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it's softened.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced fennel and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, fish broth, water, saffron, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer.
Add the mussels, clams, and shrimp to the pot.
Cook for 5-10 minutes, or until the seafood is cooked through.
Serve the Bouillabaisse hot, topped with rouille and croutons.

title: Tarte Tatin
ingredients: 3 pounds apples, peeled, cored, and halved
1/2 cup unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sliced apples, granulated sugar, flour, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and allspice.
Toss the apples to coat them evenly with the dry ingredients.
Melt 2 tablespoons of the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the apple mixture to the skillet and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the apples are tender and caramelized.
Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place the pastry over the apple mixture and tuck the edges under the fruit.
Dot the top of the pastry with the remaining butter.
Bake the Tarte Tatin in a preheated oven at 425°F for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Let the Tarte Tatin cool for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced eggplant and cook until it's tender and golden brown.
Add the sliced zucchinis and cook until they're tender.
Add the sliced bell peppers and cook until they're tender.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it's softened.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the chopped basil and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Ratatouille hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.

title: Crème Brûlée
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F.
In a medium saucepan, combine the heavy cream, granulated sugar, whole milk, and salt.
Heat the mixture over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
Remove the mixture from the heat and stir in the vanilla extract.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks.
Gradually add the warm cream mixture to the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake the Crème Brûlée for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let them cool to room temperature.
Cover the ramekins with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of granulated sugar over the top of each ramekin.
Caramelize the sugar with a kitchen torch or under the broiler.

title: Coq au Vin
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper. Heat butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the sliced onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine, chicken broth, tomato paste, thyme, rosemary, and bay leaf to the pot. Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Return the chicken to the pot and add the mushrooms, bacon, and pearl onions. Cover the pot and transfer to the oven. Braise for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly. Serve the Coq au Vin hot, garnished with fresh herbs.

title: Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 1 pound cod, cut into large pieces
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the fish heads and bones, mussels, clams, shrimp, and cod to the pot. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the fennel, tomatoes, fish broth, white wine, saffron, and thyme to the pot. Stir to combine and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the Bouillabaisse hot, garnished with croutons and a dollop of rouille.

title: Tarte Tatin
ingredients: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). In a large skillet, combine the apples and granulated sugar. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the apples are tender and caramelized.
Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch. Transfer the pastry to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Arrange the cooked apples in the pastry-lined tart pan, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges. Dot the top of the apples with the butter pieces.
Roll the edges of the pastry up over the apples to form a crust. Brush the pastry with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Bake the Tarte Tatin for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the apples are tender.

title: Ratatouille
ingredients: 1 red bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the eggplant and cook until tender, about 5 minutes. Add the zucchini and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the red bell pepper to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes, garlic, and thyme to the skillet. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 20-25 minutes, or until the ratatouille has thickened slightly.
Season the ratatouille with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs.

title: Crème Brûlée
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C). In a medium saucepan, combine the heavy cream, granulated sugar, and salt. Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and vanilla extract. Gradually add the hot cream mixture to the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Strain the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes. Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake the crème brûlée for 25-30 minutes, or until set. Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.

Cover the ramekins with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled. Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of granulated sugar over the top of each ramekin and caramelize with a kitchen torch.

title: Coq au Vin
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds chicken thighs, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the red wine, chicken broth, tomato paste, and thyme to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Return the chicken to the pot and simmer until cooked through, about 25 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 1 pound fish fillets (such as halibut or snapper), cut into 1-inch pieces
1/2 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the mussels and clams and cook until they start to open, about 2 minutes.
Add the fish, fish stock, water, tomato paste, bay leaves, thyme, and saffron to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer until the fish is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Tarte Tatin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place the pastry in a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Arrange the apple halves in a concentric circle pattern in the pastry-lined tart pan.
Dot the top of the apples with butter.
Sprinkle the sugar evenly over the apples.
Bake the tart for 25 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 375°F (190°C) and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the apples are tender.
If desired, drizzle with caramel sauce before serving.

title: Ratatouille
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
2 medium zucchinis, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
2 medium bell peppers, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rings
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the eggplant and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the eggplant from the skillet and set aside.
Add the zucchinis and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook until the mixture is heated through, about 5 minutes.
Return the eggplant to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped basil, if desired.

title: Crème Brûlée
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C).
In a medium saucepan, combine the cream, sugar, and salt.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and vanilla extract.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm cream mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of granulated sugar over the top of each ramekin.
Caramelize the sugar with a kitchen torch or under the broiler.

title: Coq au Vin
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, cook the bacon over medium heat until browned.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the cognac to the pot and ignite. Let it burn for 1-2 minutes.
Add the red wine, chicken broth, tomato paste, thyme, rosemary, and bay leaf to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and onions to the pot and simmer for an additional 10-15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 2 lbs fish and shellfish (such as mussels, clams, and shrimp)
1 tsp saffron threads, soaked in 2 tbsp hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the garlic, onion, leeks, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the fish broth, water, saffron, thyme, and rosemary to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Add the fish and shellfish to the pot and simmer for an additional 5-10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Tarte Tatin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the apples to the skillet and cook until they are tender.
Add the sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Roll out the puff pastry and place it over the apples.
Bake the tarte for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the eggplant, zucchini, and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the garlic and onion to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the tomato sauce to the skillet and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Crème Brûlée
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F.
In a medium saucepan, combine the cream, sugar, and vanilla extract.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-10 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks.
Temper the egg yolks with the cream mixture, then pour the mixture into ramekins.
Bake the crème brûlée for 20-25 minutes, or until set.
Sprinkle a layer of sugar over the top of each ramekin and caramelize with a kitchen torch.

title: Coq au Vin
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds chicken thighs, bone-in and skin-on
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat the bacon in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the cognac and ignite, scraping up any browned bits.
Add the wine, carrots, celery, garlic, and herbs.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise until the chicken is cooked through, about 25 minutes.
Stir in the mushrooms and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.

title: Bouillabaisse
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onions, garlic, and leeks and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the fish heads and bones and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, stock, wine, saffron, and fennel seeds.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the shrimp, mussels, and clams and cook, covered, until the seafood is cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, with rouille and croutons on the side, if desired.

title: Tarte Tatin
ingredients: 3-4 Granny Smith apples, peeled and halved
1/4 cup unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large skillet, combine the sugar, flour, and salt.
Add the butter and cook, stirring constantly, until the sugar dissolves.
Add the apples and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 10 minutes.
Roll out the pie crust and place over the apples.
Tuck the edges of the crust under the apples and trim the excess.
Bake until the crust is golden, about 25 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk the cream and egg until smooth.
Pour the cream mixture over the apples and return to the oven.
Bake until the filling is set and the crust is golden, about 10 minutes.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the eggplant and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the zucchinis and bell peppers and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer, stirring occasionally, until the flavors have melded together, about 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped basil, if desired.

title: Crème Brûlée
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C).
In a medium saucepan, combine the cream, sugar, and salt.
Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar dissolves.
In a small bowl, whisk the egg yolks and vanilla extract until smooth.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm cream mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake until set, about 25-30 minutes.
Remove from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate until chilled, at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of granulated sugar over the top of each ramekin.
Caramelize the sugar with a kitchen torch or under the broiler.

title: Coq au Vin
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, cook the bacon over medium heat until browned.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the cognac and flambé until the liquid is almost gone.
Add the red wine, chicken broth, carrots, celery, onion, garlic, thyme, and rosemary.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Add the mushrooms and continue to cook for 5-10 minutes, or until they are tender.

title: Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 2 lbs fish and shellfish (such as mussels, clams, and shrimp)
2 lbs vegetable scraps (such as carrot tops, celery leaves, and onion peels)
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is softened.
Add the vegetable scraps and cook until they are tender.
Add the fish broth, white wine, saffron, thyme, and paprika.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Add the fish and shellfish to the pot and cook until they are tender.
Season the bouillabaisse with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the bouillabaisse hot, topped with croutons and rouille.

title: Tarte Tatin
instructions: In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the sugar and cook until it is dissolved.
Add the apples to the skillet and cook until they are tender.
Roll out the puff pastry and place it over the apples.
Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake at 400°F for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove the skillet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Invert the tarte onto a serving plate and serve warm.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the eggplant, zucchini, and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until they are tender.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is softened.
Season the ratatouille with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the ratatouille hot, garnished with fresh herbs.

title: Crème Brûlée
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F.
In a medium saucepan, combine the cream, sugar, and vanilla extract.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the hot cream mixture into the bowl.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins and place them in a baking dish.
Add hot water to the baking dish to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let them cool to room temperature.
Cover the ramekins with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of sugar over the top of each ramekin.
Caramelize the sugar with a kitchen torch or under the broiler.

title: Coq au Vin
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds chicken thighs, cut into 8 pieces
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken and set aside.
Melt the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter in the pot and add the sliced onion.
Cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red wine and bring to a boil.
Scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Add the chicken broth, tomato paste, thyme, rosemary, and bay leaf.
Return the chicken to the pot and bring to a boil.
Add the mushrooms, bacon, and pearl onions to the pot.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.

title: Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 2 pounds assorted fish and shellfish, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the fish and shellfish and cook until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the fish broth, white wine, water, tomatoes, tomato paste, saffron, and thyme.
Bring the mixture to a boil and then reduce the heat to low.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the bouillabaisse hot, topped with rouille if desired.

title: Tarte Tatin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the sugar and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sugar is caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add the halved apples to the skillet and cook until they are tender and caramelized, about 10-15 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the flour and salt.
Add the flour mixture to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Roll out the puff pastry and place it over the apples.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the beaten egg and fold the pastry over the apples.
Bake the tarte Tatin for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the eggplant, zucchini, bell peppers, and tomatoes to the skillet.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned, about 20-25 minutes.
Season the ratatouille with thyme, salt, and pepper to taste.

title: Crème Brûlée
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C).
In a medium saucepan, combine the heavy cream, granulated sugar, and salt.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and vanilla extract.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm cream mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Strain the mixture into 4 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let them cool to room temperature.
Cover the ramekins with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of granulated sugar over the top of each ramekin.
Caramelize the sugar with a kitchen torch or under the broiler.

title: Coq au Vin
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds chicken thighs, bone-in and skin-on
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken until browned, then remove and set aside.
Add the bacon and cook until browned, then remove and set aside.
Add the carrots, celery, and garlic, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the cognac and cook until the liquid is almost completely evaporated.
Add the red wine, thyme, rosemary, and bay leaf, and bring to a boil.
Return the chicken and bacon to the pot, and simmer until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the chicken and sauce over egg noodles.

title: Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 2 pounds fish and shellfish, such as mussels, clams, and shrimp
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the diced tomatoes, fish stock, water, bay leaves, saffron, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer.
Add the fish and shellfish, and cook until the seafood is cooked through.
Serve the bouillabaisse with croutons and grated cheese.

title: Tournedos Rossini
instructions: Season the filet mignon with salt and pepper.
Sear the filet mignon in a hot skillet until browned, then set aside.
Add the butter to the skillet, then add the Madeira wine and cognac.
Scrape up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Add the foie gras and truffle to the pan, and cook until the foie gras is browned.
Serve the filet mignon with the foie gras and truffle, and spoon the mushroom duxelles and truffle sauce over the top.

title: Cassoulet
ingredients: 1 pound white beans, such as cannellini or Great Northern
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F.
Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the sausage and cook until browned, then remove and set aside.
Add the pork and cook until browned, then remove and set aside.
Add the garlic, onion, carrot, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the white beans, diced tomatoes, chicken broth, thyme, and rosemary, and bring to a boil.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 2 hours, or until the beans are tender.
Serve the cassoulet hot, topped with the sausage and pork.

title: Crème Brûlée
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F.
Whisk the cream, sugar, and vanilla extract in a saucepan until the sugar is dissolved.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg yolks until light and fluffy.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm cream mixture into the eggs, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4 ramekins and place in a baking dish.
Add hot water to the baking dish to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Let the crème brûlée cool to room temperature, then cover and refrigerate until chilled.
Just before serving, sprinkle a layer of granulated sugar over the top of each ramekin and caramelize with a kitchen torch.

title: Coq au Vin
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken thighs, cut into 8 pieces
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the pot and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the pot.
Add the sliced onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the red wine, chicken broth, tomato paste, thyme, and rosemary to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a boil.
Return the chicken to the pot and simmer, covered, until the chicken is cooked through, about 25 minutes.
Serve the Coq au Vin hot, garnished with fresh parsley.

title: Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 2 pounds mixed fish and shellfish (such as mussels, clams, and shrimp)
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the fish broth, water, tomato paste, thyme, and bay leaves to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.
Add the mixed fish and shellfish to the pot and simmer, covered, until the seafood is cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Serve the Bouillabaisse hot, topped with rouille.

title: Tarte Tatin
ingredients: 3-4 Golden Delicious apples, peeled and halved
instructions: In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the granulated sugar to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sugar is caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add the halved apples to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the apples are tender and caramelized, about 10 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and allspice.
Add the flour mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place the puff pastry over the apples and tuck the edges under the apples.
Bake the Tarte Tatin in a preheated oven at 425°F (220°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Serve the Tarte Tatin hot, topped with heavy cream.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced eggplant, zucchinis, and bell peppers to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic, chopped tomatoes, thyme, and rosemary to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season the Ratatouille with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Ratatouille hot, garnished with fresh parsley.

title: Crème Brûlée
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine the heavy cream, granulated sugar, and salt.
Cook the mixture over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and vanilla extract.
Gradually add the hot cream mixture to the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake the Crème Brûlée in a preheated oven at 300°F (150°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover the ramekins with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of granulated sugar over the top of each ramekin.
Caramelize the sugar with a kitchen torch or under the broiler.

title: Coq au Vin
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds chicken thighs, bone-in and skin-on
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the chicken on all sides, then remove and set aside.
Add more butter if needed, then sauté the onion, garlic, carrots, and celery until the vegetables are tender.
Add cognac and cook until the liquid is almost completely evaporated.
Add red wine and bring to a boil, scraping the bottom of the pot.
Add the chicken broth, tomato paste, thyme, rosemary, and bay leaf.
Return the chicken to the pot and bring to a boil.
Cover and transfer the pot to the oven.
Bake at 300°F for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the bay leaf and stir in the flour to thicken the sauce.

title: Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 2 pounds fish and shellfish (such as mussels, clams, and shrimp)
2 pounds vegetables (such as onions, carrots, and celery)
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Sauté the garlic and fennel until fragrant.
Add the vegetables and cook until tender.
Add the fish and shellfish and cook until they start to open.
Add the tomatoes, fish stock, water, saffron, and thyme.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve with croutons and rouille.

title: Tarte Tatin
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F.
Roll out the pie crust and place it in a 9-inch tart pan.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the sugar and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sugar dissolves.
Add the apples and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften.
Add the flour, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and allspice, and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Roll the pie crust over the apples and crimp the edges.
Brush the crust with the beaten egg.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Invert the tart onto a serving plate and serve with heavy cream.

title: Ratatouille
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sauté the eggplant, zucchinis, and bell peppers until they start to soften.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook for 10-15 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped basil, if desired.

title: Crème Brûlée
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F.
In a medium saucepan, combine the heavy cream, granulated sugar, and salt.
Cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar dissolves.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and vanilla extract.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the warm cream mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4-6 ramekins or small baking dishes.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of granulated sugar over the top of each ramekin.
Caramelize the sugar with a kitchen torch or under the broiler.

title: Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 1 pound assorted fish and shellfish, cut into bite-sized pieces
4 cups fish stock, homemade or store-bought
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
Croutons and grated Gruyère cheese, for serving
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion, garlic, leeks, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the fish and shellfish, fish stock, bay leaves, thyme, saffron, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the mussels and clams, and cook until they open, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the rouille and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the bouillabaisse hot, topped with croutons and grated Gruyère cheese.

title: Coq au Vin
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds chicken thighs, bone-in and skin-on
instructions: Season the chicken with salt, pepper, and thyme.
Heat the butter in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cognac and ignite the mixture, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Add the onion, garlic, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the red wine, chicken broth, mushrooms, and pearl onions, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the bacon and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the Coq au Vin hot, garnished with fresh parsley.

title: Tarte Tatin
ingredients: 3 pounds apples, peeled, halved, and cored
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
In a large bowl, combine the apples, sugar, flour, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and allspice. Toss until the apples are evenly coated.
Roll out the pie crust and place it in a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
Arrange the apple mixture in the pie crust, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Dot the top of the apples with the butter.
Roll out the remaining pie crust and use it to cover the tart. Crimp the edges to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape.
Bake the tart for 25 minutes, then reduce the heat to 375°F (190°C) and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.

title: Ratatouille
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
2 large zucchinis, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
2 large bell peppers, sliced into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the eggplant and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the zucchinis and bell peppers, and cook until they are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and onion, and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10-15 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and the mixture is thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the ratatouille hot, garnished with chopped fresh basil if desired.

title: Crème Brûlée
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C).
In a medium saucepan, combine the sugar, cream, milk, and salt. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is hot but not boiling.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks and vanilla extract. Gradually add the hot cream mixture to the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Pour the mixture into 4 (6-ounce) ramekins or custard cups.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let them cool to room temperature. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Just before serving, sprinkle a thin layer of sugar over the top of each ramekin. Caramelize the sugar with a kitchen torch or under the broiler.

title: Bouillabaisse
ingredients: 2 pounds assorted fish and shellfish (such as cod, shrimp, mussels, and clams)
1 teaspoon saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
