Sprinkle kefalograviera cheese over the bechamel sauce.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.

title: Spanakopita (Spinach and Feta Pie)
ingredients: 1 package phyllo dough (usually found in the frozen food section)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine spinach, feta cheese, kefalograviera cheese, scallions, garlic, and thyme.
In a small bowl, mix together melted butter and beaten egg.
Unroll phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Place a piece of phyllo dough on a flat surface and brush with some of the butter mixture.
Place another piece of phyllo dough on top of the first and brush with more of the butter mixture.
Repeat the process until all the phyllo dough is used, finishing with a layer of butter on top.
Spoon the spinach mixture onto the phyllo dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the phyllo dough up over the filling to form a triangle.
Brush the top of the pie with the remaining butter mixture and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the phyllo dough is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olives, and feta cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk together red wine vinegar and olive oil.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Sprinkle red onion over the top of the salad and toss again to combine.
Season with salt, pepper, and oregano to taste.
Serve immediately.

title: Grilled Octopus
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, and oregano.
Brush the octopus tentacles with the marinade and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the octopus for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it is charred and tender.
Serve immediately.

title: Galaktoboureko (Custard Pie in Phyllo)
ingredients: 1 package phyllo dough (usually found in the frozen food section)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a medium saucepan, combine milk, heavy cream, sugar, cornstarch, and salt.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract and melted butter.
In a small bowl, beat the egg and stir it into the custard mixture.
Unroll phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Place a piece of phyllo dough on a flat surface and brush with some of the melted butter.
Place another piece of phyllo dough on top of the first and brush with more of the melted butter.
Repeat the process until all the phyllo dough is used, finishing with a layer of butter on top.
Spoon the custard mixture onto the phyllo dough and sprinkle with chopped walnuts (if using).
Roll the phyllo dough into a log shape and place seam-side down on a baking sheet.
Brush the top of the pie with the remaining melted butter and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the phyllo dough is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.

title: Greek Salad
ingredients: 2 large cucumbers, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Combine diced tomatoes, thinly sliced red onion, and cucumbers in a large bowl.
Crumble feta cheese over the top of the vegetables.
Drizzle extra virgin olive oil over the salad, followed by red wine vinegar.
Sprinkle chopped fresh dill over the top and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately and enjoy!

title: Moussaka
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, sliced into 1/2 inch thick rounds
1 cup bechamel sauce (see below for recipe)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Sauté sliced eggplant in olive oil until golden brown and set aside.
Cook ground beef in a large pan until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in tomato sauce and bring to a simmer. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Bechamel Sauce
instructions: Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add flour to the saucepan and whisk to combine. Cook for 1-2 minutes, or until the mixture is lightly golden.
Slowly add milk to the saucepan, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in grated Parmesan cheese. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Greek Stuffed Grape Leaves
instructions: Prepare grape leaves by removing stems and blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
Combine cooked rice, ground beef, chopped onion, and minced garlic in a large bowl.
Add chopped parsley and dill to the bowl and mix well to combine.
Place a grape leaf on a flat surface and lay a tablespoon of the rice mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.

title: Loukoumades
instructions: Combine flour, sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
Gradually add olive oil to the bowl and mix until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 5-10 minutes until it is smooth and elastic.
Heat a deep frying pan with 2-3 inches of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Fry small balls of dough until they are golden brown and puffed up.

title: Gyro Meat
ingredients: 1 pound ground lamb, beef, or combination of the two
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine ground meat, onion, garlic, oregano, thyme, salt, and pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Form meat mixture into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Brush patties with olive oil and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve in a warm pita with your favorite toppings.

title: Greek Stuffed Bell Peppers
ingredients: 1 pound ground lamb, beef, or combination of the two
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds and membranes. Place in a baking dish.
In a large skillet, cook ground meat over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add cooked rice, chopped tomatoes, feta cheese, parsley, dill, and garlic to the skillet with the ground meat. Mix well.
Stuff each bell pepper with the meat mixture and top with a little water.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove foil and continue baking for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until bell peppers are tender.

title: Spanakopita (Spinach and Feta Pie)
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine spinach, feta cheese, Parmesan cheese, parsley, and garlic. Mix well.
In a small bowl, combine flour, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Add flour mixture to the spinach mixture and mix until just combined.
Unroll filo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Brush each piece of filo with olive oil and place a quarter of the spinach mixture in the center of each piece.
Fold dough over filling to form a triangle and press edges together to seal.
Brush tops with beaten egg and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Grilled Octopus
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, vinegar, and oregano. Mix well.
Add octopus tentacles to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Remove octopus from marinade and season with salt and pepper.
Grill octopus for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred and tender.
Serve immediately.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olives, feta cheese, and red onion.
In a small bowl, combine garlic, red wine vinegar, and olive oil. Mix well.
Drizzle dressing over salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olives, feta cheese, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, and dried oregano.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Moussaka
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Brush eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Sauté eggplant in a large skillet until golden brown.
In a separate skillet, cook onion and garlic until softened.
Add ground lamb and cook until browned, breaking up with a spoon as needed.
In a large baking dish, create a layer of eggplant, followed by a layer of meat mixture, and finally a layer of bechamel sauce.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of bechamel sauce on top.
Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over the top and bake for 45 minutes.

title: Souvlaki
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, oregano, and lemon zest.
Brush the mixture over the pork skewers and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve hot with pita bread and your favorite toppings.

title: Spanakopita
ingredients: 1 package frozen spinach, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine spinach, feta cheese, Parmesan cheese, parsley, and dill.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour and melted butter.
Add the egg to the flour mixture and stir to combine.
Add the wet ingredients to the spinach mixture and stir until just combined.
Spoon the mixture into a 9x13-inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Tiropita
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine feta cheese, Parmesan cheese, parsley, and dill.
In a separate bowl, whisk together melted butter and beaten egg.
Layer the filo dough in a 9x13-inch baking dish, brushing each layer with the butter mixture.
Spoon the cheese mixture into the center of the dough and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
Top with crumbled feta cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, and dried oregano.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Pour dressing over salad and toss to combine.

title: Spanakopita
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine spinach, feta cheese, Parmesan cheese, flour, salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Add melted butter and beaten egg to spinach mixture and stir to combine.
Unfold puff pastry on a lightly floured surface and roll out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer spinach mixture to one half of the puff pastry, leaving a 1/2-inch border around the edges.
Fold the other half of the puff pastry over the filling and press edges to seal.
Brush top of pastry with beaten egg and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Moussaka
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
1 cup bechamel sauce (see below for recipe)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large skillet, sauté eggplant slices until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.
In a separate skillet, cook ground lamb or beef until browned, breaking up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add chopped onion and minced garlic to skillet and cook until onion is translucent.
Stir in tomato puree and cook for 1-2 minutes.
In a large baking dish, create a layer of eggplant slices.
Top with a layer of meat sauce, followed by a layer of bechamel sauce.
Repeat layers two more times, finishing with a layer of bechamel sauce on top.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake for 30-40 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Bechamel Sauce
instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add flour and whisk to combine. Cook for 1-2 minutes, or until mixture is lightly golden.
Slowly add milk, whisking constantly to prevent lumps.
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened, stirring constantly.
Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan cheese until melted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Greek Stuffed Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a small bowl, combine feta cheese, parsley, dill, and garlic.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cut a horizontal slit in each chicken breast to create a pocket.
Stuff each chicken breast with feta cheese mixture and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through.

title: Greek Salad
ingredients: 1 large cucumber, peeled, seeded and thinly sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, combine tomatoes, onion, bell pepper and cucumber.
Top with crumbled feta cheese.
Drizzle with olive oil and red wine vinegar.
Season with dried oregano, salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately.

title: Moussaka
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds eggplant, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Brush eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Sauté lamb or beef in a large skillet until browned.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until softened.
Combine tomato puree with the meat mixture.
In a separate saucepan, heat bechamel sauce over low heat.
In a large baking dish, create a layer of eggplant slices.
Top with the meat mixture, followed by a layer of bechamel sauce.
Repeat the layers, finishing with a layer of bechamel sauce and kefalograviera cheese.
Bake for 45 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Greek Stuffed Zucchini
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Scoop out the insides of the zucchinis, leaving a shell.
Sauté lamb or beef in a large skillet until browned.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until softened.
Combine cooked rice, kefalograviera cheese and beaten egg with the meat mixture.
Stuff each zucchini shell with the meat mixture.
Place the stuffed zucchinis in a baking dish.
Bake for 30-40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Spanakopita
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine spinach, feta cheese, kefalograviera cheese, parsley and scallions in a bowl.
Add garlic to the bowl and mix well.
Roll out puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer the pastry to a baking sheet.
Spread the spinach mixture onto one half of the pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border.
Brush the edges of the pastry with beaten egg.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with beaten egg.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Greek Chicken Souvlaki
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into skewers
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, combine chicken, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and oregano.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Thread chicken onto skewers.
Grill for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
Serve immediately.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olives, feta cheese, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, and dried oregano.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

title: Souvlaki
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds pork skewers, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Thread pork onto skewers and brush with olive oil, garlic, oregano, lemon zest, salt, and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve with pita bread and tzatziki sauce.

title: Spanakopita
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In a large bowl, combine spinach, feta cheese, scallions, Parmesan cheese, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Layer phyllo dough in a baking dish, brushing with olive oil between layers.
Pour spinach mixture into the center of the phyllo and fold the dough over to form a triangle.

title: Greek Stuffed Chicken
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In a small bowl, combine feta cheese, olives, parsley, garlic, and oregano.
Cut a horizontal slit in each chicken breast and fill with the cheese mixture.
Brush the outside of the chicken with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until cooked through.

title: Moussaka
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In a large skillet, cook lamb, onion, and garlic until the lamb is browned.
In a separate skillet, cook eggplant and zucchinis until tender.
In a large baking dish, create a layer of eggplant and zucchinis, followed by a layer of lamb mixture and tomato sauce.
Repeat the layers, finishing with a layer of bechamel sauce and Parmesan cheese.

title: Greek Moussaka
ingredients: 1 large eggplant, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
2 medium eggplants, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
1 cup grated kefalograviera or parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Sauté the eggplant slices in olive oil until golden brown.
In a large pan, cook the lamb or beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the tomato puree and cook for 2-3 minutes.
In a large baking dish, create a layer of eggplant slices, followed by a layer of the meat mixture, and finally a layer of bechamel sauce.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of bechamel sauce on top.
Sprinkle the kefalograviera or parmesan cheese on top of the bechamel sauce.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the moussaka is hot and bubbly.

title: Grilled Octopus with Lemon and Oregano
instructions: Rinse the octopus tentacles under cold water and pat them dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, and oregano.
Add the octopus tentacles to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Grill the octopus for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it is charred and cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional oregano if desired.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
Top the salad with the crumbled feta cheese and Kalamata olives.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, red wine vinegar, and dried oregano.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately.

title: Spanakopita
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1/2 cup grated kefalograviera or parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine the spinach, feta cheese, kefalograviera or parmesan cheese, scallions, dill, and garlic.
Add the beaten egg to the bowl and stir to combine.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place the spinach mixture in the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the olive oil.
Fold the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.

title: Tiropita
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated kefalograviera or parmesan cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine the feta cheese, kefalograviera or parmesan cheese, scallions, and garlic.
Add the beaten egg to the bowl and stir to combine.
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Place the cheese mixture in the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the olive oil.
Fold the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.

title: Moussaka
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
1 cup bechamel sauce (see below for recipe)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Brush eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt.
Sauté eggplant slices until golden brown.
In a separate pan, cook lamb, onion, and garlic until the lamb is browned.
Combine tomato puree and cooked lamb mixture.
In a 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of eggplant slices.
Follow with a layer of the lamb mixture, then a layer of bechamel sauce.
Repeat the layers, finishing with a layer of bechamel sauce and kefalograviera cheese.
Bake for 45 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olives, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together red wine vinegar and olive oil.
Pour dressing over salad and toss to combine.
Top with crumbled feta cheese and serve.

title: Spanakopita
ingredients: 1 package frozen spinach, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, combine spinach, feta cheese, scallions, dill, Parmesan cheese, flour, salt, and pepper.
Mix well to combine.
Roll out puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place a quarter of the spinach mixture in the center of the pastry.
Brush edges with olive oil and fold pastry to form a triangle.
Brush with beaten egg and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Grilled Octopus
ingredients: 1 pound octopus, cleaned and cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
In a bowl, combine octopus, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, red wine vinegar, and oregano.
Marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Grill octopus for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon wedges.

title: Tiropita
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, combine feta cheese, Parmesan cheese, scallions, and dill.
Mix well to combine.
Roll out puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place a quarter of the cheese mixture in the center of the pastry.
Brush edges with olive oil and fold pastry to form a triangle.
Brush with beaten egg and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Stifado (Greek Beef Stew)
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chunks, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef in batches, then set aside.
Soften the onions and garlic, then add the carrots and potatoes.
Add the wine, broth, tomato paste, cinnamon, allspice, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Garnish with parsley and serve with mashed potatoes or rice.

title: Tyropita (Greek Cheese Pie)
instructions: Combine the milk, sugar, and yeast in a bowl and let it sit for 10 minutes.
Add the flour, salt, and melted butter to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes and let it rise for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Roll out the dough and place it in a pie dish.
Mix the feta, egg, and thyme, and pour the mixture into the pie crust.
Brush the edges with oil and bake for 40-45 minutes, or until golden.

title: Giouvetsi (Greek Braised Chicken in a Clay Pot)
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken thighs, bone-in and skin-on
instructions: Heat the oil in a clay pot over medium heat.
Brown the chicken on both sides, then set aside.
Soften the onions and garlic, then add the carrots and potatoes.
Add the broth, wine, tomato paste, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Return the chicken to the pot and bring to a boil.
Simmer, covered, for 45 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with parsley, if desired, and serve.

title: Spanakopita (Greek Spinach Pie)
instructions: Combine the spinach, feta, dill, scallions, garlic, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Layer the phyllo dough in a pie dish, brushing with melted butter between layers.
Pour the spinach mixture into the pie crust.
Brush the top with the beaten egg and sprinkle with thyme.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Loukoumades (Greek Honey Balls)
instructions: Combine the flour, milk, sugar, yeast, and salt in a bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes and let it rise for 1 hour.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F.
Punch down the dough and shape into small balls.
Fry the loukoumades until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with honey.

title: Giouvetsi (Greek Beef Stew)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the browned beef and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onions and cook until softened.
Add the garlic, red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, bay leaves, oregano, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.

title: Tiropita (Greek Cheese Pie)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Thaw the filo dough according to the package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the crumbled feta, grated kefalograviera, and grated Parmesan cheese.
Add the beaten egg, chopped parsley, and chopped dill to the cheese mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Layer the filo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with olive oil.
Pour the cheese mixture into the baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the filo is golden brown and the cheese is melted.

title: Moussaka (Greek Eggplant and Ground Beef Casserole)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Brush the eggplant slices with olive oil and grill until tender.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef until browned.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the tomato puree to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the bechamel sauce and grated kefalograviera cheese.
Add the beaten egg to the cheese mixture and stir to combine.
Layer the eggplant slices, meat sauce, and cheese mixture in a large baking dish.
Top with additional grated cheese and bake for 30-40 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Spanakopita (Greek Spinach and Feta Pie)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Thaw the filo dough according to the package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped spinach, crumbled feta, and grated kefalograviera cheese.
Add the beaten egg, chopped parsley, and chopped dill to the spinach mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Layer the filo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with olive oil.
Pour the spinach mixture into the baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, or until the filo is golden brown and the cheese is melted.

title: Loukoumades (Greek Fried Dough Balls)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the lukewarm water to the flour mixture and stir to combine.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Fry the dough balls until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the fried dough balls on paper towels.
Dip the fried dough balls in a mixture of beaten eggs, sugar, and vanilla extract.
Serve the loukoumades warm, drizzled with honey or syrup.

title: Tomato Keftedes (Tomato Fritters)
instructions: Combine diced tomatoes, grated onion, kefalograviera cheese, garlic, parsley, and dill in a bowl.
Add beaten egg and mix well.
Add flour and mix until just combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Heat about 1/2-inch of vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the tomato mixture into the oil and flatten slightly.
Fry the keftedes for about 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.

title: Stifado (Beef Stew with Onions and Garlic)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add beef and cook until browned on all sides.
Remove the beef from the saucepan and set aside.
Add more olive oil if necessary, then add the sliced onions and cook until they are soft and caramelized.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add beef broth, tomato paste, red wine, cinnamon, and allspice to the saucepan.
Return the beef to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for about 1 1/2 hours, until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve warm.

title: Kleftiko (Lamb in a Clay Oven)
ingredients: 2 pounds lamb shoulder, boneless and skinless
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C).
Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe pot over medium heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned on all sides.
Add garlic, lamb broth, white wine, tomato paste, oregano, and thyme to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for about 2 1/2 hours, until the lamb is tender and falls apart easily.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, and serve warm.

title: Melomakarona (Christmas Cookies with Honey and Walnuts)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Combine flour, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, cloves, and nutmeg in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together honey, oil, and eggs.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until just combined.
Stir in chopped walnuts.
Drop tablespoon-sized balls of the dough onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for about 15-20 minutes, until golden brown.
Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet for a few minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Galaktoboureko (Semolina Custard Pie in a Phyllo Crust)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine semolina flour, milk, sugar, and melted butter in a saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in eggs and vanilla extract.
Brush a 9x13-inch baking dish with vegetable oil.
Layer the phyllo dough in the baking dish, brushing each layer with oil.
Pour the semolina custard into the phyllo-lined baking dish.
Top with additional phyllo dough and brush with oil.
Bake for about 35-40 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Greek Stifado (Beef Stew)
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the cinnamon, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, wine, tomato paste, sugar, and flour, and stir to combine.
Add the beef broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 2 hours.
Stir in the parsley and serve hot.

title: Melomakarona (Christmas Cookies)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, cloves, and orange zest.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the butter, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Stir in the walnuts.
Scoop the dough into balls and flatten slightly.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Allow to cool completely.
Drizzle with honey and olive oil, and sprinkle with powdered sugar.

title: Grilled Octopus (Kalamari)
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the oil, garlic, oregano, thyme, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the octopus and toss to coat.
Grill the octopus for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Serve hot with lemon wedges.

title: Spanakopita (Spinach Pie)
ingredients: 1 package frozen spinach, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine the spinach, feta, Parmesan, dill, scallions, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the pastry to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Spread the spinach mixture over the pastry, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the pastry with oil and bake for 35-40 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Loukoumades (Deep-Fried Dough Balls)
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, yeast, and salt.
Add the warm water and melted butter, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
Fry the dough balls in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the loukoumades on paper towels.
Dip the loukoumades in the honey and then in the powdered sugar, and sprinkle with walnuts if desired.

title: Moussaka
ingredients: 2 medium eggplants, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
1 pound ground lamb or beef, browned
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Bake eggplant slices until tender.
Cook ground lamb or beef with onion and garlic.
Combine tomato puree and cooked meat mixture.
Layer eggplant, meat mixture, and bechamel sauce in a baking dish.
Top with kefalograviera cheese and bake until golden brown.

title: Spanakopita
ingredients: 1 package frozen spinach, thawed and drained
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine spinach, feta cheese, kefalograviera cheese, onion, and garlic.
Add beaten egg and mix well.
Season with dill, salt, and black pepper.
Wrap filling in phyllo dough and bake until golden brown.

title: Galaktoboureko
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine milk, sugar, and cornstarch in a saucepan.
Cook until thickened and remove from heat.
Add melted butter and vanilla extract to the custard.
Wrap custard in phyllo dough and bake until golden brown.

title: Loukoumades
ingredients: Chopped walnuts or cinnamon, for garnish
instructions: Combine flour, sugar, yeast, and salt in a bowl.
Add lukewarm water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes and let rise for 1 hour.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan and fry dough balls until golden brown.
Drain loukoumades on paper towels and serve with honey.

title: Tiropita
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine feta cheese, kefalograviera cheese, parsley, and dill.
Add beaten egg and mix well.
Wrap filling in phyllo dough and bake until golden brown.

title: Greek Stifado
ingredients: 2 lbs beef or veal, cut into bite-sized pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until caramelized, about 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the wine, broth, tomato paste, cinnamon, allspice, cumin, paprika, and cayenne pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Spanakopita
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine the spinach, feta, Parmesan, scallions, dill, garlic, salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Unroll the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Brush the edges of each piece with oil.
Place a spoonful of the spinach mixture onto the center of each piece.
Fold the phyllo into a triangle and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops with oil and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Gyro Meat
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb or beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the parsley, dill, salt, pepper, paprika, and cayenne pepper.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.

title: Greek Salad
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the greens, tomatoes, cucumber, onion, and olives.
In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar and oil.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Top with feta cheese and season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Loukoumades
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Add the warm milk and eggs, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of dough into the oil and fry until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with honey or syrup.

title: Stifado
ingredients: 2 pounds beef or veal, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are dark golden brown, about 20-25 minutes.
Add the garlic, cinnamon, allspice, cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and pepper to the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the beef to the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the beef broth, vinegar, tomato paste, and sugar to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Stir in the parsley and dill. Serve hot over rice or noodles.

title: Moussaka
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Brush the eggplant slices with oil and season with salt. Grill or broil until they are golden brown.
In a large skillet, cook the ground meat over medium heat, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
In a separate saucepan, combine the tomato puree, oregano, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer.

In a 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of eggplant slices. Top with a layer of the meat mixture, followed by a layer of the tomato sauce. Repeat this process until all the ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of eggplant on top.
Spread the bechamel sauce over the top layer of eggplant and sprinkle with kefalograviera and parmesan cheese. Bake until the cheese is golden brown and the moussaka is hot and bubbly.

title: Bechamel Sauce
instructions: Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Slowly add the milk, whisking constantly to prevent lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer until it thickens.
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the kefalograviera and parmesan cheese until melted. Season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper.

title: Kleftiko
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C).
Rub the lamb leg with oil and season with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, cook the sliced onion over medium heat until it is softened.
Add the garlic, white wine, lamb broth, lemon juice, rosemary, and thyme to the pot. Bring to a boil.
Place the lamb leg in the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until the lamb is tender and falls off the bone.

title: Galaktoboureko
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine the milk, sugar, flour, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves. Whisk until smooth.
Add the melted butter to the bowl and whisk until combined.
Pour the custard mixture into a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Layer the phyllo dough on top of the custard, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Bake the galaktoboureko for 45-50 minutes, or until the phyllo is golden brown and the custard is set.
Drizzle the honey syrup over the top of the galaktoboureko and serve warm.

title: Moussaka
ingredients: 1 pound eggplant, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Bake eggplant slices for 20 minutes, until tender.
In a pan, cook lamb, onion, and garlic until lamb is browned.
Add tomato puree and cook for 5 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, heat bechamel sauce over low heat.
In a baking dish, create a layer of eggplant, followed by a layer of lamb mixture, and then a layer of bechamel sauce.
Repeat the layers two more times, finishing with a layer of bechamel sauce.
Top with kefalograviera cheese and bake for 25 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Stifado
ingredients: 1 pound beef or veal, cut into small pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Cook beef and onions until beef is browned.
Add garlic, beef broth, red wine, tomato paste, allspice, cinnamon, and cumin.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Galaktoboureko
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a saucepan, combine milk, semolina flour, sugar, and melted butter.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in eggs and vanilla extract.
In a baking dish, create a layer of phyllo dough, brushing with melted butter.
Pour in milk mixture and top with another layer of phyllo dough.
Brush with melted butter and bake for 35 minutes, until golden brown.
Drizzle with honey syrup and sprinkle with walnuts.

title: Kleftiko
instructions: Preheat oven to 275°F (135°C).
Rub lamb with garlic and olive oil.
Place lamb in a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot.
Add white wine, beef broth, oregano, and cumin.
Cover and braise for 2-1/2 hours, until lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Tiropita
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, combine feta cheese, kefalograviera cheese, flour, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, eggs, and melted butter.
Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out dough and place in a baking dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Moussaka
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Bake eggplant slices until tender.
Cook ground beef with onion and garlic until browned.
Combine tomato puree, cooked beef mixture, and oregano.
Layer eggplant, meat mixture, and bechamel sauce in a baking dish.
Top with kefalograviera cheese and bake until golden brown.

title: Tiropita
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Layer filo dough and brush with butter.
Mix feta, kefalograviera cheese, parsley, eggs, and salt.
Place cheese mixture in the center of filo dough and fold.
Bake until golden brown and crispy.

title: Spanakopita
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Layer filo dough and brush with butter.
Mix spinach, feta cheese, kefalograviera cheese, eggs, salt, and pepper.
Place spinach mixture in the center of filo dough and fold.
Bake until golden brown and crispy.

title: Gigantes
ingredients: 1 cup giant lima beans, soaked overnight
instructions: Combine lima beans, pork, onion, garlic, tomato puree, beef broth, and oregano in a large pot.
Bring to a boil and simmer until lima beans are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Kleftiko
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C).
Season lamb with salt and pepper.
Sear lamb in olive oil until browned.
Combine onion, garlic, and oregano.
Place lamb in a Dutch oven and top with onion mixture.
Bake until lamb is tender and falls apart.

title: Tiropita (Cheese Pie)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine flour and salt in a bowl. Add the melted butter and mix until crumbly.
Add the cheeses, dill, and scallions to the bowl. Mix well.
Add the beaten eggs and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough and place it in a greased pie dish.
Bake for 45-50 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Spanakorizo (Spinach and Rice)
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the rice and water to the saucepan. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the rice is cooked.
Add the spinach and cheese to the saucepan. Mix well.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Kleftiko (Braised Lamb)
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb and brown on all sides.
Add the garlic, onion, carrots, and celery to the pot. Sauté for 5 minutes.
Add the wine and broth to the pot. Bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Braise for 2 1/2 to 3 hours or until the lamb is tender.
Season with oregano and thyme to taste.

title: Galaktoboureko (Custard Pie)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine flour and sugar in a bowl. Add the melted butter and mix until crumbly.
Add the beaten eggs and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough and place it in a greased pie dish.
Combine the milk, vanilla extract, and cinnamon in a bowl. Mix well.
Add the mixture to the pie dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Melomakarona (Christmas Cookies)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Combine flour, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl. Mix well.
Add the softened butter and mix until crumbly.
Add the eggs and mix until a dough forms.
Add the cinnamon, cloves, and walnuts to the dough. Mix well.
Shape the dough into small balls and flatten slightly.
Bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Tomato Keftedes (Tomato Fritters)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chopped tomatoes, flour, Parmesan cheese, parsley, garlic, egg, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties.
Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the keftedes for about 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Drain the keftedes on paper towels and serve hot.

title: Moussaka (Eggplant and Ground Beef Casserole)
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
1 cup bechamel sauce (see below for recipe)
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Brush eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Grill or broil until golden brown.
In a large pan, cook the onion and garlic until softened. Add the ground beef and cook until browned.
Add the tomato puree to the pan and stir to combine.

In a large baking dish, create a layer of eggplant slices. Top with a layer of the meat sauce and a layer of bechamel sauce. Repeat until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of bechamel sauce on top.
Sprinkle the kefalograviera cheese on top and bake for 30-40 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Greek Salad (Horiatiki Salata)
ingredients: 4 cups mixed greens (such as tomato, cucumber, red onion, bell pepper)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and Kalamata olives.
In a small bowl, whisk together the red wine vinegar and olive oil.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Top the salad with crumbled feta cheese and serve.

title: Galaktoboureko (Semolina Custard Pie)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together the semolina flour, milk, sugar, and salt. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens.
Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla extract and melted butter.
In a separate bowl, combine the chopped phyllo dough and walnuts (if using).
Butter a 9x13-inch baking dish and arrange a layer of the phyllo dough mixture on the bottom.
Pour the semolina custard mixture over the phyllo dough and top with another layer of phyllo dough.
Bake for 30-40 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Loukoumades (Greek Doughnuts)
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the lukewarm milk, olive oil, and eggs to the bowl and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat about 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Using a spoon, drop the batter into the oil and fry until golden brown.
Drain the loukoumades on paper towels and drizzle with honey. Sprinkle with chopped walnuts (if using).

title: Moussaka
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, sliced into 1/2-inch thick rounds
1 pound ground lamb, beef, or a combination of the two
1 cup bechamel sauce (see below for recipe)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the eggplant slices and cook until golden brown on both sides, about 3-4 minutes per side.
In a separate skillet, cook the ground meat over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the tomato puree and bring the mixture to a simmer.
In a large baking dish, create a layer of eggplant slices, followed by a layer of the meat mixture, and finally a layer of bechamel sauce.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of bechamel sauce on top.
Sprinkle the kefalograviera cheese over the top layer of bechamel sauce.
Bake the moussaka in the preheated oven for 30-40 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.

title: Stifado
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set it aside.
Add the chopped onions to the pot and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the beef broth, red wine, tomato paste, flour, cinnamon, cumin, and cayenne pepper.
Return the browned beef to the pot and bring the stew to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, olives, feta cheese, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the red wine vinegar and olive oil.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Season the salad with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Bechamel Sauce
instructions: Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, stirring constantly.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Galaktoboureko
ingredients: 1 cup semolina custard (see below for recipe)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cut the phyllo dough into 4 equal pieces.
Place a piece of phyllo dough on a flat surface and brush it with the melted butter.
Place a spoonful of the semolina custard in the center of the phyllo dough.
Sprinkle the chopped walnuts and granulated sugar over the custard.
Fold the phyllo dough over the filling to form a triangle or a square shape.
Brush the edges of the phyllo dough with the beaten egg.
Repeat with the remaining phyllo dough and filling.
Bake the galaktoboureko in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the phyllo is golden brown.

title: Greek Stifado
ingredients: 1 pound beef or veal, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are softened and caramelized, about 20-25 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the wine, broth, tomato paste, paprika, oregano, cinnamon, allspice, cayenne pepper, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the meat is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme.

title: Spanakopita
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine the spinach, feta, kefalograviera, scallions, garlic, salt, pepper, and nutmeg. Mix well.
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with the olive oil and the beaten egg.
Spoon the spinach mixture onto the phyllo dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the phyllo dough over the filling, then brush the top with the remaining olive oil.
Bake the spanakopita for 35-40 minutes, or until the phyllo is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.

title: Grilled Octopus
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, vinegar, and oregano.
Add the octopus to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Season the octopus with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the octopus for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it is tender and slightly charred.
Serve the grilled octopus hot, with lemon wedges on the side.

title: Tiropita
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine the feta, kefalograviera, scallions, salt, pepper, and nutmeg. Mix well.
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with the olive oil and the beaten egg.
Spoon the cheese mixture onto the phyllo dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the phyllo dough over the filling, then brush the top with the remaining olive oil.
Bake the tiropita for 25-30 minutes, or until the phyllo is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.

title: Galaktoboureko
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large saucepan, combine the milk, semolina flour, sugar, melted butter, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, and cloves. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the chopped walnuts.
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with the beaten egg.
Spoon the semolina mixture onto the phyllo dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the phyllo dough over the filling, then brush the top with the remaining egg.
Bake the galaktoboureko for 35-40 minutes, or until the phyllo is golden brown and the filling is hot and bubbly.

title: Greek Stifado (Beef Stew in a Sweet and Spicy Sauce)
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the broth, wine, tomato paste, cinnamon, allspice, cayenne pepper, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven. Braise the stew for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the parsley and serve the stew hot.

title: Spanakopita (Spinach and Feta Pie)
ingredients: 1 package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine the spinach, feta, Parmesan, flour, salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
In a small bowl, whisk together the melted butter and eggs.
Add the egg mixture to the spinach mixture and stir to combine.
Unfold the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface and roll it out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the spinach mixture to one half of the pastry and brush the edges with the beaten egg.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Bake the pie for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.

title: Greek Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the greens, tomatoes, cucumber, olives, feta, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the vinegar and oil.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Season the salad with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Tiropita (Cheese Pie)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine the feta, Parmesan, flour, salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
In a small bowl, whisk together the melted butter and eggs.
Add the egg mixture to the cheese mixture and stir to combine.
Unfold the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface and roll it out to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the cheese mixture to one half of the pastry and brush the edges with the beaten egg.
Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling and press the edges to seal.
Bake the pie for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.

title: Grilled Octopus with Lemon and Herbs
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, oil, garlic, oregano, and parsley.
Add the octopus to the bowl and toss to coat.
Season the octopus with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the octopus for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it is charred and cooked through.
Serve the octopus hot.

title: Grilled Octopus with Oregano and Lemon
ingredients: 2 large octopuses, cleaned and patted dry
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Season the octopuses with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Grill the octopuses for 2-3 minutes per side, until tender.
Brush with olive oil and serve with lemon wedges.
Garnish with parsley, if desired.

title: Stifado (Beef Stew with Onions and Garlic)
ingredients: 1 kg beef, cut into small pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until caramelized.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef and cook until browned.
Add wine, broth, tomato paste, and cinnamon.
Simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Melomakarona (Christmas Cookies)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Mix flour, sugar, and baking powder.
Add oil, eggs, cinnamon, walnuts, and orange zest.
Mix until a dough forms.
Shape into small balls and flatten slightly.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Dip in orange juice and syrup.

title: Giouvetsi (Lamb and Eggplant Stew)
ingredients: 1 kg lamb, cut into small pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until caramelized.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add lamb and cook until browned.
Add eggplant and cook until tender.
Add tomato puree, broth, and cinnamon.
Simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Tiropita (Cheese Pie)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix flour and cheese.
Add eggs, parsley, scallions, salt, and pepper.
Mix until a dough forms.
Roll out dough and fill with cheese mixture.
Fold dough over and seal edges.
Brush with olive oil and bake for 30-40 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Stifado
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add the onions and cook until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the broth, tomato paste, vinegar, cumin, cinnamon, allspice, cloves, and cayenne pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the potatoes and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven. Braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat and potatoes are tender.

title: Bougatsa
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the warm milk and yeast. Let sit for 5 minutes, or until foamy.
Add the sugar, eggs, flour, and salt to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes, or until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Preheat the oven to 375°F.
Punch down the dough and divide into 6 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly.
Place a piece of dough in a greased 9-inch pie plate. Top with semolina flour, cheese, and parsley. Repeat with the remaining dough pieces.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Melomakarona
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, and salt.
Add the softened butter and mix until a dough forms.
Beat in the eggs, one at a time, until well combined.
Stir in the chopped walnuts.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut into desired shapes and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Allow the cookies to cool completely on a wire rack.
Dip the tops of the cookies in the honey, then roll in the powdered sugar to coat.

title: Kleftiko
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300°F.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onions and cook until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the wine, broth, tomato paste, honey, mustard, oregano, thyme, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven. Braise for 3 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and falls apart easily.

title: Loukoumades
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the warm milk and yeast. Let sit for 5 minutes, or until foamy.
Add the sugar, eggs, melted butter, and flour to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes, or until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F.
Punch down the dough and divide into 12 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball.
Fry the dough balls in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the loukoumades on paper towels and serve with honey and powdered sugar.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and mix until the chicken is well coated with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat the grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and cook until browned and cooked through, about 6-8 minutes.
In a large saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons of ghee or oil over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are lightly browned, about 8-10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, chicken broth, and heavy cream.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cooked chicken to the sauce and stir to coat.
Simmer the chicken in the sauce for 5-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Garnish with fresh cilantro leaves and serve over basmati rice.

title: Sri Lankan Hoppers
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, water, salt, sugar, and yeast.
Mix the dough until it is smooth and elastic, about 5-7 minutes.
Knead the dough for 2-3 minutes and cover it with a damp cloth.
Let the dough rest in a warm place for 1-2 hours, or until it has doubled in size.
Heat a non-stick pan or a hoppers pan over medium heat.
Brush the pan with a small amount of ghee or oil.
Pour a small amount of the dough into the pan and tilt the pan to evenly coat the bottom.
Cook the hopper for 1-2 minutes, or until the edges start to curl.
Loosen the hopper with a spatula and flip it over.
Cook the other side for 1 minute, or until it is lightly browned.
Serve the hoppers hot with your favorite fillings.

title: Bengali-Style Lentil Curry
ingredients: 1 cup split red lentils, rinsed and drained
2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, for garnish
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the lentils and water.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
In a large pan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is lightly browned, about 8-10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, turmeric, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked lentils to the pan and stir to coat with the spice mixture.
Simmer the curry for 5-10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over rice or with roti.

title: Nepali Gorkhali Lamb
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless lamb shoulder or neck, cut into 2-inch pieces
2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, for garnish
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of ghee or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are lightly browned, about 8-10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, cinnamon, cardamom, and black pepper.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, broth, and tomato paste to the pan.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 1 1/2 to 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over rice or with roti.

title: Indian-Style Vegetable Biryani
ingredients: 1 cup basmati rice, rinsed and drained
1 cup mixed vegetables (such as peas, corn, and carrots)
2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, for garnish
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is lightly browned, about 8-10 minutes.
Add the grated carrot, cauliflower, and potato, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the mixed vegetables, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cardamom, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the basmati rice to the pan and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Add the water to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pan with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, ghee or oil, garam masala, cumin, smoked paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper. Add the chicken and mix to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.

Preheat the grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off. Grill the chicken until it is cooked through, about 6-8 minutes per side. Transfer the chicken to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
In a large saucepan, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are lightly browned and caramelized, about 8-10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.

Stir in the diced tomatoes, chicken broth, heavy cream, and tomato puree. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together, about 10-15 minutes.
Add the cooked chicken to the sauce and simmer, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is coated in the sauce, about 5-7 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve over basmati rice.

title: Sag Aloo (Spinach and Potato Curry)
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the diced potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned, about 3-5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the ground cumin, coriander, turmeric, red chili powder, garam masala, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the fresh spinach leaves and cook, stirring occasionally, until they have wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for 1 minute.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the ghee or oil and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked potato mixture to the saucepan with the ghee or oil and stir to combine. Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro.

title: Palak Paneer (Spinach and Cheese Curry)
ingredients: 1 cup paneer (Indian cheese), cut into small cubes
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned, about 3-5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the ground cumin, coriander, turmeric, red chili powder, garam masala, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the fresh spinach leaves and cook, stirring occasionally, until they have wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the paneer cubes to the sauce and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are coated in the sauce, about 2-3 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed. Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro.

title: Biryani (Mixed Rice Dish)
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, rinsed and drained
1 cup mixed vegetables (such as carrots, peas, and corn)
1 cup cooked chicken or lamb, diced
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned, about 3-5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the ground cumin, coriander, turmeric, red chili powder, garam masala, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender, about 3-5 minutes.
Add the cooked chicken or lamb and stir to combine.
Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the ghee or oil and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the saucepan with the ghee or oil and stir to combine. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the biryani hot, garnished with fresh cilantro.

title: Dosas (Fermented Rice and Lentil Crepes)
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (such as carrots, peas, and corn)
instructions: Heat a non-stick skillet or dosa pan over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup of the dosa batter onto the skillet and spread it evenly to form a thin layer.
Cook the dosa for 1-2 minutes, until the edges start to curl and the surface is dry.
Loosen the dosa with a spatula and flip it over. Cook for another 1-2 minutes, until the other side is lightly browned.
Repeat with the remaining batter, until all the dosas are cooked.
Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned, about 3-5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the ground cumin, coriander, turmeric, red chili powder, garam masala, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender, about 3-5 minutes.
Serve the dosas hot with the vegetable mixture and garnish with fresh cilantro.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, ghee or oil, garam masala, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and black pepper. Add the chicken and mix until coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.

Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off. Grill the chicken until browned and cooked through, about 6-8 minutes per side. Transfer the chicken to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
In the same grill or in a large skillet, cook the sliced onions over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until they are lightly browned and caramelized, about 8-10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and chicken broth. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the heavy cream and cook for 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Add the cooked chicken to the sauce and stir to coat. Simmer for 2-3 minutes, until the chicken is fully coated.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed. Garnish with cilantro leaves and serve over basmati rice.

title: Sag Aloo (Spinach with Potatoes)
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the diced potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are golden brown and tender, about 8-10 minutes.
Add the chopped onion to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the fresh spinach leaves to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until they have wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the lemon juice to the skillet and stir to combine. Cook for 1 minute.
Serve the sag aloo hot, garnished with chopped cilantro leaves.

title: Chana Masala (Chickpea Curry)
ingredients: 1 can (14 oz) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas to the skillet and stir to combine. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, water, and tomato paste. Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together, about 20-25 minutes.
Serve the chana masala hot, garnished with chopped cilantro leaves.

title: Biryani (Mixed Rice with Meat or Vegetables)
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, rinsed and drained
1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces (optional)
1 cup mixed vegetables (such as carrots, peas, and cauliflower)
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken (if using) to the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, until it is browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the mixed vegetables to the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the basmati rice to the saucepan and stir to combine. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the water to the saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is cooked and fluffy.
Serve the biryani hot, garnished with chopped cilantro leaves.

title: Gajar Ka Halwa (Carrot Pudding)
ingredients: Chopped nuts or dried fruit, for garnish
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the grated ginger and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the grated carrots to the saucepan and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are tender and lightly browned, about 15-20 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the milk, water, cornstarch, sugar, cardamom, cinnamon, nutmeg, and salt. Add the mixture to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring constantly, until it has thickened and the flavors have melded together, about 5-7 minutes.
Serve the gajar ka halwa hot, garnished with chopped nuts or dried fruit.

title: Chana Masala
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until they are browned.
Add garlic and ginger paste, and cook for 1 minute.
Add cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over basmati rice.

title: Sri Lankan Fish Ambulthiyal
ingredients: 1 pound fish fillets (such as mackerel or sardines)
instructions: Combine tamarind paste and water in a bowl.
Add fish tamarind sauce, ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander, and turmeric.
Marinate the fish fillets in the mixture for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add green chilies and cook for 1 minute.
Add the marinated fish fillets and cook until they are cooked through.
Season with salt and serve garnished with chopped cilantro.

title: Nepali Dal Bhat
ingredients: 2 cups split red lentils, rinsed and drained
2 cups basmati rice, rinsed and drained
instructions: Combine lentils and water in a pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer until the lentils are cooked.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until they are browned.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add tomato and cook until it is soft.
Add cumin, coriander, and turmeric, and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the dal over basmati rice.

title: Pakistani Karahi
ingredients: 1 pound beef or lamb, cut into small pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add onions and cook until they are browned.
Add garlic and ginger paste, and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef or lamb and cook until it is browned.
Add tomatoes, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper and serve garnished with chopped cilantro.

title: Indian Samosas
ingredients: Filling ingredients: 1 cup cooked chickpeas, 1 cup cooked potatoes, 1/2 cup chopped cilantro, 1/4 cup lemon juice, 1/4 cup ghee or oil, Salt, to taste
instructions: Combine flour and salt in a bowl.
Add ghee or oil and mix until the dough comes together.
Add lukewarm water and knead the dough for 5 minutes.
Roll out the dough and cut into circles.
Place a tablespoon of filling in the center of each circle and fold the dough to form a triangle.
Fry the samosas until they are golden brown and serve hot.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Marinate the chicken in yogurt mixture for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Remove the chicken from marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Grill the chicken until it is cooked through, about 6-8 minutes per side.
In a large saucepan, heat oil over medium heat. Add cumin and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
