instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, cook pancetta over medium heat until crispy.
In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, Parmesan cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add cooked spaghetti to the bowl and toss with egg mixture.
Add pancetta to the bowl and toss until well combined.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Season chicken breasts with salt, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning.
Dredge chicken breasts in flour, then dip in beaten eggs, and finally coat in breadcrumbs.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet and fry chicken breasts until golden brown.
Transfer fried chicken breasts to a baking dish and spoon marinara sauce over the top.
Sprinkle Parmesan and mozzarella cheese over the top of the chicken.
Bake in preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Risotto alla Milanese
ingredients: Salt and white pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat chicken broth in a separate pot and keep warm.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic until softened.
Add Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add white wine and cook until absorbed.
Add warmed chicken broth, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each portion to be absorbed before adding the next.
After 20-25 minutes of cooking, the rice should be tender and creamy.
Remove from heat and stir in butter and Parmesan cheese.
Season with salt and white pepper to taste.

title: Pollo alla Cacciatora
ingredients: 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add mushrooms to the skillet and cook until tender.
Add diced tomatoes, white wine, basil, and oregano to the skillet.
Return chicken to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Tiramisù
instructions: Dip ladyfingers in coffee for about 3-5 seconds on each side.
In a large bowl, combine mascarpone cheese, granulated sugar, egg yolks, and vanilla extract.
Beat heavy cream until stiff peaks form and fold into mascarpone mixture.
To assemble tiramisù, start with a layer of ladyfingers, then a layer of mascarpone mixture, and repeat.
Dust top of tiramisù with cocoa powder.
Refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, cook pancetta over medium heat until crispy.
In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, Parmesan cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
When spaghetti is done, reserve 1 cup of pasta water and then drain the spaghetti.
Add cooked spaghetti to the bowl with egg mixture and toss to combine.
Add reserved pasta water to the bowl in small increments and continue to toss until the spaghetti is well coated with the egg mixture.
Add cooked pancetta to the bowl and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Prepare breading station: In one shallow dish, mix together flour, salt, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning.
In another shallow dish, place breadcrumbs.
In a third shallow dish, beat eggs.
Dredge each chicken breast in flour mixture, then eggs, and finally breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry breaded chicken breasts until golden brown and cooked through.
Transfer fried chicken breasts to a baking dish.
Spoon marinara sauce over each chicken breast.
Sprinkle shredded mozzarella cheese over the sauce.
Bake in preheated oven at 400°F (200°C) for 15-20 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Risotto alla Milanese
ingredients: 2 oz saffron threads, soaked in 2 tbsp hot water
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat chicken broth in a separate pot and keep warm.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add white wine and cook until absorbed, stirring constantly.
Add 1 cup of warmed chicken broth to the rice and cook, stirring constantly, until absorbed.
Repeat step 7 until all chicken broth is used, stirring constantly and adding broth in 1 cup increments.
Stir in saffron and its liquid.
Remove skillet from heat and stir in Parmesan cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Pollo alla Cacciatora
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add chopped onion to the skillet and cook until translucent.
Add garlic, mushrooms, and red bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add crushed tomatoes, basil, oregano, salt, and black pepper to the skillet.
Stir to combine.
Return chicken to the skillet and cook until heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.

title: Tiramisù
instructions: In a large bowl, combine mascarpone cheese, granulated sugar, egg yolks, and vanilla extract.
Whisk until smooth.
In a separate bowl, whip heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold whipped cream into mascarpone mixture until well combined.
Dip each ladyfinger into coffee for about 3-5 seconds on each side.
They should be soft and pliable but not too wet.
In a large serving dish, create a layer of ladyfingers.
Spread half of the mascarpone mixture over the ladyfingers.
Repeat the layers, starting with ladyfingers and then mascarpone mixture.
Dust the top of the tiramisù with cocoa powder.
Refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight before serving.

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a large pot, heat oil over medium heat. Add onion, garlic, and carrot, and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add crushed tomatoes, red wine, tomato paste, basil, and oregano. Season with salt and pepper.
Simmer the sauce for 20-30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the sauce over cooked spaghetti and top with Parmesan cheese.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper.
In a shallow dish, mix together flour, salt, and pepper.
In another shallow dish, beat eggs.
In a third shallow dish, mix together breadcrumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Dredge chicken breasts in flour, then eggs, and finally breadcrumbs.
Fry the breaded chicken breasts in olive oil until golden brown.
Transfer the fried chicken to a baking dish and spoon marinara sauce over the top.
Top with shredded mozzarella cheese and bake in the oven until melted and bubbly.

title: Bruschetta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Slice baguette into 1-inch pieces and toast until lightly browned.
In a bowl, mix together diced tomatoes, olive oil, garlic, and basil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Rub garlic on toasted bread and spoon tomato mixture over the top.
Top with Parmesan cheese and drizzle with balsamic vinegar.

title: Risotto alla Milanese
ingredients: 2 tablespoons saffron threads, soaked in 2 tablespoons hot water
instructions: Heat chicken broth in a separate pot and keep warm.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add white wine and cook until absorbed.
Add 1 cup of warmed chicken broth to the rice and stir constantly until absorbed.
Repeat the process, adding broth in 1-cup increments, until the rice is cooked and creamy.
Stir in saffron and Parmesan cheese. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Tiramisu
instructions: Dip ladyfingers in coffee for 3-5 seconds on each side.
In a large bowl, mix together mascarpone cheese, granulated sugar, and egg yolks.
In a separate bowl, whip heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold whipped cream into mascarpone mixture.
To assemble, start with a layer of ladyfingers in a large serving dish.
Spread a layer of mascarpone mixture over the ladyfingers.
Repeat the process, ending with a layer of mascarpone mixture on top.
Dust with cocoa powder and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, cook pancetta over medium heat until crispy.
In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, Parmesan cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add cooked spaghetti to the bowl and toss with egg mixture.
Add pancetta to the bowl and toss everything together.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped parsley.

title: Bruschetta
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Slice baguette into 1-inch thick slices and toast until lightly browned.
In a large bowl, combine diced tomatoes, olive oil, garlic, basil, and balsamic vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Rub toasted baguette slices with garlic and spoon tomato mixture over each slice.
Serve immediately.

title: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Season chicken breasts with salt, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning.
Dredge chicken breasts in flour, then in breadcrumbs.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook chicken breasts until golden brown.
Transfer chicken breasts to a baking dish and spoon marinara sauce over each breast.
Top each breast with mozzarella cheese and bake until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve hot.

title: Tiramisu
instructions: Dip ladyfingers in coffee for about 3-5 seconds on each side.
In a large bowl, combine mascarpone cheese, heavy cream, granulated sugar, and vanilla extract.
In a large serving dish, create a layer of ladyfingers.
Spread half of the mascarpone mixture over the ladyfingers.
Repeat the layers, ending with a layer of mascarpone mixture.
Dust with cocoa powder and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
Serve chilled.

title: Risotto alla Milanese
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable or chicken broth, warmed
instructions: Heat broth in a separate pot and keep warm.
In a large saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add white wine and cook until absorbed.
Add warmed broth to the rice, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each portion to be absorbed before adding the next.
Stir in Parmesan cheese and saffron-infused broth.
Remove from heat and stir in butter.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Tagliatelle al Ragù di Carne
instructions: Cook the tagliatelle pasta in boiling salted water until al dente.
In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, carrot, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are soft.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon.
Add the tomatoes, wine, broth, tomato paste, basil, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Simmer the ragù for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Serve the ragù over the cooked tagliatelle pasta and top with Parmesan cheese.

title: Prosciutto e Melone
ingredients: 4 ripe melons (such as cantaloupe or honeydew)
instructions: Cut the melons into wedges or balls.
Wrap each melon wedge or ball with a slice of prosciutto.
Serve immediately and garnish with fresh mint leaves.

title: Tortellini en Brodo
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add the olive oil, onion, and garlic, and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the tortellini and cook until they float to the surface.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley.

title: Carpaccio di Manzo
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced raw beef (such as wagyu or ribeye)
instructions: Arrange the beef slices on a plate or platter.
Drizzle the olive oil over the beef.
Sprinkle the lemon juice, capers, and parsley over the beef.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately.

title: Pappardelle al Cinghiale
ingredients: 1 pound wild boar ragù (or substitute with ground pork)
instructions: Cook the pappardelle pasta in boiling salted water until al dente.
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and garlic, and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the wild boar ragù and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon.
Add the wine, broth, tomato paste, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Simmer the ragù for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Serve the ragù over the cooked pappardelle pasta and top with Parmesan cheese.

title: Tajarin con Tartufo
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Make the pasta dough by combining eggs, flour, and a pinch of salt. Knead for 10 minutes.
Rest the dough for 30 minutes, then roll out to a thin sheet.
Cut into thin strips and cook in boiling salted water.
Drain and toss with butter, garlic, Parmesan, and truffle.

title: Agnolotti del Plin
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Make the pasta dough by combining flour, eggs, and a pinch of salt. Knead for 10 minutes.
Rest the dough for 30 minutes, then roll out to a thin sheet.
Cut into squares and fill with a mixture of Parmesan, parsley, and prosciutto.
Seal the edges and cook in boiling salted water.

title: Bollito Misto
ingredients: 1 pound beef brisket, cut into large chunks
1 pound pork belly, cut into large chunks
1 pound veal shanks, cut into large chunks
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine beef, pork, tongue, and veal in a large pot.
Add garlic, wine, broth, carrots, and celery. Season with salt and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours.
Serve with a side of sauerkraut and mostarda.

title: Pappardelle al Cinghiale
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Cook the pappardelle in boiling salted water until al dente.
Combine with wild boar ragù and Parmesan cheese.
Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.

title: Castagnaccio
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine chestnut flour, water, and olive oil in a bowl.
Mix until a smooth batter forms.
Pour into a greased baking dish and top with Parmesan cheese.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 35-40 minutes.

title: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling salted water until al dente.
In a large skillet, cook pancetta over medium heat until crispy.
In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs and Parmesan cheese.
Add cooked spaghetti to the bowl and toss with egg mixture.
Combine cooked pancetta with the spaghetti and egg mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve.

title: Pollo alla Cacciatora
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
Add onions and garlic to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add mushrooms and cook until browned.
Add wine and broth to the skillet, scraping up browned bits.
Return chicken to the skillet and stir in thyme.
Simmer until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened.

title: Risotto alla Milanese
instructions: Heat broth in a separate pot and keep warm.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat.
Add Arborio rice and cook until lightly toasted.
Add wine and cook until absorbed.
Add warmed broth to the rice, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring constantly.
Continue until rice is cooked and creamy.
Stir in Parmesan cheese and season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve.

title: Fettuccine al Pesto
instructions: Cook fettuccine in boiling salted water until al dente.
In a food processor, combine basil, pine nuts, and garlic.
Process until well combined and slightly smooth.
Add Parmesan cheese and process until well combined.
With processor running, slowly add olive oil through the top.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Combine cooked fettuccine with pesto sauce and toss to coat.

title: Torta di Ricotta e Visciole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a large bowl, whisk together ricotta cheese, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add softened butter to the ricotta mixture and whisk until well combined.
Add flour mixture to the ricotta mixture and stir until just combined.
Fold in chopped visciole cherries.
Pour batter into a greased 9-inch springform pan.
Bake until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.

title: Bigoli in Salsa
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the bigoli.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Drain the cooked bigoli and add it to the skillet, tossing to coat with the salsa.
Serve immediately.

title: Fritto Misto
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, paprika, and garlic powder.
Pour the buttermilk into a separate shallow dish.
Dip each piece of zucchini, eggplant, shrimp, and calamari into the buttermilk, then roll in the flour mixture to coat.
Heat about 1/2-inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the coated vegetables and seafood in batches until golden brown.
Drain the fritto misto on paper towels and serve hot.

title: Risotto alla Pescatora
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the shrimp, mussels, and clams to the skillet and cook until the seafood is lightly browned.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until the liquid is almost completely evaporated.
Add 1 cup of the warmed fish broth to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Add the Arborio rice to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the remaining fish broth to the skillet, 1 cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each portion to be absorbed before adding the next.
Serve the risotto hot, topped with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Pollo alla Cacciatora
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the tomatoes, white wine, and chicken broth to the skillet and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is cooked through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, then serve hot.

title: Torta di Ricotta e Visciole
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Add the softened butter to the bowl and mix until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Beat in the eggs until the mixture is smooth.
Stir in the ricotta cheese until well combined.
Gently fold in the visciole.
Pour the batter into a greased and floured 9-inch (23cm) round cake pan.
Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean.

title: Orecchiette with Cime di Rapa and Sausage
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the orecchiette according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the sausage and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped cime di rapa and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Combine the cooked orecchiette and sausage mixture in a large serving bowl. Top with grated Pecorino cheese and season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Fritto Misto (Mixed Fried Vegetables)
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the buttermilk into a separate shallow dish.
Dip each vegetable slice into the buttermilk, coating completely, then roll in the flour mixture to coat.
Heat about 1/2-inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the coated vegetables in batches until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the fried vegetables on paper towels and serve hot.

title: Pollo alla Cacciatora (Hunter-Style Chicken)
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 cup mixed mushrooms (button, cremini, shiitake), sliced
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the white wine, chicken broth, tomato paste, dried basil, and dried oregano. Stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and cook until the sauce has thickened, about 10-15 minutes. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Panzerotti (Stuffed Fritters)
instructions: Combine the flour and salt in a large bowl. Add the lard or shortening and, using a pastry blender or your fingers, work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the warm water, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk.
Place a tablespoon or two of filling in the center of each disk. Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-circle and press the edges together to seal.
Heat about 1/2-inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the panzerotti until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.

title: Risotto con Asparagi e Prosciutto (Asparagus and Prosciutto Risotto)
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable or chicken broth, warmed
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Arborio rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the white wine and cook until absorbed, about 2 minutes.

Add 1 cup of warmed broth to the rice and cook, stirring constantly, until absorbed. Repeat this process, adding the broth in 1-cup increments, until the rice is cooked and creamy, about 20-25 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chopped prosciutto and cook until crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the trimmed asparagus to the skillet with the prosciutto and cook until tender, about 3-5 minutes.
Stir the cooked asparagus and prosciutto into the cooked risotto. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Serve immediately, topped with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Arancini
instructions: Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F.
Shape cooled risotto into small balls.
Insert a cube of mozzarella and a piece of ham into each ball.
Dip each ball in beaten egg and then roll in breadcrumbs.
Fry the arancini until golden brown and crispy.

title: Caponata
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Sauté the eggplant until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, and celery and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Add the tomatoes, capers, raisins, salt, and pepper. Cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in chopped parsley.

title: Cassata
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Mix flour, sugar, and baking powder in a bowl.
Add the softened butter and mix until a dough forms.
Beat the eggs and add the milk, vanilla extract, and candied fruit.
Combine the egg mixture with the dough and mix well.
Pour the batter into a greased and floured pan.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Panzanella
ingredients: 4 cups stale bread, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Toss the bread cubes with olive oil and toast in the oven until crispy.
Combine the toasted bread, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and mozzarella cheese in a bowl.
Drizzle the red wine vinegar over the salad and season with salt and pepper.

title: Sfincione
instructions: Combine the flour, salt, sugar, and yeast in a bowl.
Add the warm water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-10 minutes.
Roll out the dough into a circle and place on a greased baking sheet.
Spread the tomato sauce over the dough, leaving a 1-inch border.
Top with mozzarella cheese and bake in a preheated oven at 400°F for 15-20 minutes.
Garnish with basil and serve.

title: Spaghetti alle Vongole
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the clams and cook until they start to open, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced.
Stir in the parsley and season with salt and pepper.
Serve the spaghetti with the clam sauce and enjoy!

title: Pollo alla Cacciatora
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the white wine and chicken broth to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the tomato paste.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

title: Risotto alla Milanese
instructions: Heat the chicken broth in a separate pot and keep warm.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced.
Add 1/2 cup of the warmed broth to the rice and stir until absorbed.
Repeat the process, adding the broth in 1/2 cup increments, until the rice is cooked.
Stir in the butter and Parmesan cheese and season with salt and pepper.

title: Fritto Misto
ingredients: 1 cup calamari, cleaned and cut into rings
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, pepper, and paprika.
Add the buttermilk to the bowl and whisk until smooth.
Dip the zucchini, eggplant, shrimp, and calamari into the batter and coat evenly.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the battered vegetables and seafood until golden brown and crispy.
Drain the fried items on paper towels and serve hot.

title: Torta di Ricotta e Visciole
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together the ricotta cheese, eggs, granulated sugar, and flour.
Add the vanilla extract and whisk until smooth.
Gently fold in the visciole.
Pour the mixture into a 9-inch springform pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 40-50 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center is slightly jiggly.
Let cool completely before dusting with confectioners' sugar and chopped almonds.

title: Ribollita
ingredients: 2 cups leftover bread, torn into small pieces
1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
Salt and black pepper, to taste
Freshly grated Parmesan cheese, for serving
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the torn bread, cannellini beans, and vegetable broth to the pot.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Simmer the soup for 20-25 minutes or until the bread has broken down.
Serve hot, topped with freshly grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Pappardelle al Cinghiale
ingredients: 1 pound wild boar ragu, or substitute with ground pork
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the wild boar ragu and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned.
Add the red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, and thyme to the skillet.
Simmer the sauce for 10-15 minutes or until the flavors have melded together.
Toss the cooked pappardelle pasta with the wild boar sauce and serve hot.

title: Pollo alla Cacciatora
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned.
Add the garlic, bell peppers, crushed tomatoes, white wine, basil, and oregano to the skillet.
Simmer the sauce for 10-15 minutes or until the flavors have melded together.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.

title: Bistecca alla Fiorentina
ingredients: 4 steaks (1 1/2 pounds each), preferably T-bone or porterhouse
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Season the steaks with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped rosemary to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Sear the steaks on the grill for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Let the steaks rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

title: Cannoli Siciliani
ingredients: Chocolate chips or chopped pistachios, for garnish
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the lard or shortening to the bowl and mix until the dough comes together.
Add the eggs, vinegar, and mix until the dough is smooth.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch and cut out circles using a cookie cutter.
Fry the dough circles in hot oil until crispy and golden brown.
Let the shells cool completely before filling with sweetened ricotta cheese and garnishing with chocolate chips or chopped pistachios.

title: Tortellini en Brodo
ingredients: 1 pound fresh tortellini, homemade or store-bought
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a simmer in a large pot.
Add the olive oil, onion, and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the tortellini to the pot and cook according to the package instructions.
Season the broth with basil, salt, and pepper to taste.
Serve the tortellini hot in the broth, topped with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Tagliatelle al Ragù
ingredients: 12 ounces tagliatelle pasta, homemade or store-bought
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Cook the tagliatelle pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the ground beef to the skillet and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink.
Add the crushed tomatoes, beef broth, basil, and oregano to the skillet and stir to combine.
Simmer the ragù for 20-30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the tagliatelle hot with the ragù spooned over the top and grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Prosciutto e Funghi Risotto
ingredients: 4 cups vegetable or chicken broth, warmed
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the prosciutto to the skillet and cook until it is crispy.
Add the mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they are tender.
Add the Arborio rice to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until it is absorbed.
Add 1 cup of the warmed broth to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until it is absorbed.
Repeat the process of adding the broth, 1 cup at a time, until the rice is cooked and creamy.
Stir in the butter and serve the risotto hot, topped with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Lasagna Verde
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
2 cups bechamel sauce (see below for recipe)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cook the lasagna noodles in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, Parmesan cheese, egg, basil, oregano, salt, and pepper. Mix well to combine.
Spread a layer of the bechamel sauce in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the ricotta mixture over the noodles.
Top the ricotta mixture with half of the ragù and half of the mozzarella cheese.
Repeat the layers, starting with the noodles, then the bechamel sauce, the ricotta mixture, the ragù, and finally the mozzarella cheese.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Zuppa Toscana
ingredients: 1 pound kale, stems removed and discarded, leaves chopped
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the Italian sausage to the pot and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink.
Add the chopped kale to the pot and cook until it is tender.
Add the diced tomatoes, chicken broth, and thyme to the pot and stir to combine.
Simmer the soup for 20-30 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together.
Season the soup with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the soup hot, topped with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Tajarin with Truffle Sauce
ingredients: 1 pound fresh egg noodles, homemade or store-bought
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the egg noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the truffle oil and cook for an additional minute.
Pour in the heavy cream and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5-7 minutes until slightly thickened.
Season the sauce with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the cooked egg noodles with the truffle sauce and top with Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley, if desired.

title: Agnolotti del Plin
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: To make the pasta dough, combine the flour, eggs, and salt in a mixing bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch and cut into squares.
Place a tablespoon of the pork filling in the center of each square and fold the dough over to form a triangle.
Seal the edges with a fork and set aside.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the agnolotti for 3-5 minutes until they float to the surface.

title: Bollito Misto
ingredients: 1 pound beef brisket, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 pound beef shank, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 pound pork shoulder, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 pound veal shank, cut into 2-inch pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the beef, pork, veal, carrots, celery, garlic, and onion.
Cook for 5-7 minutes until the meat is browned on all sides.
Add the beef broth, white wine, and tomato paste to the pot. Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and let the bollito simmer for 2-3 hours until the meat is tender.
Serve the bollito with a side of salsa verde, a mixture of chopped fresh herbs and capers.

title: Fritto Misto
ingredients: Assorted vegetables, such as zucchini, eggplant, and bell peppers, sliced into 1/4-inch thick rounds
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, Parmesan cheese, and parsley.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg and buttermilk.
Dip each vegetable slice into the egg mixture, then coat in the flour mixture.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat. Fry the coated vegetables in batches until golden brown.
Drain the fried vegetables on paper towels and serve hot.

title: Risotto alla Tartufata
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes until coated in the butter.
Add the white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely absorbed.
Add 1 cup of the warmed broth to the rice and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Repeat the process, adding the broth in 1-cup increments, until the rice is cooked and creamy.
Stir in the truffle oil and Parmesan cheese. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the risotto hot, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.

title: Spaghetti alla Carbonara
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti al dente.
In a large skillet, cook pancetta over medium heat until crispy.
In a medium bowl, whisk together eggs, Parmesan cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add cooked spaghetti to the bowl and toss with egg mixture.
Add cooked pancetta to the bowl and toss to combine.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped parsley if desired.

title: Pollo alla Cacciatora
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
Add onion and garlic to skillet and cook until onion is translucent.
Add mushrooms to skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add white wine, chicken broth, tomato paste, and basil to skillet.
Return chicken to skillet and simmer until cooked through.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Risotto alla Milanese
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic to skillet and cook until onion is translucent.
Add Arborio rice to skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add white wine to skillet and cook until absorbed.
Add warmed chicken broth to skillet, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring constantly.
After 20 minutes, stir in butter and Parmesan cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Torta di Ricotta e Visciole
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together ricotta cheese, granulated sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Pour mixture into a 9-inch springform pan.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until edges are set.
Let cool completely.
Dust with confectioners' sugar and top with mixed berries and chopped pistachios, if desired.

title: Carciofi alla Romana
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Trim artichoke stems and remove tough outer leaves.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic to skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add artichokes to skillet and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Stir in parsley, mint, and Pecorino cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Fritto Misto
ingredients: 1 pound mixed seafood (shrimp, calamari, scallops), peeled and deveined
1 pound mixed vegetables (zucchini, eggplant, bell peppers, onions)
instructions: In a shallow dish, combine flour, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Dredge seafood and vegetables in flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Dip floured seafood and vegetables in buttermilk, then roll in flour mixture again.
Heat 1/2-inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry seafood and vegetables in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

title: Risotto alla Pescatora
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sauté onion and garlic until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add Arborio rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add white wine and cook until absorbed, about 2 minutes.
Add 1/2 cup warmed fish broth and cook, stirring constantly, until absorbed.
Repeat step 5, adding fish broth in 1/2-cup increments, until rice is tender and creamy.
Stir in seafood and cook until pink and cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with Parmesan cheese.

title: Pollo alla Cacciatora
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sauté chicken until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove chicken from skillet and set aside.
Sauté onion and garlic until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add mushrooms and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add diced tomatoes, chicken broth, tomato paste, basil, and oregano.
Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Return chicken to skillet and cook until cooked through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot.

title: Tortellini en Brodo
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sauté onion and garlic until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add warmed chicken broth and bring to a simmer.
Cook tortellini according to package instructions.
Add cooked tortellini to skillet and cook until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley if desired.

title: Bigoli in Salsa
ingredients: 1 cup duck or pork ragù (homemade or store-bought)
instructions: Cook bigoli pasta according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sauté onion and garlic until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add ragù and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5-7 minutes.
Toss cooked bigoli pasta in skillet with ragù and onion mixture.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with Parmesan cheese.

title: Orecchiette con Cime di Rapa
ingredients: 2 large cime di rapa (turnip greens), chopped
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the orecchiette according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the chopped cime di rapa and cook until wilted.
Add the guanciale and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Combine the cooked orecchiette and the skillet mixture, season with salt and black pepper, and serve with Pecorino cheese.

title: Fritto Misto
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the flour, salt, and pepper.
Dredge the zucchini, eggplant, calamari, and shrimp in the flour mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet and fry the battered vegetables until golden brown.
Drain the fried mixture on paper towels and serve with mixed greens and a side of white wine.

title: Pollo alla Cacciatora
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken thighs, boneless and skinless
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook the chicken until browned.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the garlic and mushrooms and cook until the mushrooms release their liquid.
Add the white wine and chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Simmer the mixture until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is cooked through.

title: Ravioli con Ricotta e Spinaci
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
Extra virgin olive oil, for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the flour and eggs to form a dough.
Roll out the dough and use a round cookie cutter to create ravioli shapes.
In a separate bowl, mix together the ricotta cheese, spinach, and Parmesan cheese.
Place a spoonful of the ricotta mixture in the center of each ravioli and fold the dough over to seal.
Cook the ravioli in a large pot of salted water until they float to the surface and serve with olive oil.

title: Panzerotti con Mozzarella e Prosciutto
ingredients: Extra virgin olive oil, for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the flour, eggs, and water to form a dough.
Roll out the dough and use a round cookie cutter to create panzerotti shapes.
Place a slice of mozzarella cheese and a few pieces of prosciutto in the center of each panzerotti.
Fold the dough over to seal and cook the panzerotti in a large pot of salted water until they float to the surface.
Serve the panzerotti with olive oil and basil.

title: Caponata
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add eggplant, celery, and garlic; cook until eggplant is tender, about 10 minutes.
Add capers, parsley, vinegar, salt, and pepper; cook for 2 minutes.
Serve at room temperature.

title: Arancini
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
In a bowl, combine risotto, Parmesan cheese, parsley, ham, and mozzarella cheese.
Shape mixture into balls and fry in oil until golden brown.
Bake for 10-15 minutes or until crispy.

title: Sfincione
instructions: Combine flour, yeast, and salt in a bowl.
Gradually add lukewarm water; mix until dough forms.
Knead dough for 10 minutes; let rise for 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Roll out dough and top with tomato sauce, oregano, basil, anchovies, and mozzarella cheese.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Cannoli
instructions: Combine flour, lard, vinegar, and salt in a bowl.
Mix until dough forms; let rest for 30 minutes.
Roll out dough; fry in oil until crispy.
Drain excess oil and let cool.
Fill with ricotta cheese mixture and top with candied fruit and pistachios.

title: Granita
instructions: Combine sugar and water in a saucepan; heat until sugar dissolves.
Add lemon juice and stir to combine.
Strain mixture into a shallow metal pan and let freeze.
Scrape mixture with a fork to form crystals; garnish with mint and basil.

title: Spaghetti alle Vongole
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add clams, white wine, parsley, oregano, and red pepper flakes. Cook until clams open, about 3-5 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Toss cooked spaghetti with clam sauce and serve with Parmesan cheese.

title: Pollo alla Cacciatora
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 cup mixed mushrooms (button, cremini, shiitake), sliced
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until onion is translucent.
Add mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add chicken broth, red wine, and thyme. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook, covered, until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Serve hot, garnished with parsley if desired.

title: Parmigiana di Melanzane
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, sliced into 1/4-inch thick rounds
instructions: Dredge eggplant slices in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip in beaten eggs and then coat in breadcrumbs.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and fry eggplant slices until golden brown.
Transfer eggplant slices to a baking dish and top with marinara sauce and mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes, until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Risotto alla Pescatora
ingredients: 1 cup mixed seafood (shrimp, scallops, mussels), peeled and deveined
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until onion is translucent.
Add Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add white wine and cook until absorbed.
Add warmed fish broth, 1/2 cup at a time, stirring constantly and allowing each portion to absorb before adding the next.
Add seafood and cook until heated through.
Season with oregano, salt, and black pepper to taste. Serve with Parmesan cheese.

title: Caprese Salad
instructions: Arrange tomato and mozzarella slices on a large platter or individual plates.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.
Sprinkle with chopped basil leaves.
Season with salt and serve immediately.

title: Ribollita
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the cannellini beans, vegetable broth, tomato paste, and thyme. Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the chopped kale and cook until wilted.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Transfer the soup to a baking dish and top with cubed bread.
Bake for 10-15 minutes, or until the bread is toasted and the soup is hot.
Serve hot, topped with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Pappardelle al Cinghiale
ingredients: 1 pound wild boar ragù (or ground pork)
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pappardelle pasta until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the wild boar ragù (or ground pork) and cook, breaking up with a spoon, until browned.
Add the red wine, beef broth, tomato paste, and rosemary. Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Add the sliced porcini mushrooms and cook until tender.
Serve the pappardelle pasta with the wild boar ragù and top with grated Parmesan cheese.

title: Tortellini en Brodo
instructions: Bring a large pot of chicken broth to a boil.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cheese-filled tortellini and cook until they float to the surface.
Heat the olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add the grated Parmesan cheese and cook until melted and golden brown.
Serve the tortellini in the chicken broth, topped with the Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley (if using).

title: Bistecca alla Fiorentina
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat the grill to high heat.
Season the ribeye steaks with salt and black pepper.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the steaks for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Transfer the steaks to a plate and let rest for 5 minutes.
In a small skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped rosemary and cook until fragrant.
Serve the steaks with the garlic and rosemary sauce (if using).

title: Castagnaccio
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together the chestnut flour, all-purpose flour, Parmesan cheese, rosemary, and sage.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the olive oil, milk, eggs, and salt.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Pour the batter into a 9-inch round cake pan or a cast-iron skillet.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown and the center is set.
Serve warm, cut into wedges.

title: Tonkatsu
ingredients: Shredded cabbage and steamed rice for serving
instructions: Season the flour with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Dredge the pork cutlets in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured pork in the eggs, making sure they're fully coated.
Dredge the egg-coated pork in the panko breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the breaded pork cutlets until golden brown and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain the fried pork on paper towels.
Serve the tonkatsu with tonkatsu sauce, shredded cabbage, and steamed rice.

title: Yakitori
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
Sesame seeds and chopped scallions for garnish
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sugar.
Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated chicken, onion, bell pepper, and zucchini onto skewers.
Brush the grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the yakitori until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender, about 8-10 minutes.
Serve the yakitori hot, garnished with sesame seeds and chopped scallions.

title: Takoyaki
ingredients: Soy sauce and bonito flakes for serving
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, eggs, dashi broth, and water.
Heat the vegetable oil in a takoyaki pan or a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour a small amount of the batter into the pan and top with a few pieces of octopus, tempura bits, and bonito flakes.
Cook the takoyaki until the bottom is golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
Loosen the takoyaki with a spatula and flip them over.
Cook the other side until the takoyaki are cooked through and the bottoms are crispy, about 2-3 minutes.
Serve the takoyaki hot with soy sauce and bonito flakes.

title: Onigiri
instructions: Rinse the rice thoroughly and cook according to the package instructions.
Mix the cooked rice with water and salt in a large bowl.
Shape the rice into small triangles or ovals.
Place a small piece of umeboshi, daikon radish, and carrot in the center of each rice triangle.
Fold the rice over the filling to form a triangle or oval shape.
Serve the onigiri as a snack or side dish.

title: Sushi
instructions: Rinse the rice thoroughly and cook according to the package instructions.
Mix the cooked rice with water, rice vinegar, sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
Cut the avocado, cucumber, and carrot into thin slices.
Lay a nori sheet flat on a sushi mat or a piece of parchment paper.
Spread a thin layer of rice onto the nori, leaving a 1-inch border at the top.
Place a few slices of avocado, cucumber, and carrot in the middle of the rice.
Roll the sushi using the mat or parchment paper.
Slice the sushi into individual pieces and serve with pickled ginger.

title: Tonkatsu
ingredients: 4 pork cutlets, about 1/4 inch thick, pounded to an even thickness
Shredded cabbage and steamed rice for serving
instructions: Season the pork cutlets with salt and pepper.
Dredge the pork in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured pork in beaten eggs, then coat with panko breadcrumbs.
Heat about 1/2-inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the breaded pork cutlets until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain the pork on paper towels and serve with tonkatsu sauce, shredded cabbage, and steamed rice.

title: Miso Soup
ingredients: 2 cups dashi broth (or store-bought chicken broth)
1/4 cup sliced green onions for garnish
instructions: Whisk together the miso paste, soy sauce, sake, and mirin in a small bowl until smooth.
Add the miso mixture to the dashi broth and whisk until dissolved.
Bring the broth to a simmer in a medium saucepan.
Reduce the heat to low and add the sliced green onions, cubed tofu, and wakame seaweed.
Simmer for 2-3 minutes, or until the ingredients are heated through.
Serve hot.

title: Sushi Rolls
ingredients: Fillings of choice (e.g., salmon, cucumber, avocado, carrot)
instructions: Rinse the rice thoroughly and cook according to package instructions.
In a small saucepan, combine the rice vinegar, sugar, and 1 tablespoon water.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Allow the rice to cool to room temperature.
Cut the nori sheet into desired sizes for rolling.
Assemble the sushi rolls with the cooked rice and fillings.

title: Ramen Noodle Soup
ingredients: Sliced pork or boiled egg for garnish
Green onions and sesame seeds for garnish
instructions: In a large saucepan, combine the chicken broth, soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sesame oil.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
Cook the ramen noodles according to package instructions.
Add the cooked noodles to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with sliced pork, boiled egg, green onions, and sesame seeds.

title: Yakitori Chicken Skewers
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch pieces
10 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sugar.
Add the chicken pieces to the marinade and toss to coat.
Thread the marinated chicken onto the bamboo skewers.
Grill the skewers over medium heat, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Serve hot.

title: Tonkatsu
instructions: Cut the pork loin into thin slices.
Season the flour with salt and pepper.
Dredge the pork slices in the flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured pork slices in the beaten eggs, coating completely.
Dredge the egg-coated pork slices in the panko breadcrumbs.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the breaded pork slices until golden brown and crispy.
Remove the tonkatsu from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
Serve with shredded cabbage, green onions, and a side of dashi broth.
Dish the dashi broth with soy sauce, sake, and mirin in a small saucepan.
Bring the dashi broth to a simmer over medium heat.
Serve the tonkatsu with the warm dashi broth.

title: Sushi Rolls
instructions: Rinse the Japanese rice thoroughly and cook according to package instructions.
In a small saucepan, combine the rice vinegar, sugar, and salt.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
Once the rice has cooled, mix in the rice vinegar mixture.
Cut the nori seaweed sheets into desired sizes.
Lay a nori sheet flat and spread a thin layer of rice onto it.
Place the cucumber, avocado, smoked salmon, and pickled ginger in the middle of the rice.
Roll the sushi using a bamboo sushi mat.
Slice the sushi rolls into individual pieces.

title: Teriyaki Chicken
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sugar.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and let simmer for 5 minutes.

Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Hakata Gyoza
instructions: In a bowl, combine ground pork, cabbage, green onions, garlic, soy sauce, sake, and sugar.
Mix well and add beaten egg. Mix until just combined.
Place a small spoonful of filling in the center of a wonton wrapper.
Dip your finger in water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press edges together to seal. Repeat with remaining wrappers.

title: Mizutaki
ingredients: 2 cups bok choy, cleaned and drained
instructions: In a large pot, combine chicken pieces, dashi broth, water, soy sauce, sake, mirin, sugar, ginger, and garlic.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add green onions and bok choy to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional green onions and ginger if desired.

title: Chikara Udon
instructions: Cook udon noodles according to package instructions.
In a large pan, heat oil over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute. Add pork belly and cook until browned.
Add dashi broth, water, soy sauce, sake, and sugar to the pan. Bring to a boil.
Serve hot noodles in a bowl and top with pork belly mixture and green onions. Garnish with sesame seeds.

title: Goya Champuru
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced pork (such as pork loin or shoulder)
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add pork and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until onion is translucent.
Add goya and cook until tender.
Stir in ginger, soy sauce, and sake.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with cilantro.

title: Rafute (Braised Pork Belly)
ingredients: 2 pounds pork belly, sliced into 1-inch thick pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add pork and cook until browned on all sides.
Add sugar, soy sauce, sake, mirin, garlic, ginger, and star anise.
Cover and bring to a boil.
Transfer to the oven and braise for 2-3 hours, or until tender.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions.

title: Soki Soba (Okinawan Noodle Soup)
ingredients: 1/2 cup diced pork (such as pork loin or shoulder)
instructions: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add noodles and cook until tender.
Add pork, onion, garlic, and ginger.
Stir in soy sauce, sake, and mirin.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions.

title: Umibudo (Sea Grape) Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, combine umibudo, cucumber, and carrot.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sake, mirin, and oil.
Pour dressing over vegetables and toss to coat.
Garnish with cilantro and serve chilled.

title: Goya Tama (Bitter Melon and Tofu)
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until onion is translucent.
Add goya and cook until tender.
Stir in ginger, soy sauce, and sake.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot.

title: Hiroshima-style Okonomiyaki
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 2 teaspoons salt, 2 teaspoons sugar, 1 packet active dry yeast
1 cup water, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 2 eggs
1 cup shredded cabbage, 1 cup shredded carrots, 1 cup sliced green onion
4 slices pork belly, 4 slices bacon, 1 cup okonomiyaki sauce
instructions: Combine flour, salt, sugar, and yeast in a bowl, mix well.
Add water and mix until dough forms.
Rest dough for 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan, add cabbage, carrots, and green onion, cook until tender.
Add pork belly and bacon, cook until browned.
Pour dough into pan, cook until bottom is crispy.
Flip okonomiyaki, cook until top is crispy.
Serve with okonomiyaki sauce.

title: Tonkatsu Curry Rice
ingredients: 2 cups Japanese curry powder, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 1 onion, 2 cloves garlic
1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 cup panko breadcrumbs, 2 eggs
4 pork loin cutlets, 1 cup Tonkatsu curry sauce
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add onion and garlic, cook until tender.
Add curry powder, cook for 1 minute.
Add panko breadcrumbs, cook for 1 minute.
Dredge pork cutlets in flour, then eggs, then breadcrumbs.
Fry pork cutlets in oil until golden brown.
Serve with Tonkatsu curry sauce and Japanese rice.

title: Hiroshima-style Oysters
ingredients: 12 oysters, 1/4 cup sake, 1/4 cup mirin, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons sugar
2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 2 cloves garlic, 1 tablespoon grated ginger
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add garlic and ginger, cook until fragrant.
Add sake, mirin, soy sauce, and sugar, cook until sauce thickens.
Add oysters, cook until edges start to curl.
Serve oysters with sauce.

title: Mizutaki (Hiroshima-style Chicken Hot Pot)
ingredients: 4 boneless chicken thighs, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 2 cloves garlic, 1 tablespoon grated ginger
2 cups dashi broth, 2 cups water, 2 tablespoons soy sauce
2 cups Chinese broccoli, 1 cup sliced green onion, 1 cup sliced mushrooms
instructions: Heat oil in a pot, add garlic and ginger, cook until fragrant.
Add chicken, cook until browned.
Add dashi broth, water, and soy sauce, bring to a boil.
Add Chinese broccoli, green onion, and mushrooms, cook until tender.
Serve hot pot with chicken and vegetables.

title: Hiroshima-style Okara
ingredients: 2 cups okara (soybean paste), 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 2 cloves garlic
1 cup water, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons sake
1 cup grated daikon radish, 1 cup sliced green onion
instructions: Heat oil in a pan, add garlic, cook until fragrant.
Add okara, cook until browned.
Add water, soy sauce, and sake, bring to a boil.
Add daikon radish and green onion, cook until tender.
Serve okara hot.

title: Zunda (Mashed Soybean Paste with Green Onion)
instructions: Soak edamame in water for 4 hours. Drain and blend into a paste.
Heat soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sugar in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add blended edamame paste and grated daikon to the saucepan.
Stir until the mixture thickens, then serve with green onions on top.

title: Sendai-style Sushi (Sushi with Grilled Eel and Seafood)
ingredients: 1/2 cup seafood (such as salmon and shrimp), sliced
instructions: Prepare sushi rice according to the recipe.
Mix sushi vinegar, water, sake, mirin, and sugar in a saucepan.
Heat the mixture over low heat and stir until dissolved.
Assemble sushi with grilled eel and seafood on top.

title: Hiyayakko (Cold Tofu with Grated Ginger and Soy Sauce)
ingredients: 1 block firm tofu, drained and cubed
instructions: Drain and cube tofu. Place in a bowl.
Grate ginger and sprinkle on top of the tofu.
Mix soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sugar in a saucepan.
Heat the mixture over low heat and stir until dissolved.
Pour the mixture over the tofu and serve.

title: Gyutan (Grilled Beef Tongue with Soy Sauce and Sesame Oil)
instructions: Soak beef tongue in water for 4 hours. Drain and slice.
Grill the beef tongue slices until cooked through.
Mix soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sugar in a saucepan.
Heat the mixture over low heat and stir until dissolved.
Brush the mixture on the grilled beef tongue.
Drizzle sesame oil on top and serve with green onions.

title: Mentaiko (Spicy Pollock Roe with Mayonnaise and Sesame Oil)
instructions: Mix pollock roe, mayonnaise, soy sauce, sake, mirin, sugar, and sesame oil in a bowl.
Add Korean chili flakes and mix well.
Serve the spicy pollock roe as a side dish or topping for rice.

title: Tonkatsu
ingredients: 1 lb pork cutlet, pounded to 1/4 inch thickness
instructions: Dredge the pork cutlet in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured pork in beaten eggs and then coat with panko breadcrumbs.
Heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Fry the breaded pork until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain the fried pork on paper towels and serve with tonkatsu sauce, shredded cabbage, and steamed rice.

title: Miso Ramen
ingredients: 8 oz pork slices, cooked and sliced
1/2 cup sliced green onions, for garnish
1/2 cup sliced bean sprouts, for garnish
instructions: Combine chicken broth, miso paste, soy sauce, sake, and sugar in a saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Sauté the thinly sliced onion until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cooked pork and boiled egg to the onion and stir to combine.
Serve the pork and egg mixture in a bowl of steaming hot miso ramen broth.
Garnish with sliced green onions and bean sprouts.

title: Yakiitori
ingredients: 1 lb chicken thighs, boneless and skinless
1/4 cup chopped green onions, for garnish
instructions: Thread the chicken thighs onto skewers.
Whisk together sake, soy sauce, and mirin in a bowl.
Brush the chicken with the sake mixture and let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Grill the chicken skewers until slightly charred, about 5-7 minutes per side.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.

title: Gyoza
instructions: Mix together ground pork, chopped cabbage, chopped green onions, and garlic in a bowl.
Place a small spoonful of the pork mixture onto a gyoza wrapper.
Dip your finger in water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a half-moon shape and press the edges to seal.
Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
Cook the gyoza until the bottoms are golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
Add 2 tablespoons of water to the pan and cover with a lid.
Steam the gyoza until the wrappers are cooked through, about 5 minutes.

title: Takoyaki
ingredients: 1/4 cup diced green onions, for garnish
instructions: Mix together the takoyaki batter mix, dashi broth, and water in a bowl.
Heat a takoyaki pan or a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour a small amount of batter into the pan and add a few pieces of diced octopus.
Cook the takoyaki until the bottoms are golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
Flip the takoyaki over and cook until the other side is golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
Garnish with diced green onions and bonito flakes.

title: Tonkatsu
instructions: Season the pork slices with salt and pepper.
Dredge the pork in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured pork in beaten eggs, then coat in panko breadcrumbs.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet and fry the breaded pork until golden brown.
Drain the pork on paper towels and serve with tonkatsu sauce, shredded cabbage, and steamed rice.

title: Takoyaki
instructions: Whisk together flour, eggs, dashi broth, and water to make a batter.
Heat a takoyaki pan or a non-stick skillet and brush with oil.
Pour a small amount of batter into each mold and top with diced octopus, green onion, and tempura bits.
Cook until the bottom is golden brown, then flip and cook the other side.
Serve with takoyaki sauce, mayonnaise, and bonito flakes.

title: Kushikatsu
ingredients: Assorted vegetables, such as carrot, potato, and onion, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Dredge the vegetables in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured vegetables in beaten eggs, then coat in panko breadcrumbs.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet and fry the breaded vegetables until golden brown.
Drain the vegetables on paper towels and serve with kushikatsu sauce, shredded cabbage, and steamed rice.

title: Okonomiyaki
instructions: Whisk together flour, eggs, dashi broth, and water to make a batter.
Heat a non-stick skillet and brush with oil.
Pour a small amount of batter into the skillet and top with shredded cabbage, diced green onion, and diced pork belly.
Cook until the bottom is golden brown, then flip and cook the other side.
Serve with okonomiyaki sauce, mayonnaise, and bonito flakes.

title: Oden
instructions: Combine dashi broth, water, soy sauce, sake, and mirin in a large pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer.
Add sliced daikon and carrot to the pot and cook until tender.
Add boiled egg, fishcake, and pickled ginger to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot with dipping sauce.

title: Tonkatsu
instructions: Season the pork slices with salt and pepper.
Dredge the pork in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured pork in beaten eggs, then coat with panko breadcrumbs.
Heat vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Fry the breaded pork slices until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Serve with tonkatsu sauce, shredded cabbage, and steamed rice.

title: Higashi (Kyoto-style Rice Balls)
instructions: Prepare sushi rice according to package instructions.
Mix rice vinegar, sugar, salt, and sesame oil in a small bowl.
Fold the vinegar mixture into the cooked rice until combined.
Let the rice cool to room temperature.
Shape the rice into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Top each rice ball with pickled plum, shiso leaves, and bonito flakes.

title: Kakuni (Braised Pork Belly)
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear the pork belly until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add soy sauce, sake, mirin, sugar, garlic, and ginger to the pot.
Pour in dashi broth and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven.
Braise the pork for 2-3 hours, or until tender and caramelized.

title: Imagawayaki (Japanese Castella Cake)
instructions: Preheat a imagawayaki pan or a non-stick mini cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Whisk together flour, sugar, and baking powder in a medium bowl.
Add melted butter, eggs, milk, and water to the bowl, whisking until smooth.
Pour a small amount of batter into the preheated pan.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the cake and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until cooked through.

title: Shojin-ryori (Buddhist-style Grilled Tofu)
ingredients: 1 block firm tofu, drained and cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Whisk together soy sauce, sake, mirin, and sugar in a small bowl.
Add the tofu cubes to the marinade and let sit for at least 30 minutes.
Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Remove the tofu from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
Grill the tofu until golden brown and crispy on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Serve with garlic and ginger.

title: Hokkaido-Style Soup Curry
ingredients: 2 pounds pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Cook pork until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onions, garlic, carrots, and potatoes, cook until vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add curry powder, cumin, turmeric, salt, and black pepper, cook for 1 minute.
Add beef broth, water, soy sauce, sake, and mirin, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Hokkaido Milk Bread
instructions: Combine warm milk and yeast, let it sit for 5 minutes.
Add sugar, flour, and salt, mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough, shape into a loaf.
Place the loaf in a greased 9x5-inch loaf pan.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F for 35-40 minutes.
Let the bread cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Hokkaido-Style Grilled Salmon
instructions: Whisk together soy sauce, sake, mirin, sugar, garlic, and ginger in a small bowl.
Place the salmon fillets in a shallow dish, brush the marinade on both sides of the fish.
Let the fish marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Remove the fish from the marinade, cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot.

title: Jingisukan (Mongolian BBQ)
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds lamb or beef, sliced into thin strips
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook lamb or beef until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add onions, garlic, bell pepper, and zucchini, cook until vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add soy sauce, sake, mirin, sugar, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, cook for 1 minute.
Serve hot.

title: Hokkaido-Style Miso Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup sliced green onions, for garnish
instructions: Whisk together miso paste, soy sauce, sake, mirin, sugar, and ginger in a small bowl.
Add the miso mixture to the dashi broth, whisk until dissolved.
Bring the soup to a simmer.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions.

title: Tonkotsu Ramen
ingredients: 4 pounds pork bones, 2 pounds chicken bones, 2 carrots, 2 celery stalks, 2 cloves garlic
4 cups chicken broth, 4 cups water, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons sake
1 tablespoon sugar, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 1 onion, 2 cloves garlic, 1 package ramen noodles
Sliced pork, green onions, pickled ginger, sesame seeds
instructions: Roast pork and chicken bones in oven at 400°F for 30 minutes.
Simmer bones in chicken broth and water for 4 hours.
Strain broth and discard solids.
Cook ramen noodles according to package.
Cook sliced pork in pan with vegetable oil until browned.
Assemble ramen with noodles, pork, green onions, pickled ginger, and sesame seeds.

title: Mentaiko Pasta
ingredients: 8 ounces spaghetti, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 1 onion, 2 cloves garlic, 1 cup mentaiko (spicy pollock roe)
1 cup heavy cream, 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese, Salt and black pepper
instructions: Cook spaghetti in boiling water until al dente.
Sauté onion and garlic in pan with vegetable oil until softened.
Add mentaiko and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in heavy cream and Parmesan cheese.
Combine cooked spaghetti and sauce, season with salt and black pepper.

title: Horumon Hot Pot
ingredients: 1 pound horumon (cow stomach), 1 pound pork belly, 2 cups dashi broth, 2 cups water
2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons sake, 2 tablespoons mirin, 2 cloves garlic
1 onion, 1 carrot, 1 celery stalk, 1 package udon noodles
instructions: Cut horumon and pork belly into bite-sized pieces.
Simmer dashi broth and water in pot for 10 minutes.
Add soy sauce, sake, mirin, and garlic to pot.
Add horumon and pork belly to pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Cook udon noodles according to package.
Assemble hot pot with noodles, horumon, and pork belly.

title: Mizutaki Chicken
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken, 2 cups dashi broth, 2 cups water, 2 tablespoons soy sauce
2 tablespoons sake, 2 tablespoons mirin, 2 cloves garlic, 1 onion
instructions: Simmer dashi broth and water in pot for 10 minutes.
Add soy sauce, sake, mirin, and garlic to pot.
Add chicken to pot and cook for 10 minutes.
Serve with sliced green onions and grated daikon.

title: Karaage Chicken
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken, 1 cup potato starch, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1 cup panko breadcrumbs
2 eggs, 1 cup buttermilk, Vegetable oil for frying
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Dredge chicken in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip chicken in eggs, then coat in potato starch.
Coat chicken in panko breadcrumbs.
Fry chicken in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Goya Champuru
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and sauté until fragrant.
Add goya and cook until tender.
Add tofu, scallions, and mushrooms, and stir-fry until combined.
Season with soy sauce and sake.

title: Rafute
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic and ginger, and sauté until fragrant.
