Serve the sikhye chilled, garnished with additional Korean pears if desired.

title: Bulgogi
ingredients: 500g beef (thinly sliced), 2 cloves garlic, 1 tablespoon Gochujang, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons sugar, 2 tablespoons sesame oil, 1 tablespoon black pepper, 1 tablespoon sesame seeds, 2 green onions, 2 cloves ginger
instructions: Marinate the beef in a mixture of Gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, garlic, ginger, and black pepper for at least 2 hours.
Grill or stir-fry the marinated beef until cooked through.
Serve with a side of mixed greens and garnish with sesame seeds and green onions.

title: Jeyuk Bokkeum
ingredients: 500g pork (thinly sliced), 2 cloves garlic, 1 tablespoon Gochujang, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons sugar, 2 tablespoons sesame oil, 1 tablespoon black pepper, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 2 green onions, 2 cloves ginger
2 cups mixed vegetables (such as zucchini, carrots, and bell peppers)
instructions: Heat sesame oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned.
Add the garlic, ginger, Gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, and black pepper. Stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the mixed vegetables and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot garnished with green onions.

title: Tteokbokki
ingredients: 1 cup rice cakes, 2 cups water, 2 tablespoons Gochujang, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons sugar, 2 tablespoons garlic, 2 cloves ginger, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 1 tablespoon black pepper
instructions: Combine the water and Gochujang in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Add the soy sauce, sugar, garlic, and ginger. Reduce heat to a simmer.
Add the rice cakes and cook for 10-15 minutes or until they are well coated with the sauce.
Add the vegetable oil and black pepper. Stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve hot garnished with chopped green onions and a fried egg.

title: Naengmyeon
ingredients: 1 cup buckwheat noodles, 2 cups ice-cold water, 2 tablespoons Gochujang, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons sugar, 2 tablespoons garlic, 2 cloves ginger, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 1 tablespoon black pepper
1/4 cup chopped cucumber, 1/4 cup chopped pear, 2 tablespoons chopped green onions
instructions: Cook the buckwheat noodles according to the package instructions.
Combine the ice-cold water, Gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, garlic, and ginger in a bowl.
Add the cooked noodles to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Add the vegetable oil and black pepper. Toss to combine.
Serve hot garnished with chopped cucumber, pear, and green onions.

title: Gamja-twigim
ingredients: 2 large potatoes, peeled and cut into sticks, 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup cornstarch, 1/2 cup water, 1/4 cup vegetable oil, 1/4 cup grated ginger, 1/4 cup chopped green onions
instructions: Combine the flour, cornstarch, and water in a bowl to make a batter.
Add the grated ginger and chopped green onions to the batter and mix well.
Dip the potato sticks into the batter and then coat with potato starch.
Fry the coated potato sticks in hot oil until crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.

title: Jjajangmyeon
ingredients: 500g noodles, cooked according to package instructions
1 cup jjajang sauce (Korean black bean paste)
1/4 cup chopped green onions, for garnish
1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds, for garnish
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, stir-fry until softened.
Add jjajang sauce, water, sugar, and black pepper, stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add cooked noodles, stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.

title: Maeuntang (Spicy Fish Stew)
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped green onions, for garnish
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry until fragrant.
Add chili flakes, stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add fish pieces, water, fish stock, soy sauce, and chili paste.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Garnish with green onions.

title: Tteokbokki (Rice Cakes in Spicy Sauce)
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped green onions, for garnish
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry until fragrant.
Add chili flakes, stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add rice cakes, water, fish stock, soy sauce, and chili paste.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Garnish with green onions.

title: Bibimbap
ingredients: 2 cups mixed rice, cooked according to package instructions
1 cup diced beef ( ribeye or sirloin), cooked
1/4 cup chopped green onions, for garnish
1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds, for garnish
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions.
Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add garlic, stir-fry until fragrant.
Add bean sprouts, zucchini, and carrot, stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Add cooked beef, soy sauce, and Gochujang, stir-fry for 1 minute.
To assemble, place a scoop of rice in a bowl, top with vegetable mixture, and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.

title: Kimchi Stew (Kimchi Jjigae)
ingredients: 1 cup pork ( ribeye or pork belly), diced
1/4 cup chopped green onions, for garnish
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, stir-fry until softened.
Add pork, stir-fry until browned.
Add kimchi, water, fish stock, soy sauce, and chili paste.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Garnish with green onions.

title: Kimchi Stew (Kimchi Jjigae)
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until onion is translucent.
Add pork and cook until browned.
Add kimchi and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add pork broth, gochujang, sugar, and black pepper. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.

title: Bibimbap
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (zucchini, carrots, bean sprouts)
Chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds for garnish
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add mixed vegetables and cook until tender.
Add beef and cook until browned.
Add garlic, Gochujang, soy sauce, and sugar. Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Serve rice in a bowl and top with beef and vegetable mixture.
Make a well in the center and pour in the beaten egg.
Cook until egg is set, then stir-fry with the rest of the ingredients.

title: Tteokbokki
ingredients: 1 tablespoon chopped green onions for garnish
instructions: Combine water and tteok in a large pot. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Heat oil in a small skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add Gochujang, soy sauce, and sugar. Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Add fish cake and cook until browned.
Add cooked tteok and sauce to the skillet. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot and garnish with green onions and egg slices.

title: Jeyuk Bokkeum (Stir-Fried Pork)
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, zucchini)
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add pork and cook until browned.
Add garlic and onion and cook until onion is translucent.
Add mixed vegetables and cook until tender.
Add soy sauce, sugar, Gochujang, and black pepper. Stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Serve hot and garnish with chopped green onions.

title: Haemul Pajeon (Seafood Pancake)
instructions: Combine flour, cornstarch, and water in a large bowl. Mix until smooth.
Add chili flakes, green onions, carrots, and zucchini. Mix until combined.
Add seafood and mix until well combined.
Add beaten egg and mix until smooth.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Pour in the pancake batter and cook until bottom is golden brown.
Flip and cook until other side is golden brown.

title: Bibimbap
ingredients: 1 cup diced beef ( ribeye or sirloin), cooked
1/4 cup chopped green onions, for garnish
instructions: Cook the short-grain white rice according to package instructions.
Prepare the vegetables by blanching the bean sprouts and steaming the zucchini and carrots until tender.
Slice the cooked beef and tofu into thin strips.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Gochujang sauce, soy sauce, sesame oil, sugar, black pepper, and ginger.
To assemble the Bibimbap, place a scoop of rice in the bottom of a bowl, followed by a layer of vegetables, beef, and tofu.
Drizzle the sauce over the top and garnish with chopped kimchi and green onions.
Serve with a fried egg on top.

title: Kimchi Stew (Kimchi Jjigae)
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped green onions, for garnish
1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds, for garnish
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the kimchi and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the pork or beef and cook until browned.
Add the chicken broth, Gochujang sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and black pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in the water and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions, sesame seeds, and scallions.

title: Jeyuk Bokkeum (Stir-Fried Pork)
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, zucchini)
1/4 cup chopped green onions, for garnish
1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds, for garnish
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the pork and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, Gochujang sauce, sugar, and black pepper.
Pour the sauce over the pork and vegetables and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds.

title: Tteokbokki (Rice Cakes in Spicy Sauce)
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (carrots, zucchini, bell peppers)
1/4 cup chopped green onions, for garnish
1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds, for garnish
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the garlic and onion and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until tender.
Add the spicy sauce and water and bring to a boil.
Add the tteok and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the tteok is coated.
Stir in the sugar and black pepper.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds.

title: Bossam (Boiled Pork with Lettuce and Kimchi)
ingredients: 1/4 cup chopped green onions, for garnish
1/4 cup toasted sesame seeds, for garnish
instructions: In a large pot, combine the water, salt, sugar, black pepper, and garlic.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Add the pork belly and cook for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until tender.
To serve, place a few slices of the boiled pork on a lettuce leaf, along with a spoonful of kimchi.
Serve with a side of kimchi and green onions.

title: Budae Jjigae (Korean Army Stew)
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, cook until onion is translucent.
Add kimchi, sausage, ham, and beans, cook for 5 minutes.
Add water, black pepper, cumin, and gochujang, stir well.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Haemul Pajeon (Korean Seafood Pancake)
instructions: Combine flour, cornstarch, and water in a bowl, mix well.
Add chili flakes, scallions, carrots, zucchini, shrimp, and mussels, mix well.
Add egg, soy sauce, and sesame oil, mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, add batter.
Cook until bottom is golden brown, flip and cook the other side.

title: Jeyuk Bokkeum (Korean Stir-Fried Pork)
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, onions)
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add pork and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add Gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, and black pepper, stir well.
Add mixed vegetables and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.

title: Milmyeon (Korean Cold Noodle Soup)
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions, rinse with cold water.
In a bowl, combine soy sauce, Gochujang, chili flakes, sugar, and sesame oil.
Add noodles to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Garnish with scallions and cucumber.

title: Tteokbokki (Korean Rice Cakes in Spicy Sauce)
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add tteok and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add Gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, and black pepper, stir well.
Add water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.

title: Kimchi Stew
ingredients: 1 pound pork, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until onion is translucent.
Add pork; cook until browned.
Add kimchi, broth, soy sauce, sugar, and black pepper; stir to combine.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions.

title: Bibimbap
ingredients: 1 cup vegetables (bean sprouts, shredded carrots, diced zucchini, diced bell pepper)
instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add vegetables; cook until tender.
Push vegetables to one side of the pan.
Add a little more oil to the empty side of the pan.
Crack in an egg; cook until set.
Cut the egg into small pieces.
Add tofu to the pan; cook until golden brown.
To assemble, place a scoop of rice in a bowl.
Add a spoonful of vegetables, a piece of egg, and a piece of tofu.
Drizzle with soy sauce, Gochujang, and sesame oil; serve.

title: Jeyuk Bokkeum (Stir-Fried Pork)
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (diced carrots, diced bell pepper, diced zucchini)
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add pork; cook until browned.
Add garlic and onion; cook until onion is translucent.
Add mixed vegetables; cook until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together Gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, and black pepper.
Pour the sauce over the pork and vegetables; stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes; serve hot.

title: Tteokbokki (Spicy Rice Cakes)
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (diced carrots, diced bell pepper, diced zucchini)
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add garlic and onion; cook until onion is translucent.
Add mixed vegetables; cook until tender.
Add tteok; cook for 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together Gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, and black pepper.
Pour the sauce over the tteok and vegetables; stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes; serve hot.

title: Haemultang (Spicy Seafood Soup)
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (diced carrots, diced bell pepper, diced zucchini)
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add garlic and onion; cook until onion is translucent.
Add mixed seafood; cook until seafood is pink.
Add fish stock, mixed vegetables, Gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, and black pepper; stir to combine.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with green onions.

title: Jeju Black Pork Bulgogi
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together Gochujang, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger.
Add the sliced pork and marinate for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Remove the pork from the marinade and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until caramelized.
Transfer the pork to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve with steamed rice and garnish with green onions and sesame seeds.

title: Maeun-tang (Spicy Seafood Stew)
ingredients: 2 pounds mixed seafood (clams, mussels, shrimp, and fish)
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the seafood and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly browned.
Add the chili flakes, fish stock, water, soy sauce, Gochujang, and brown sugar.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Season with salt and serve with steamed rice.

title: Jeju-style Grilled Octopus
ingredients: 4 pounds octopus, cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together chili flakes, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, sake, and brown sugar.
Add the octopus and marinate for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Remove the octopus from the marinade and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Transfer the octopus to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve with steamed rice and garnish with green onions.

title: Jeju-style Bibimbap
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (zucchini, carrots, bean sprouts, and mushrooms)
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly browned.
In a separate bowl, whisk together Gochujang and soy sauce.
Add the cooked rice to the bowl and mix well.
To assemble the bibimbap, place a scoop of rice in a bowl, top with the mixed vegetables, fried egg, and a drizzle of the Gochujang sauce.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.

title: Omija Cha (Five-flavor Tea)
instructions: In a small pot, combine the omija berries and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Strain the tea into a cup and discard the berries.
Add the honey and stir to dissolve.
Serve warm and enjoy.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, ginger, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Add the lamb or beef and mix to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Thread the lamb or beef onto skewers, if using.
Grill the shawarma for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by slicing the cooked meat into thin strips and serving it in the pita breads with tzatziki sauce.

title: Fattoush Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cucumber, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, toasted pita bread, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and feta cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley and mint over the top of the salad and serve.

title: Kebabs with Sumac Onions
ingredients: 1 pound beef or lamb, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, sumac, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Add the beef or lamb and mix to coat.
Thread the meat onto skewers, if using.
Grill the kebabs for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, until they are caramelized and golden brown.
Serve the kebabs with the sumac onions on top.

title: Stuffed Grape Leaves (Dolmas)
ingredients: 1 package grape leaves, fresh or jarred
1 pound ground meat (beef, lamb, or a combination)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground meat, chopped onion, cooked rice, tomato paste, cinnamon, allspice, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
If using fresh grape leaves, blanch them in boiling water for 30 seconds to make them pliable. If using jarred grape leaves, rinse them with water.
To assemble the dolmas, lay a grape leaf flat on a work surface, with the stem end facing you. Place a tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a neat package. Repeat with the remaining grape leaves and filling.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the dolmas and cook, turning occasionally, until they are golden brown and crispy on the bottom.

title: Baklava
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Unroll the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces. Cover the dough with plastic wrap to prevent it from drying out.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped walnuts, granulated sugar, flour, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, and salt.
To assemble the baklava, lay a piece of phyllo dough on the prepared baking sheet. Brush the dough with some of the melted butter.
Sprinkle a quarter of the walnut mixture over the dough, then repeat the layering process with the remaining dough and walnut mixture, ending with a layer of dough on top.
Cut the baklava into diamond-shaped pieces and bake for 45-50 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced lamb or beef, cut into strips
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced meat to the bowl and mix to coat.
Thread the meat onto skewers, if using.
Grill the meat over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by spreading a layer of tzatziki sauce on each pita, then adding a few slices of the grilled meat.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve.

title: Fattoush Salad
ingredients: 1 cup toasted pita bread, broken into pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, toasted pita bread, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil and lemon juice.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley and mint over the top of the salad.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately.

title: Kebabs
ingredients: 1 pound lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the meat to the bowl and mix to coat.
Thread the meat onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Serve hot.

title: Baklava
ingredients: 1 package phyllo dough (usually found in the freezer section)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Thaw the phyllo dough according to the package instructions.
In a small bowl, mix together the chopped walnuts, granulated sugar, flour, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, and salt.
Layer the phyllo dough in a 9x13-inch baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Sprinkle a quarter of the walnut mixture over the top of the phyllo dough.
Repeat the layering process, finishing with a layer of phyllo dough on top.
Cut the baklava into diamond-shaped pieces and bake for 45-50 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Gormeh Sabzi
ingredients: 1 pound lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch cubes
1 cup dried lime (or 2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lime juice)
1 cup dried barberries (or 1/4 cup chopped fresh barberries)
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, turmeric, cinnamon, cardamom, and cayenne pepper.
Add the lamb or beef to the bowl and mix to coat.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the meat, turning occasionally, until browned on all sides and cooked through.
Add the chopped parsley and cilantro to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, until wilted.
Stir in the dried lime and barberries.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound boneless lamb shoulder, thinly sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb and mix to coat.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the lamb onto skewers and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by slicing the lamb and serving it in the pita breads with tzatziki sauce.

title: Fattoush Salad
ingredients: 1 cup cucumber, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, toasted pita bread, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil and lemon juice.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Sprinkle with parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Ma'amoul
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour and confectioners' sugar.
Add the softened butter and mix until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 5-10 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into small balls and flatten slightly into disks.
Use a ma'amoul mold or a glass to press a design into the center of each disk.
Fill the center with chopped dates or nuts, if using.
Close the dough over the filling and press the edges to seal.

title: Kunafeh
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the shredded phyllo dough and melted butter.
Mix until the phyllo is well coated with the butter.
Butter a 9x13 inch baking dish and press the phyllo mixture into the bottom.
Sprinkle the shredded akkawi cheese over the phyllo.
Drizzle with rose water and sprinkle with cardamom, cinnamon, and salt.
Bake in a preheated oven at 350°F for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Gormeh Sabzi
ingredients: 1 pound lamb or beef, cut into small pieces
1 cup dried lime, soaked in water
instructions: In a large pot, heat the oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the lamb or beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped parsley, cilantro, and dill, and cook until the herbs are wilted.
Add the soaked lime, beef broth, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 30-40 minutes, or until the meat is tender.

title: Fattoush Salad
ingredients: 1 cup pita bread, toasted and cubed
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chopped greens, toasted pita bread, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil and lemon juice.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Top the salad with crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 cup lamb or beef, thinly sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the olive oil, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the sliced lamb or beef and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Remove the meat from the marinade and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by slicing the cooked meat and serving it in the pita breads with tzatziki sauce and chopped parsley.

title: Baklava
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Thaw the phyllo dough according to the package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the chopped walnuts and pistachios.
In a separate bowl, mix together the granulated sugar, flour, cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves.
Layer the phyllo dough in a 9x13-inch baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Sprinkle a layer of the nut mixture and then a layer of the sugar mixture on top of the phyllo dough.
Repeat the layering process until all the ingredients are used up, finishing with a layer of phyllo dough on top.
Brush the top layer of phyllo dough with the beaten egg and cut the baklava into diamond shapes.
Bake the baklava for 45-50 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Kibbeh
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground meat, bulgur, chopped onion, garlic, salt, black pepper, cinnamon, and allspice.
Mix the ingredients together until just combined.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Using your hands, shape the kibbeh mixture into small patties or balls.
Cook the kibbeh for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.

title: Gormeh Sabzi
ingredients: 1 cup dried lime, soaked in water
1 cup lamb or beef, cut into small pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chopped parsley, cilantro, and dried lime.
In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the lamb or beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, turmeric, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30-40 minutes, or until the meat is tender.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound boneless lamb or beef, thinly sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together garlic, olive oil, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced lamb or beef and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated meat onto skewers, if using.
Grill the meat for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by spreading tzatziki sauce on the pita bread, then adding the grilled meat, tomatoes, onions, and parsley (if using).

title: Baklava
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
Thaw the phyllo dough according to the package instructions.
In a large bowl, mix together the walnuts, sugar, flour, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, and salt.
Unroll the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Layer the phyllo pieces in a 9x13-inch baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter and the beaten egg.
Sprinkle the walnut mixture over the phyllo layers.
Repeat the layering process, ending with a layer of phyllo on top.
Cut the baklava into diamond-shaped pieces and bake for 45-50 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Kebabs
ingredients: 1 pound boneless lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch pieces
4 skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together garlic, olive oil, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion and lamb or beef to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated meat and onion onto the skewers.
Grill the kebabs for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your liking.

title: Falafel
ingredients: 1 cup dried chickpeas, soaked overnight and drained
instructions: Drain the chickpeas and transfer them to a food processor.
Add the garlic, parsley, cilantro, flour, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper to the processor.
Process the mixture until it forms a thick paste.
Using your hands, shape the paste into small patties.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the falafel patties to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until golden brown and crispy.

title: Ma'amoul
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, confectioners' sugar, salt, and cardamom.
Add the softened butter and mix until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into small balls and flatten each ball slightly.
Place a teaspoon of filling (dates or pistachios, if using) in the center of each dough ball.
Fold the dough over the filling and seal the edges to form a small cookie.
Brush the tops of the cookies with beaten egg and bake in a preheated oven at 350°F (175°C) for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced lamb or beef, 2 tablespoons olive oil, 2 cloves garlic, minced, 1 teaspoon ground cumin, 1 teaspoon paprika, 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper, Salt and black pepper, 4 pita bread, 1 cup mixed greens, 1 cup sliced tomatoes, 1 cup sliced red onions
4 tablespoons tahini, 2 tablespoons lemon juice, 1 tablespoon garlic, minced, 1/4 cup water
instructions: Combine lamb or beef, olive oil, garlic, cumin, paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper in a bowl. Let marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Grill lamb or beef until cooked through. Slice into thin strips.
Warm pita bread by wrapping in foil and heating in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble shawarma by spreading tahini sauce on pita, topping with lamb or beef, mixed greens, tomatoes, and red onions.

title: Kebabs
ingredients: 1 pound boneless lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch cubes
Salt and black pepper, to taste
10-12 wooden skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Thread lamb or beef onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture evenly onto both sides of the meat.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced lamb or beef
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add sliced lamb or beef and cook for 3-4 minutes, until browned.
Warm pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble shawarma by spreading tzatziki sauce on the pita, then topping with meat and serving.

title: Fattoush Salad
ingredients: 2 cups toasted pita bread, broken into pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, toasted pita bread, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil and lemon juice.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Sprinkle chopped parsley over the top and season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Stuffed Grape Leaves (Dolmas)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Prepare grape leaves by blanching them in boiling water for 30 seconds.
In a large bowl, mix together ground beef or lamb, cooked rice, parsley, mint, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Place a grape leaf on a flat surface, with the stem end facing you.
Place a tablespoon of the meat mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the stem end over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the leaf to form a tight package.

title: Baklava
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Layer phyllo dough in a 9x13-inch baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Sprinkle chopped walnuts, granulated sugar, flour, cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves over the phyllo.
Layer additional phyllo dough on top, brushing with melted butter.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, until golden brown.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced lamb or beef, cut into 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the lamb or beef onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together the garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the meat.
Grill the meat for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until cooked through.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by placing a few pieces of meat onto each pita bread, topping with tzatziki sauce, and garnishing with parsley.

title: Baba Ghanoush
ingredients: 2 large eggplants, cut in half lengthwise
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Place the eggplants on a baking sheet, cut side up.
Roast the eggplants in the oven for 30-40 minutes, or until the flesh is tender and collapsed.
Remove the eggplants from the oven and let them cool slightly.
Scoop the flesh out of the eggplants and place it in a blender or food processor.
Add the garlic, tahini, lemon juice, and olive oil to the blender.
Blend the mixture until smooth, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the baba ghanoush to a serving bowl and garnish with parsley.

title: Fattoush Salad
ingredients: 4 cups mixed greens (such as arugula, spinach, and lettuce)
1 cup toasted pita bread, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, toasted pita bread, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil and lemon juice.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the parsley and mint over the top of the salad.
Season the salad with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Kibbeh Balls
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground meat, bulgur, onion, parsley, mint, salt, and pepper.
Mix the ingredients together with your hands until just combined.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
When the oil is hot, add the kibbeh balls and cook until they are browned on all sides and cooked through.
Serve the kibbeh balls hot.

title: Ma'amoul Cookies
ingredients: 1 cup ground nuts (such as almonds or pistachios)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour, confectioners' sugar, and salt.
Add the softened butter to the bowl and mix until the dough comes together.
Gradually add the granulated sugar to the dough and mix until well combined.
Beat in the eggs, rose water, and cardamom (if using).
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Use a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out circles of dough.
Place a small amount of ground nuts in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the nuts to form a triangle or a square, and press the edges together to seal the cookie.
Place the cookies on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the cookies for 15-20 minutes, or until lightly golden.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper. Add the sliced meat and marinate for at least 2 hours.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated meat onto skewers, if using.
Grill the meat for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by spreading a layer of tahini sauce on each pita bread, followed by a few slices of the grilled meat, some mixed greens, sliced tomatoes, and red onions.

title: Fattoush Salad
ingredients: 4 cups toasted pita bread, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, feta cheese, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, red onion, and parsley.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the toasted pita bread pieces over the top of the salad and serve.

title: Kibbeh Bil Sanieh
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, bulgur, chopped onion, garlic, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small patties, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter and 1/2 inch thick.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the patties and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve the kibbeh patties in bowls, topped with hot beef broth.

title: Maqluba
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (such as carrots, zucchini, and bell peppers)
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mixed vegetables to the saucepan and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly tender.
Add the rinsed rice to the saucepan and stir to combine with the vegetables and spices.
Add the water and broth to the saucepan, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.

title: Gormeh Sabzi
ingredients: 1 pound lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the chopped parsley, cilantro, and dill. Mix well.
Add the lamb or beef to the bowl and mix until just combined with the herbs.
Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, turmeric, and black pepper to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb or beef mixture to the saucepan and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the meat is browned.
Add the beef broth and dried lime powder to the saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the meat is tender.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 2 pounds thinly sliced lamb or beef, cut into strips
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread lamb or beef strips onto skewers, if using.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with garlic, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Grill skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble shawarma by placing a few slices of lamb or beef onto each pita bread, followed by tomato, onion, cucumber, pickled turnips, and a dollop of tzatziki sauce.

title: Fattoush Salad
ingredients: 2 cups toasted pita bread, cut into small pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, toasted pita bread, cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, parsley, and mint.
Drizzle olive oil and lemon juice over the salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately.

title: Kebabs
ingredients: 1 pound lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch cubes
Salt and black pepper, to taste
10 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Thread lamb or beef cubes onto skewers.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with garlic, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Grill skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot.

title: Baklava
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Thaw phyllo dough according to package instructions.
In a bowl, mix together walnuts, sugar, flour, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, and salt.
Layer phyllo dough in a 9x13-inch baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Sprinkle walnut mixture over phyllo dough, leaving a 1-inch border around edges.
Fold edges of phyllo dough over walnut mixture and brush with melted butter.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Gormeh Sabzi
ingredients: 2 pounds lamb or beef, cut into small pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until onion is translucent.
Add lamb or beef and cook until browned.
Add parsley, cilantro, dill, crushed lime, cumin, turmeric, salt, and black pepper.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1-2 hours, or until lamb or beef is tender.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound boneless lamb or beef, thinly sliced
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, garlic, lemon juice, paprika, cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced meat and mix until coated.
Let marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the meat onto skewers, if using.
Grill for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by spreading tzatziki sauce on the pita, then adding the grilled meat.

title: Fattoush Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, toasted pita bread, cucumber, tomatoes, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil and lemon juice.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Sprinkle with parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Kebabs with Spiced Rice
ingredients: 1 pound boneless lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender.
Meanwhile, thread the lamb or beef onto skewers, if using.
Grill or broil the kebabs for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve the kebabs over the spiced rice.

title: Baklava
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, mix together the walnuts, sugar, flour, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, and salt.
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Sprinkle a quarter of the walnut mixture over the phyllo, then repeat the layering process 3 more times.
Top the final layer of phyllo with the remaining walnut mixture.
Cut the baklava into diamond shapes and bake for 30-40 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Gormeh Sabzi
ingredients: 1 pound lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat the oil over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb or beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the parsley, cilantro, dill, lime leaves, and barberries.
Add the cumin and turmeric, and stir to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the meat is tender.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced lamb or beef, cut into strips
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together garlic, olive oil, pomegranate molasses, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb or beef strips and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated meat onto skewers, if using.
Grill the meat for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by placing the grilled meat onto the warmed pita breads, topped with tzatziki sauce and parsley.

title: Fattoush Salad
ingredients: 4 cups mixed greens, such as arugula, spinach, and lettuce
2 cups toasted pita bread, cut into small pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, toasted pita bread, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil and lemon juice.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley over the top of the salad and serve.

title: Ma'amoul Cookies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, confectioners' sugar, and salt.
Add the softened butter and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into small pieces and shape into disks.
Use a cookie cutter or a glass to cut out the shapes.
Place the cookies on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Allow the cookies to cool completely before serving.

title: Mujaddara
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, and coriander, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the rice and lentils, and stir to combine.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice and lentils are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.

title: Baklava
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, combine the chopped walnuts, granulated sugar, flour, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, and salt.
Layer the phyllo dough in a 9x13-inch baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Sprinkle the walnut mixture evenly over the phyllo dough.
Continue layering the phyllo dough and brushing with butter until all the ingredients are used up.
Cut the baklava into diamond-shaped pieces and bake for 45-50 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow the baklava to cool completely before serving.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound boneless lamb or beef, thinly sliced
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced meat and mix well to coat.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a vertical spit or grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated meat onto skewers, if using.
Cook the meat for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by slicing the cooked meat and serving it in the pita breads with tzatziki sauce and garnished with parsley.

title: Fattoush Salad
ingredients: 1/4 cup pita bread, toasted and broken into pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, cucumber, tomatoes, feta cheese, parsley, and mint.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil and lemon juice.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the toasted pita bread over the top of the salad.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Kebabs with Grilled Vegetables
ingredients: 1 pound boneless lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
1 large red bell pepper, seeded and sliced
1 large yellow bell pepper, seeded and sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb or beef and mix well to coat.
Thread the marinated meat onto skewers, if using.
Thread the bell peppers, onion, and zucchinis onto separate skewers.
Preheat a grill to medium-high heat.
Cook the kebabs for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Cook the vegetables for 5-7 minutes per side, or until tender.

title: Baklava
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Thaw the phyllo dough according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, mix together the chopped nuts, sugar, flour, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, and salt.
Layer the phyllo dough in a 9x13-inch baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Sprinkle a layer of the nut mixture over the phyllo dough.
Repeat the layering process, ending with a layer of phyllo dough on top.
Cut the baklava into diamond-shaped pieces and bake for 45-50 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Ma'amoul Cookies
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, confectioners' sugar, cardamom, and rose water.
Add the softened butter and mix until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small balls and flatten slightly into disks.
Place a spoonful of chopped dates or almonds in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling and seal the edges.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until lightly golden.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, cumin, coriander, paprika, and cayenne pepper.
Add the lamb or beef and mix well to coat.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the lamb or beef onto skewers.
Grill for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for 5 minutes.
Serve the shawarma in the pita breads with tzatziki sauce.

title: Baklava
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Unroll the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Mix the walnuts, sugar, flour, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, and salt in a bowl.
Layer the phyllo dough in a 9x13-inch baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Sprinkle a quarter of the nut mixture onto the phyllo dough.
Repeat the layering process until all the phyllo dough and nut mixture are used up.
Cut the baklava into diamond-shaped pieces and bake for 45-50 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely.

title: Fattoush Salad
ingredients: 1 cup pita bread, toasted and crumbled
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, feta cheese, parsley, mint, pita bread, red onion, and cucumber.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil and lemon juice.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Kibbeh
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, bulgur, onion, flour, salt, and pepper.
Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Using your hands, shape the kibbeh mixture into small patties.
Cook the kibbeh for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.

title: Ma'amoul
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, confectioners' sugar, and salt.
Add the softened butter and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin sheet.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter.
Place a tablespoon of date or walnut filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle and press the edges together.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 2 lbs thinly sliced lamb or beef, cut into 1/4-inch strips
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, allspice, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb or beef and mix well to coat.
Thread the meat onto skewers, if using.
Grill the shawarma over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by spreading a dollop of tzatziki sauce on each pita, then adding a few pieces of the grilled meat.

title: Fattoush Salad
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, toasted pita bread, cucumber, tomatoes, parsley, and mint.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil and lemon juice.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Kebabs
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables, such as cherry tomatoes, bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms
1 pound lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb or beef and mix well to coat.
Thread the meat and vegetables onto skewers, if using.
Grill the kebabs over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until cooked through.

title: Tabbouleh
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the parsley, mint, scallions, tomatoes, and bulgur.
In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice and olive oil.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

title: Ma'amoul
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, confectioners' sugar, and salt.
Add the softened butter and mix until the dough comes together.
Beat in the eggs, rose water, and cardamom.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to about 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of dates or nuts in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle or a square, and press the edges together to seal.
Place the ma'amoul on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake until golden brown.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds boneless lamb shoulder, thinly sliced
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, allspice, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb slices to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Grill the lamb for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by slicing the grilled lamb and serving it in the pita breads with tzatziki sauce.

title: Baklava
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Sprinkle a layer of walnuts, sugar, cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves over the phyllo dough.
Repeat the layering process until all the ingredients are used up, finishing with a layer of phyllo dough on top.
Cut the baklava into diamond-shaped pieces and brush the top layer with the beaten egg and rose water.
Bake the baklava for 45-50 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Kebabs
ingredients: 1 pound boneless lamb or beef, cut into 1-inch cubes
Salt and black pepper, to taste
10 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb or beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated meat onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with parsley or cilantro.

title: Falafel
ingredients: 1 cup dried chickpeas, soaked overnight and drained
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a food processor, combine the chickpeas, garlic, parsley, cilantro, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Process the mixture until it forms a coarse paste.
Using your hands, shape the paste into small patties.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Fry the falafel patties until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.

title: Ma'amoul
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, confectioners' sugar, cardamom, and rose water.
Add the softened butter to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into small balls and flatten each ball slightly.
Place a date in the center of each dough circle and fold the dough over the date to form a triangle.
Brush the tops of the ma'amoul with the beaten egg and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Mujaddara
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper; cook for 1 minute.
Add lentils and rice; stir to combine.
Add 4 cups water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes.
Fluff with a fork and garnish with parsley.

title: Maqluba
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion, potato, and carrot; cook until softened.
Add cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper; cook for 1 minute.
Add rice; stir to combine.
Add 4 cups water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Uncover and cook until rice is lightly browned.

title: Kunafeh
instructions: Soak phyllo dough in water for 10 minutes.
Layer phyllo dough in a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle cheese, pistachios, sugar, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves, and salt on top.
Drizzle melted butter over the top.
Bake at 350°F for 30-40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced lamb or beef
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together oil, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper.
Add sliced meat and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread marinated meat onto skewers and cook for 5-7 minutes or until cooked through.
Warm pita breads by wrapping in foil and heating in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble shawarma by spreading tzatziki sauce on pita bread, then topping with cooked meat.

title: Gormeh Sabzi
ingredients: 2 cups beef or lamb, cut into bite-sized pieces
2 cups dried lime, soaked in water
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add garlic, parsley, cilantro, dill, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper; cook for 1 minute.
Add beef or lamb and cook until browned.
Add soaked lime and 2 cups water; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes or until meat is tender.

title: Mujaddara
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, 5 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper; cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and rice; stir to combine.
Add 4 cups water; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer, 20-25 minutes, or until lentils are tender.
Fluff with a fork; garnish with parsley.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced lamb or beef, cut into strips
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together oil, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add lamb or beef; toss to coat.
Let marinate, at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours.
Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread lamb or beef onto skewers.
Grill, 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Serve in pita breads with tzatziki sauce.

title: Kunafeh
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Butter a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Layer phyllo dough in the dish, brushing with melted butter.
Sprinkle cheese, sugar, rose water, cardamom, cinnamon, and nutmeg over phyllo.
Top with remaining phyllo dough; brush with melted butter.
Bake, 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let cool; serve warm.

title: Maqluba
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
2 cups mixed vegetables (such as carrots, zucchini, and bell peppers)
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, 5 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, salt, and pepper; cook 1 minute.
Add rice; stir to combine.
Add water, broth, and mixed vegetables; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer, 20-25 minutes, or until rice is tender.
Invert onto a serving platter; serve warm.

title: Gormeh Sabzi
ingredients: 1 cup dried kidney beans, soaked and drained
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, 5 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and pepper; cook 1 minute.
Add parsley, cilantro, and kidney beans; stir to combine.
Add beef broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer, 20-25 minutes, or until beans are tender.
Serve warm, garnished with additional parsley and cilantro, if desired.

title: Shakshuka
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and bell peppers, cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic, smoked paprika, and ground cumin, cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes, salt, and black pepper, stir to combine.
Create 6 wells in the tomato mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked through.

title: Hummus
ingredients: 1 cup dried chickpeas, soaked overnight and drained
instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
In a blender or food processor, combine the chickpeas, garlic, lemon juice, tahini, and olive oil.
Blend on high speed for 2 minutes, or until smooth.
Season with salt and water, blend for an additional 30 seconds.
Transfer the hummus to a serving bowl and garnish with paprika, parsley, or pine nuts.

title: Matbucha
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and bell peppers, cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes, minced garlic, ground cumin, and smoked paprika, cook for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Simmer the matbucha for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until thickened.

title: Falafel
ingredients: 1 cup dried chickpeas, soaked overnight and drained
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
In a food processor, combine the chickpeas, garlic, parsley, cilantro, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Process until coarsely chopped.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into 8-10 patties.
Dip each patty in the flour, shaking off excess.
Heat 2-3 inches of oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Fry the falafel for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.

title: Kubbeh
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour and salt.
Gradually add the warm water, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes, until smooth.
Divide the dough into 8-10 pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly.
Heat 2-3 inches of oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Fry the kubbeh for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.

title: Kebabs Masgouf
ingredients: 1 whole mullet fish (about 2 pounds), scaled and cleaned
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Mix garlic, parsley, mint, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Rub the spice mixture all over the fish, making sure to get some under the skin as well.
Drizzle the olive oil over the fish and place it on the grill.
Cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve hot with lemon wedges on the side.

title: Shawarma
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced lamb or beef, cut into strips
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lamb or beef and cook for 3-4 minutes, until browned.
Mix in the parsley, mint, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by placing a few slices of the lamb or beef on each pita bread and topping with tzatziki sauce.

title: Kubbeh Bil Sanieh
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine the flour and water in a large bowl to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes, until softened.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.

title: Gormeh Sabzi
ingredients: 1 cup dried kidney beans, soaked overnight and drained
1 pound beef, cut into small pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes, until softened.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the parsley, cilantro, fenugreek leaves, and kidney beans.
Cook for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth and bring to a boil.

title: Kunafah
instructions: Soak the shredded phyllo dough in water for 30 minutes.
Drain the phyllo dough and squeeze out as much water as possible.
Mix the granulated sugar, rose water, and orange blossom water in a small bowl.
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with the melted butter.
Sprinkle the pistachios and almonds over the top layer of phyllo dough.
Pour the sugar mixture over the top of the phyllo dough and bake in a preheated oven at 350°F for 30-40 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Fesenjan
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken or beef, cut into bite-sized pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, cinnamon, turmeric, cumin, and cayenne pepper, and cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the pomegranate juice, molasses, walnuts, and almonds, and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the meat is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, about 30 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, and serve over rice.

title: Kebabs-e Barg
ingredients: 1 pound lamb or beef, cut into skewers
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the meat onto skewers.
Brush the skewers with oil and season with garlic, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Grill the skewers, turning occasionally, until cooked through, about 8-10 minutes.
Serve hot with rice and herbs.

title: Khoresh-e Bademjan
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the eggplant and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the broth, tomato puree, tomato paste, molasses, sugar, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the sauce has thickened, about 30 minutes.
Serve hot over rice.

title: Baklava
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Layer the phyllo dough in a baking dish, brushing with melted butter between each layer.
Sprinkle the pistachios over the phyllo dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Mix the sugar, cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves, and sprinkle over the pistachios.
Roll up the phyllo dough and cut into diamonds.
Bake until golden brown, about 30-40 minutes.

title: Ash-e Reshteh
ingredients: 1 pound lamb or beef, cut into bite-sized pieces
2 cups dried chickpeas, soaked overnight and drained
2 cups dried beans, soaked overnight and drained
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, beans, broth, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the soup has thickened, about 30 minutes.
Serve hot, topped with herbs and crusty bread.

title: Doner Kebab
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced lamb or beef, cut into 1/4-inch thick strips
instructions: In a large bowl, combine lamb or beef strips, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and let it marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a vertical spit or a grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated lamb or beef onto skewers, if using.
Cook the lamb or beef for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the doner kebab by slicing the cooked lamb or beef into thin strips and serving it in the pita breads with lettuce, tomato, onion, and tzatziki sauce.

title: Menemen
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to brown.
Add the diced tomatoes and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Crack the eggs into the skillet and scramble them with the onions and tomatoes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the menemen hot, garnished with chopped parsley and dill, and accompanied by crusty bread.

title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Cut the tops off the bell peppers and remove the seeds and membranes.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground beef or lamb and cook until it is browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Stir in the cooked rice, parsley, and cheese.
Stuff each bell pepper with the meat and rice mixture and place them in a baking dish.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the bell peppers are tender.

title: Baklava
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Unroll the phyllo dough and cut it into 4 equal pieces.
Mix the chopped walnuts, granulated sugar, flour, cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves in a bowl.
Layer the phyllo dough in a 9x13-inch baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Sprinkle a quarter of the walnut mixture over the phyllo dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Repeat the layering process 3 more times, finishing with a layer of phyllo dough on top.
Brush the top layer of phyllo dough with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Cut the baklava into diamond-shaped pieces and bake for 45-50 minutes, or until the phyllo dough is golden brown.

title: Lahmacun
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the warm water and yeast. Let it sit for 5-10 minutes, or until the yeast is activated.
Add the olive oil, salt, and 2 cups of flour to the bowl. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Gradually add the remaining cup of flour, kneading the dough for 5-10 minutes, or until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Preheat a pizza stone or baking sheet in the oven to 450°F (230°C).
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch and place it on the preheated stone or baking sheet.
Top the dough with the ground lamb or beef, chopped onion, garlic, parsley, and feta cheese.
Bake for 10-15 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the toppings are cooked through.

title: Kibbeh Bil Sanieh (Stuffed Kibbeh)
instructions: Soak the bulgur in water for 30 minutes, then squeeze out excess water.
Mix the ground beef, chopped onion, salt, black pepper, allspice, and cumin in a bowl.
Add the squeezed bulgur to the bowl and mix well.
Shape the mixture into small balls and flatten them slightly.
Stuff each ball with a mixture of chopped parsley, mint, and pine nuts.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Fry the stuffed kibbeh until golden brown on both sides, about 5 minutes.

title: Shawarma (Lebanese-Style Chicken Wrap)
ingredients: 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into thin strips
instructions: Marinate the chicken strips in a mixture of olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, cumin, and paprika for at least 30 minutes.
Grill or cook the chicken strips in a skillet until cooked through.
Warm the pita breads by wrapping them in foil and heating them in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by spreading tzatziki sauce on the pita bread, followed by a few strips of chicken, tomato slices, onion slices, and cucumber slices.

title: Fattoush Salad (Lebanese-Style Bread Salad)
ingredients: 1 cup toasted pita bread, cut into small pieces
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, toasted pita bread, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil and lemon juice.
Drizzle the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Sprinkle the chopped parsley and mint over the salad and serve.

title: Gormeh Sabzi (Herb Stew with Lamb and Dill)
ingredients: 1 pound lamb, cut into small pieces
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the lamb broth, chopped parsley, chopped dill, dried lima beans, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.

title: Baklawa (Lebanese-Style Pastry with Nuts and Honey)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (180°C).
Thaw the phyllo dough according to the package instructions.
Layer the phyllo dough in a baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Sprinkle the chopped nuts, granulated sugar, flour, cinnamon, cardamom, and salt over the phyllo dough.
Layer the phyllo dough on top of the nut mixture and brush with melted butter.
Bake the baklawa for 30-40 minutes, or until golden brown.
Drizzle the honey over the baklawa and serve.

title: Fattoush Salad
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chopped greens, toasted pita bread, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, and sumac.
Pour dressing over salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Maqluba (Upside-Down Rice Casserole)
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat ghee or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add chicken and cook until browned.
Add rice, water, chicken broth, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 20-25 minutes or until rice is cooked and liquid is absorbed.
Fluff with a fork and serve.

title: Mujaddara (Lentil and Rice Bowl)
ingredients: 1 cup brown or green lentils, rinsed
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine lentils and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer until lentils are tender.
Heat ghee or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add rice and cook until lightly toasted.
Add cumin, salt, and pepper.
Add cooked lentils and mix well.

title: Shawarma-Style Chicken
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, cut into thin strips
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken and mix well to coat.
Grill or cook chicken in a skillet until cooked through.
Warm pita breads by wrapping in foil and heating in the oven.
Assemble shawarma by slicing cooked chicken and serving in pita bread with your favorite toppings.

title: Kunafeh (Shredded Phyllo Pastry with Cheese)
ingredients: 1/4 cup rose water or orange blossom water
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, combine shredded phyllo pastry, akkawi cheese, mozzarella cheese, and melted butter.
Mix well to combine.
Transfer mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Drizzle with rose water or orange blossom water and sprinkle with sugar and cardamom.
