ingredients: 2 ounces pisco or other clear Peruvian brandy
instructions: In a shaker, combine the pisco, lime juice, and simple syrup.
Add the egg white and dry shake (shake without ice) for 10-15 seconds.
Add ice to the shaker and shake until frothy.
Strain into a rocks glass filled with ice.
Garnish with a lime wheel.

title: Churros con Cajeta
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, salt, and cinnamon.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk and eggs.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F.
Pipe the dough through a star tip and fry until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve with cajeta.

title: Feijoada
ingredients: 1 pound dried black beans, soaked overnight
1 pound smoked pork neck or shoulder, cut into 2-inch pieces
2 pounds beef brisket or shank, cut into 2-inch pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Cook the beans in a large pot of water until tender.
In a separate pot, cook the pork and beef in oil until browned.
Add the onions, garlic, bell pepper, and tomatoes to the pot and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the cooked beans to the pot and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve the feijoada hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.

title: Aji de Gallina
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Add the shredded chicken, Parmesan cheese, heavy cream, aji amarillo pepper paste, and cumin to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the aji de gallina over cooked rice, topped with sliced hard-boiled eggs.

title: Chimichurri
ingredients: 1 cup fresh parsley leaves and stems
instructions: Combine the parsley, oregano, and garlic in a food processor and process until well combined.
With the processor running, slowly pour in the red wine vinegar and olive oil through the feed tube.
Season the chimichurri with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the chimichurri to a serving bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.

title: Ceviche de Camarones
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine the shrimp, lime juice, onion, cilantro, and garlic in a large bowl and stir to combine.
Refrigerate the ceviche for at least 30 minutes to allow the shrimp to 'cook' in the lime juice.
Just before serving, stir in the diced mango.
Season the ceviche with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the ceviche chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.

title: Churros con Chocolate
instructions: Combine the flour, sugar, salt, and cinnamon in a large bowl and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir to combine.
Heat the oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
Pipe the dough through a star tip into the hot oil and fry until golden brown.
Dust the churros with confectioners' sugar and serve with dark chocolate for dipping.

title: Feijoada
ingredients: 1 pound dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained
1 pound smoked pork neck or shoulder, cut into large pieces
2 pounds beef brisket or shank, cut into large pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Brown the pork and beef in oil, then set aside.
Sauté the onions and garlic until softened.
Add the soaked black beans, cumin, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Add the browned pork and beef, and stir well.
Add the tomatoes and enough water to cover.
Simmer for 2-3 hours or until the beans are tender.
Serve with rice, farofa, and sliced oranges.

title: Chimichurri
instructions: Combine parsley, oregano, and garlic in a bowl.
Add the vinegar, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Mix well to combine.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve with grilled meats or as a dip.

title: Cazuela de Mariscos
ingredients: 1 pound squid, cut into bite-sized pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the mussels, clams, shrimp, and squid.
Pour in the wine and broth, and add oregano.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer.
Serve with crusty bread and lemon wedges.

title: Churros con Cajeta
instructions: Combine flour, sugar, salt, and cinnamon in a bowl.
Add the milk and eggs, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F.
Fry the dough in 4-6 inch pieces until golden brown.
Drain and dust with powdered sugar.
Serve with cajeta for dipping.

title: Aji de Gallina
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken breast or thighs, cooked and shredded
2 medium aji amarillo peppers, seeded and chopped
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine the aji peppers and garlic in a blender.
Blend until smooth, then set aside.
In a saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the shredded chicken and aji pepper mixture.
Pour in the heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat and let sauce thicken.
Stir in Parmesan cheese and season with salt and pepper.

title: Aji de Gallina
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breast, cooked and shredded
2 large aji amarillo peppers, seeded and chopped
instructions: Shred the cooked chicken breast into bite-sized pieces.
In a blender or food processor, combine the heavy cream, Parmesan cheese, cumin, paprika, black pepper, and cayenne pepper. Blend until smooth.
Heat the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the diced potatoes and cook until they are tender, about 10-12 minutes.
Add the chopped aji amarillo peppers and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the blended cream mixture and cook until heated through.
Add the shredded chicken to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.

title: Feijoada
ingredients: 1 lb dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained
1 lb smoked beef brisket or beef shank, cut into large pieces
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced pork sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked beef brisket or beef shank and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the soaked and drained black beans, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the beef broth and water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the beans and meat are tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro and farofa.

title: Chimichurri
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the chopped parsley, oregano, and garlic. Blend until well combined.
With the blender or food processor running, slowly pour in the red wine vinegar and olive oil. Blend until smooth.
Season with black pepper and salt to taste.
Transfer the chimichurri to a bowl and serve with grilled meats or as a dip.

title: Cazuela de Mariscos
ingredients: 2 lbs mixed seafood (such as mussels, clams, and shrimp)
instructions: Heat the butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the chopped tomato and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the mixed seafood and cook until it starts to open, about 5 minutes.
Add the white wine, fish broth, cumin, paprika, cayenne pepper, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil and then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the seafood is cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.

title: Humitas
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the corn kernels, heavy cream, Parmesan cheese, beaten egg, cumin, paprika, cayenne pepper, and black pepper. Blend until smooth.
Heat the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Place a corn husk on a flat surface and spoon some of the corn mixture onto the center of the husk.
Fold the sides of the husk over the filling and then roll the husk up to form a tight package.
Repeat with the remaining corn mixture and husks.
Steam the humitas over boiling water for 10-12 minutes, or until the filling is set and the corn is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.

title: Feijoada
ingredients: 1 pound dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained
2 pounds beef brisket or beef shank, cut into large pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Brown the beef in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onions and garlic and cook until the onions are translucent.
Add the soaked black beans, beef broth, cumin, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 1 hour.
Add the sliced sausage and cook for an additional 30 minutes.
Serve the feijoada with rice, farofa, and sliced oranges.

title: Ceviche de Camarones
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the shrimp and lime juice.
Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Stir in the chopped onion, cilantro, and garlic.
Add the diced mango and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve chilled.

title: Aji de Gallina
instructions: In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the aji amarillo pepper paste and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the heavy cream and bring to a simmer.
Add the shredded chicken and cook until heated through.
Stir in the Parmesan cheese until melted.
Serve the chicken mixture over cooked white rice and top with sliced eggs.

title: Chimichurri
instructions: In a food processor, combine the parsley, oregano, and garlic.
Process until the mixture is well combined.
With the processor running, slowly add the red wine vinegar.
Process until the mixture is well combined.
With the processor running, slowly add the olive oil.
Process until the mixture is well combined.

title: Churros con Chocolate
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, salt, and cinnamon.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, eggs, and vegetable oil.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Heat the vegetable shortening in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
Fry the dough in batches until golden brown.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve with dark chocolate.

title: Peruvian Lomo Saltado
ingredients: 1 pound beef strips (sirloin or ribeye), cut into bite-sized pieces
1 large red bell pepper, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove beef and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then add onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add garlic, bell pepper, and tomatoes, and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Return beef to the wok and stir in soy sauce, vinegar, and black pepper.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, then serve over rice with French fries on the side.

title: Brazilian Feijoada
ingredients: 1 pound dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained
1 pound smoked sausage (such as linguiça), sliced
1 pound beef brisket or beef shank, cut into large pieces
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a large pot, combine beans, sausage, beef, onions, garlic, and bell pepper.
Add diced tomatoes, beef broth, cumin, and oregano.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 2-3 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve with rice, farofa, and sliced oranges.

title: Argentine Choripan
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Grill choripan until browned and cooked through.
Split bread rolls in half and toast until lightly browned.
Spread mayonnaise on the bottom half of each roll.
Top with a slice of choripan, some onion, and a tomato slice.
Drizzle with chimichurri sauce and serve immediately.

title: Colombian Ajiaco
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
2 large corn on the cob, cut into 1-inch pieces
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: In a large pot, combine chicken, broth, onion, garlic, potatoes, and corn.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in cumin and oregano, then season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and lime wedges.

title: Uruguayan Chivito
ingredients: 1 pound thinly sliced steak (such as flank steak or skirt steak)
instructions: Grill steak until browned and cooked through.
Split bread rolls in half and toast until lightly browned.
Spread mayonnaise on the bottom half of each roll.
Top with a slice of steak, some lettuce, a tomato slice, a slice of ham, a slice of cheese, and a few slices of onion.
Drizzle with chimichurri sauce and serve immediately.

title: Feijoada
ingredients: 1 pound dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained
1 pound smoked pork neck or butt, cut into large pieces
1 pound beef brisket or shank, cut into large pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large pot, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, and oregano. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the pork and beef. Cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the beans, salt, and black pepper. Pour in enough water to cover the ingredients and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the beans and meats are tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
Serve the feijoada hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro and farofa.

title: Chimichurri
instructions: In a food processor, combine the parsley, oregano, and garlic. Process until chopped.
With the processor running, slowly pour in the vinegar and oil. Process until smooth.
Season the chimichurri with salt and black pepper. Serve immediately or store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

title: Cazuela de Mariscos
ingredients: 1 pound fish fillets, cut into large pieces
instructions: In a large pot, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the mussels, clams, shrimp, and fish. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the seafood is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Pour in the wine and broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the seafood is cooked through, about 10 minutes.
Serve the cazuela hot, garnished with parsley.

title: Choripan
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill the chorizo sausages until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, grill the bread rolls until lightly toasted.
In a small bowl, mix together the onion and garlic.
Split the bread rolls in half and top each with a grilled chorizo sausage, some onion mixture, and a sprinkle of salt and black pepper.

title: Pão de Queijo
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the tapioca flour and Parmesan cheese.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, egg, and salt.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.

title: Feijoada
ingredients: 1 pound dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained
2 pounds beef brisket or beef shank, cut into large pieces
instructions: Brown the beef and pork in oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add onion, garlic, cumin, oregano, cayenne, salt, and pepper. Cook until onion is softened.
Add soaked and drained black beans, chopped tomatoes, and smoked pork neck bones.
Pour in enough water to cover the ingredients and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2 hours or until the meat is tender.
Serve with rice, farofa, and sliced oranges.

title: Ceviche de Camarones
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Combine shrimp, lime juice, onion, cilantro, garlic, and jalapeño in a large bowl.
Mix well and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the shrimp to 'cook' in the lime juice.
Just before serving, stir in diced mango.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips or tostadas.

title: Feijoada
ingredients: 1 pound dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained
2 pounds beef brisket or beef shank, cut into large pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add beans, sausage, cumin, and oregano.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Add 4 cups water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, covered, until beans are tender, about 2 hours.

title: Ceviche de Camarones
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine shrimp and lime juice.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Stir in onion, cilantro, and jalapeño.
Just before serving, stir in avocado.
Season with salt and black pepper.

title: Chimichurri
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a food processor, combine parsley, oregano, and garlic.
Process until well combined.
With processor running, slowly pour in vinegar and oil.
Season with salt and black pepper.

title: Churrasco de Ternera
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, mix together garlic, cumin, and paprika.
Rub mixture all over steak.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Grill steak for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.

title: Tamales de Pollo
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine masa harina and broth.
Stir in lard or shortening until well combined.
Add chicken, onion, and cilantro.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Steam tamales for 45-60 minutes, or until cooked through.

title: Feijoada
ingredients: 1 pound dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained
1 pound smoked pork neck or shoulder, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 pound beef brisket or shank, cut into 2-inch pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, for garnish
instructions: Combine the soaked black beans and enough cold water to cover them in a large pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 1 hour.
In a separate pot, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onions, garlic, and red bell pepper. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the smoked pork, beef, cumin, and oregano to the pot. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
Add the cooked black beans to the pot, along with 4 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Season the feijoada with salt and black pepper to taste. Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.

title: Ceviche Clásico
ingredients: 1 pound firm white fish (such as halibut or sea bass), cut into small pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the fish, lime juice, onion, cilantro, garlic, and jalapeño. Stir to combine.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or until the fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork.
Season the ceviche with salt and black pepper to taste.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Serve the ceviche in the tortillas, topped with diced avocado.

title: Chimichurri
ingredients: 1 cup fresh parsley leaves and stems
instructions: In a food processor, combine the parsley, oregano, and garlic. Process until the mixture is well combined and slightly chopped.
With the processor running, slowly pour in the vinegar and oil. Process until the chimichurri is well combined and slightly thickened.
Season the chimichurri with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the chimichurri to a serving bowl or airtight container. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.

title: Empanadas
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour and salt. Add the lard or shortening and, using a pastry blender or your fingers, work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the warm water to the bowl, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 5-10 minutes, until the dough is smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk.
Place a tablespoon or two of the filling in the center of each disk. Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal the empanada.

title: Aji de Gallina
instructions: In a large pot, combine the chicken and enough cold water to cover it. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer until the chicken is cooked through.
Shred the cooked chicken into bite-sized pieces. Set aside.
In a blender or food processor, combine the aji amarillo pepper paste, heavy cream, and Parmesan cheese. Process until smooth.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the shredded chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is well coated with the aji sauce.
Serve the chicken over cooked white rice, topped with sliced hard-boiled eggs and chopped cilantro.

title: Lomo Saltado
ingredients: 1 medium red bell pepper, thinly sliced
2 aji amarillo peppers, seeded and sliced
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add beef and cook until browned.
Remove beef from wok and set aside. Add more oil if needed.
Add onion, garlic, bell pepper, and aji amarillo to the wok. Cook until vegetables are tender.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, and oregano to the wok. Stir to combine.
Return beef to the wok and stir to combine with vegetables and sauce.
Serve over French fries.

title: Ceviche Clásico
ingredients: 1 pound fresh sea bass, cut into small pieces
1 aji amarillo pepper, seeded and chopped
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine sea bass, lime juice, onion, tomato, cilantro, and aji amarillo in a bowl.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow fish to 'cook' in lime juice.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.

title: Aji de Gallina
ingredients: 1 pound chicken breast, cooked and shredded
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine chicken, heavy cream, cheese, aji amarillo pepper, and garlic in a saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sauce thickens.
Serve sauce over rice or noodles, garnished with cilantro.

title: Seco de Cordero
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until tender.
Add garlic, lamb shanks, beef broth, tomatoes, cumin, and paprika to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Serve lamb with sauce spooned over the top.

title: Anticuchos
ingredients: 1 pound beef heart, cut into small pieces
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine beef heart, vinegar, garlic, aji amarillo pepper, and cumin in a bowl.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld.
Thread beef heart onto skewers and grill or broil until cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional aji amarillo pepper if desired.

title: Ajiaco
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until onion is translucent.
Add chicken; cook until browned.
Add cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Add chicken broth, water, potatoes, and yuca; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; simmer until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with cilantro.

title: Bandeja Paisa
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until onion is translucent.
Add ground beef; cook until browned.
Serve with rice, beans, cheese, egg, chicharrón, avocado, and plantain.
Garnish with cilantro.

title: Lechona
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until onion is translucent.
Add shredded pork; cook until heated through.
Stir in rice, cilantro, scallions, parsley, and olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Sancocho
ingredients: 2 pounds beef brisket, cut into large pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until onion is translucent.
Add beef; cook until browned.
Add carrots, potatoes, yuca, beef broth, water, tomato paste, cumin, and paprika.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat; simmer until beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Empanadas
ingredients: 1/2 cup chopped cooked beef or chicken
instructions: Combine flour and salt in a bowl.
Add lard or shortening; mix until dough forms.
Gradually add warm water; knead until smooth.
Divide dough into small balls.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle.
Place a spoonful of cheese, beef or chicken, and onion in center of each circle.
Fold dough in half; press edges to seal.
Brush tops with egg wash.

title: Pastel de Choclo
ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds ground beef, cooked and drained
2 cups corn kernels, fresh or frozen
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, corn kernels, heavy cream, cumin, and paprika. Cook for 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked beef mixture, beaten eggs, and grated cheese.
Roll out the pie crust and place it in a 9-inch pie dish.
Fill the pie crust with the beef mixture and smooth the top.
Brush the edges of the pie crust with the beaten egg for a glaze.
Bake the pastel for 40-45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Let the pastel rest for 10-15 minutes before serving.

title: Chupe de Mariscos
ingredients: 1 pound squid, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mussels, clams, shrimp, and squid to the pot.
Pour in the white wine and fish broth, and stir in the cumin and paprika.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, until the seafood is cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the chupe hot, garnished with chopped parsley.

title: Empanadas de Carne
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the flour and salt.
Add the lard or shortening and, using a pastry blender or your fingers, work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the warm water, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 5-10 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon or two of the beef mixture in the center of each circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg and fold the dough over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Use a fork to crimp the edges and create a decorative border.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook the empanadas until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.

title: Choripán
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill the chorizos until nicely charred, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Split the bread rolls in half and toast until lightly browned.
Spread a layer of mayonnaise on each roll.
Add a few slices of grilled chorizo to each roll.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately.

title: Locro de Papas
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender, then set aside.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat, add the onion and cook until softened.
Add the garlic, corn, and cooked potatoes to the pot.
Pour in the milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Stir in the grated cheese until melted and smooth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Seco de Carne
ingredients: 2 pounds beef brisket, cut into large pieces
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat, add the beef and cook until browned.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot, cook until the onion is softened.
Add the beef broth, beef stock, tomato paste, cumin, and paprika to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Canelazo
ingredients: 2 cups fruit juice (such as orange or pineapple)
instructions: Combine the water and fruit juice in a large pot.
Add the cinnamon sticks and cloves to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the sugar to the pot and stir to dissolve.
Strain the mixture into a large pitcher or jug.
Add the rum, if using.

title: Empanadas
instructions: Combine the flour and lard or shortening in a large bowl, use a pastry blender or your fingers to work the fat into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the warm water to the bowl, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece of dough into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the cheese, onion, and meat mixture onto one half of the dough circle, brush the edges with the beaten egg.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape, press the edges to seal.

title: Huarache de Queso
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat, add the onion and cook until softened.
Add the queso fresco and grated cheese to the skillet, stir until the cheese is melted and smooth.
Stir in the chopped cilantro, epazote, and scallions.
Serve the cheese mixture on a large tortilla or huarache.

title: Chivito Sandwich
ingredients: 8 oz grilled ribeye steak, thinly sliced
instructions: Grill the ribeye steak to desired doneness.
Assemble the sandwich with steak, egg, fries, and chimichurri sauce.
Top with lettuce, tomato, onion, and jalapeño.

title: Choripan
instructions: Grill the chorizo sausages to desired doneness.
Assemble the choripan with sausage, chimichurri sauce, lettuce, tomato, and onion.

title: Alfajores
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Prepare the cookie dough and bake for 15 minutes.
Sandwich a dollop of dulce de leche between two cookies and dust with powdered sugar.

title: Asado
instructions: Brown the short ribs in a hot skillet.
Transfer to a Dutch oven and add beef broth, red wine, olive oil, garlic, oregano, and cumin.
Braise in the oven at 300°F for 2 hours.

title: Fainá
instructions: Whisk together chickpea flour, water, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour in the fainá mixture and cook until the bottom is crispy.

title: Feijoada
ingredients: 1 pound dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained
1 pound smoked pork neck or bacon, cut into large pieces
2 pounds beef brisket or shank, cut into large pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large pot, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beef and pork, and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the beans, tomatoes, cumin, oregano, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2-3 hours, or until the beans are tender.
Serve the feijoada hot, garnished with farofa and cilantro.

title: Churrasco-Style Grilled Skirt Steak
ingredients: 1 pound skirt steak, trimmed of excess fat
Salt and black pepper, to taste
4-6 wooden skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: In a small bowl, combine the garlic, oil, lime juice, cumin, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Add the steak to the marinade and mix to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight.
Preheat a grill to medium-high heat. Thread the steak onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the steak for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Transfer the steak to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

title: Açaí Bowl
instructions: In a blender, combine the açaí berries and mixed berries. Blend until smooth.
Transfer the mixture to a bowl. Top with granola, mint, banana, and honey.
Drizzle with coconut milk and sprinkle with protein powder, if using.
Garnish with fresh fruit and serve immediately.

title: Pão de Queijo
ingredients: 1/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese, for topping
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, and Parmesan cheese.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg, milk, and melted butter.
Add the egg mixture to the flour mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8-10 pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Place the disks onto the prepared baking sheet and top each with a sprinkle of Parmesan cheese.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Moqueca de Peixe
ingredients: 1 pound fish (such as cod or tilapia), cut into large pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the fish and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, fish broth, cumin, oregano, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10-15 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through.
Serve the moqueca hot, garnished with cilantro.

title: Asado de Tira de Asado
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Season the short ribs with salt, black pepper, oregano, cumin, and smoked paprika.
Grill the short ribs for 5 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the short ribs to a large Dutch oven, add garlic, red wine, beef broth, and olive oil.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer to the grill for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Serve with sliced onion and bell peppers.

title: Choripan
instructions: Grill the chorizo sausages until browned, about 5 minutes per side.
Split the bread rolls in half and toast until crispy.
Assemble the choripan by placing a sausage on each roll, topping with onion, tomato, and chimichurri sauce.
Garnish with chopped lettuce and serve.

title: Empanadas de Carne
instructions: In a large bowl, combine beef, onion, cheddar cheese, egg, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Divide the empanada dough into 8 equal pieces and roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture in the center of each circle and fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape.
Seal the edges with a fork and brush with vegetable oil.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Chorillo con Papas Arrugadas
instructions: Season the beef brisket with salt, black pepper, oregano, and smoked paprika.
In a large Dutch oven, heat oil over medium heat and brown the beef on all sides.
Add onions, garlic, beef broth, and red wine to the Dutch oven and bring to a boil.
Transfer the Dutch oven to the oven and braise for 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender.
Add the potatoes to the Dutch oven and continue to braise for another 30 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.

title: Dulce de Leche Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F.
In a medium bowl, mix together graham cracker crumbs and sugar.
Add the melted butter and mix until well combined.
Press the mixture into the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan.
In a large bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Beat in vanilla extract.
Pour the cheesecake batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top.
Bake for 50-60 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center is slightly jiggly.
Let cool completely before topping with dulce de leche and whipped cream.

title: Lomo Saltado
ingredients: 2 pounds beef strips, sliced into thin strips
1 cup French fries, cut into small pieces
2 cups mixed vegetables (e.g. carrots, peas, corn)
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from the wok and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the wok.
Add the chopped onions and minced garlic and cook until the onions are translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the diced tomatoes and cooked French fries to the wok and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Return the cooked beef to the wok and stir in the soy sauce, vinegar, and black pepper.
Add the mixed vegetables to the wok and stir-fry for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the Lomo Saltado over a bed of cooked rice.

title: Aji de Gallina
ingredients: 2 pounds chicken breast, cooked and shredded
2 tablespoons aji amarillo pepper paste (or substitute with hot sauce)
instructions: In a blender or food processor, puree the cooked potatoes, onion, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Heat the butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the potato mixture to the saucepan and stir in the heavy cream and grated queso fresco.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the shredded chicken and aji amarillo pepper paste.
Serve the Aji de Gallina hot over cooked rice or noodles.

title: Anticuchos
ingredients: 1 pound beef heart, cut into small pieces
10 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: In a bowl, whisk together the vinegar, soy sauce, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the beef heart pieces to the marinade and mix well.
Thread the marinated beef onto the bamboo skewers.
Grill the anticuchos over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve the Anticuchos hot with a side of salsa criolla or chimichurri sauce.

title: Ceviche Clásico
ingredients: 1 pound raw fish (e.g. halibut, sea bass), cut into small pieces
1 aji amarillo pepper, seeded and chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the fish pieces and lime juice.
Mix well and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or until the fish is opaque and cooked through.
Just before serving, stir in the chopped red onion, cilantro, and aji amarillo pepper.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the Ceviche Clásico chilled, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.

title: Tamales de Pollo
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the masa harina and chicken broth until well combined.
Add the lard or shortening and mix until the dough comes together.
Knead the dough for 5-10 minutes until it is pliable and smooth.
To assemble the tamales, spread a tablespoon of the dough onto the center of a corn husk.
Place a tablespoon of the shredded chicken in the center of the dough.
Add a sprinkle of cilantro, scallions, and queso fresco on top of the chicken.
Fold the sides of the corn husk over the filling and fold the top over to form a triangle.
Steam the tamales over boiling water for 1-2 hours, or until the dough is firm and the filling is hot.

title: Ajiaco
instructions: Place the chicken in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and cook until the chicken is tender, about 20 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside. Add the potatoes, onion, garlic, and tomato to the pot. Cook until the potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, cream, aji amarillo pepper paste, and cooked chicken to the pot. Simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.

title: Empanadas
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded beef or chicken, cooked
instructions: Combine the flour and salt in a bowl. Add the shortening and, using a pastry blender, work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the warm water to the flour mixture and stir until a dough forms. Knead the dough for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces. Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the shredded beef or chicken in the center of each circle. Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-circle and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten egg mixed with water. Bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.

title: Lechona
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
Add the shredded pork and cooked rice to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is heated through. Serve hot.

title: Sancocho
ingredients: 2 pounds beef or pork, cut into large pieces
instructions: In a large pot, combine the beef or pork, beef broth, water, onion, garlic, carrot, potato, and zucchini. Bring to a boil and cook for 1 hour.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour, or until the meat is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.

title: Tamales
instructions: Combine the masa harina and lard or shortening in a bowl. Gradually add the chicken broth and stir until the mixture forms a dough. Knead the dough for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces. Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the shredded chicken in the center of each circle. Fold the dough over the filling to form a cylinder and press the edges together to seal.
Steam the tamales for 1 hour, or until the dough is tender. Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.

title: Pastel de Choclo
ingredients: 2 cups ground beef, cooked and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, onion, garlic, corn kernels, mayonnaise, cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, cilantro, olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Mix well and set aside.
In a separate bowl, mix together 2 cups of milk and 2 large eggs.
Pour the milk mixture into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Add the beef mixture on top and smooth out.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the top is golden brown.

title: Chupe de Mariscos
ingredients: 1 pound squid, cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Add mussels, clams, shrimp, and squid, and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add fish broth, white wine, tomato paste, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley.

title: Choripan
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Grill chorizos for 2-3 minutes per side, or until slightly charred.
Meanwhile, toast bread rolls on the grill.
Spread mayonnaise and salsa criolla on toasted bread rolls.
Top with grilled chorizos, onion, and tomato slices.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Paila de Mariscos
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Add mussels, clams, and shrimp, and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add fish broth, white wine, tomato paste, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley.

title: Pastel de Choclo con Pollo
ingredients: 2 cups ground beef, cooked and drained
1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast, cooked and diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, onion, garlic, corn kernels, mayonnaise, cheddar cheese, mozzarella cheese, cilantro, olive oil, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Mix well and set aside.
Add diced chicken to the beef mixture and mix well.
In a separate bowl, mix together 2 cups of milk and 2 large eggs.
Pour the milk mixture into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Add the beef mixture on top and smooth out.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the top is golden brown.

title: Pabellón Criollo
ingredients: 1 pound beef brisket, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sear beef until browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer beef to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, cook onion and garlic until softened.
Add beef broth, cumin, and oregano; bring to a boil.
Return beef to the skillet and simmer until cooked through.
Serve beef over rice, topped with shredded beef, eggs, cheese, and cilantro.

title: Cachapas
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cornmeal and water; stir to form a dough.
Heat oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop dough into skillet.
Cook cachapas until golden brown and crispy, about 4 minutes per side.
Serve warm, topped with cheese, cilantro, and salt.

title: Carne Guisada
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Sear beef until browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer beef to a plate and set aside.
In the same Dutch oven, cook onion and garlic until softened.
Add beef broth, tomato paste, cumin, and oregano; bring to a boil.
Return beef to the Dutch oven and simmer until cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.

title: Tostones
instructions: Peel plantains and cut into 1-inch slices.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Fry plantain slices until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Using a plate or a tostonera, press plantain slices to flatten.
Serve tostones hot, sprinkled with salt.

title: Arepa de Queso
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cornmeal and cheese; stir to form a dough.
Heat oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop dough into skillet.
Cook arepa until golden brown and crispy, about 4 minutes per side.
Serve warm, topped with cilantro and salt.

title: Locro de Papas
ingredients: 1 large corn on the cob, cut into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic, cumin, and paprika; cook for 1 minute.
Add potatoes, yucca, and corn; cook for 5 minutes.
Add beef broth and milk; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer until vegetables are tender.
Stir in queso fresco; serve hot.

title: Seco de Carne
ingredients: 2 pounds beef brisket or beef shank, cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and pepper; cook for 1 minute.
Add beef broth and water; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer until meat is tender.
Stir in cilantro; serve hot.

title: Ensalada de Patacones
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add plantains and cook until flat and crispy, about 5 minutes per side.
Season with salt; set aside.
In a large bowl, combine cilantro, parsley, and lime juice.
Add avocado and mixed greens; toss to combine.
Serve with patacones.

title: Ceviche de Camarones
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: In a large bowl, combine shrimp and lime juice; marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Add onion, cilantro, parsley, and cumin; stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Serve with chopped tomato.

title: Empanadas de Queso
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour and salt.
Add shortening and use a pastry blender to work into flour until crumbly.
Gradually add queso fresco and mix until dough forms.
Divide dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly.
Brush edges with egg and fold in half to form a half-moon shape.
Fry in hot oil until golden brown and crispy.

title: Asado de Tira
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, mix together garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the mixture all over the beef short ribs.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the beef short ribs for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the meat rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve with chimichurri sauce.

title: Chivito de Uruguayo
instructions: Grill the skirt steak to desired level of doneness.
Meanwhile, toast the bread.
Assemble the sandwich by spreading mayonnaise on the bread, then layering with steak, arugula, tomatoes, onion, ham, and mozzarella cheese.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic and paprika.
Serve immediately.

title: Choripan
instructions: Grill the chorizo sausages until browned and crispy.
Meanwhile, toast the bread rolls.
Assemble the choripan by spreading chimichurri sauce on the bread, then layering with chorizo, onion, and tomatoes.
Serve immediately.

title: Alfajores
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, confectioners' sugar, and salt.
Add the softened butter and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until lightly golden.
Allow the cookies to cool completely before assembling the alfajores.
Spread a layer of dulce de leche on one cookie, then top with another cookie.
Dust with confectioners' sugar.

title: Fainá
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together chickpea flour and water.
Add the olive oil and garlic, and mix until smooth.
Season with salt to taste.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Pour in the fainá mixture and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the bottom is lightly browned.
Flip the fainá and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the other side is lightly browned.
Serve hot.

title: Feijoada
ingredients: 1 pound dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained
1 pound beef brisket or shank, cut into large pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, for garnish
instructions: In a large pot, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the soaked and drained black beans, pork neck bones, beef, cumin, oregano, salt, and black pepper. Pour in enough water to cover the ingredients.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beans are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.

title: Churrasco-Style Grilled Skirt Steak with Salsa Verde
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
For the salsa verde: 1 cup chopped fresh cilantro, 1 cup chopped scallions, 2 cups chopped fresh parsley
2 cups chopped fresh tomatoes, 2 cloves garlic, minced, 2 tablespoons freshly squeezed lime juice, Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lime juice, garlic, and oregano. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Rub the mixture all over the skirt steak, making sure to coat it evenly.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Grill the steak for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
For the salsa verde, combine all the ingredients in a food processor and process until coarsely chopped.

title: Acarajé (Fried Bean Fritters)
ingredients: 2 cups dried black beans, soaked overnight and drained
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Drain and rinse the soaked black beans. In a blender or food processor, blend the beans with the oil, garlic, ginger, cilantro, and scallions until coarsely chopped.
Using your hands, shape the bean mixture into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Heat about 2-3 inches of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. When the oil is hot, add the bean balls and fry until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and drain on paper towels.

title: Moqueca (Fish Stew)
ingredients: 1 pound firm white fish, such as sea bass or halibut
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the fish and cook, stirring occasionally, until cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cilantro, scallions, coconut milk, and fish broth. Stir to combine.
Simmer the stew over low heat for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened slightly.

title: Pão de Queijo (Cheese Bread)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, Parmesan, mozzarella, and cheddar cheese.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter, egg, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.

title: Asado de Tira
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Season beef short ribs with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Grill short ribs for 5 minutes per side, or until browned.
Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Choripan
instructions: Grill chorizos until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Split bread rolls in half and toast on grill.
Spread mayonnaise on bottom half of bread roll.
Top with chorizo, red onion, and cilantro.
Drizzle with chimichurri sauce and serve.

title: Empanadas
instructions: Combine flour and salt in a bowl.
Add lard or shortening and mix until crumbly.
Gradually add warm water and mix until dough forms.
Knead dough for 5 minutes.
Roll out dough to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut out circles of dough and fill with beef, cheese, and parsley.
Fold dough in half and press edges to seal.
Fry empanadas until golden brown.

title: Locro
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add pork and beef and cook until browned.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Add hominy, diced tomatoes, and beef broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in cilantro and serve.

title: Provoleta
instructions: Preheat grill to medium heat.
Cut provolone cheese in half and place on grill.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic, parsley, and paprika.
Grill for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

title: Swedish Meatballs (Köttbullar)
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef, mixed with 1/2 pound ground pork, 1 onion finely chopped, 2 cloves garlic minced, 1 egg, 1/2 cup milk, 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg, 2 tablespoons butter
2 cups beef broth, 2 tablespoons heavy cream
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground beef, pork, onion, garlic, egg, milk, flour, salt, pepper, and nutmeg. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small meatballs, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Place the coated meatballs on a plate or tray.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat. Add the meatballs and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Transfer the meatballs to a large saucepan and add the beef broth and heavy cream. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 10-15 minutes or until the meatballs are cooked through.
Serve the meatballs with the sauce and additional butter on top.

title: Norwegian Fattigmann (Poor Man's Cookies)
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup confectioners' sugar, 1/4 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened, 1 large egg, 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, confectioners' sugar, granulated sugar, and salt.
In a large bowl, use an electric mixer to beat the butter until creamy. Add the egg and vanilla extract, and mix until combined.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, and mix until a dough forms.
Using a cookie press or a piping bag, pipe the dough into long, thin strips onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until the cookies are golden brown. Allow to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

title: Danish Flæskesteg (Pork Roast with Crackling)
ingredients: 2 pounds pork shoulder, skin on, 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard, 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme
1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, 1/2 teaspoon caraway seeds
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil.
Score the skin of the pork shoulder in a crisscross pattern, cutting about 1/4 inch deep.
Rub the skin with brown sugar, mustard, thyme, salt, pepper, and caraway seeds.
Place the pork shoulder on the prepared baking sheet, skin side up.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the skin is golden brown and crispy.
Reduce the oven temperature to 350°F (180°C) and continue roasting for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through.

title: Finnish Karjalanpiirakka (Karelian Pasties)
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/4 cup cold unsalted butter, 1/4 cup ice water
1/2 cup rye flour, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup caraway seeds, 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill
1 cup potato filling (see below), 1 egg, beaten (for egg wash)
instructions: To make the dough, combine the all-purpose flour and salt in a large bowl. Add the cold butter and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add the ice water, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead a few times until smooth.
Divide the dough in half and roll out each half to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Using a pastry cutter or a knife, cut out circles of dough. Place a tablespoon or two of the potato filling in the center of each circle.
Brush the edges with the beaten egg and fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape. Press the edges together to seal.

title: Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef, 1/2 pound ground pork, 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, 1 onion, finely chopped, 2 cloves garlic, minced, 1 egg, 1/2 cup milk, 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, 2 teaspoons paprika, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, 2 tablespoons butter, 2 cups beef broth
1 cup heavy cream, 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard, 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix the ground beef, pork, breadcrumbs, onion, garlic, egg, milk, flour, paprika, salt, and pepper in a large bowl until just combined.
Form the mixture into small meatballs and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the meatballs for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the meatballs are baking, melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the beef broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Once the meatballs are done, add them to the skillet and simmer for a few minutes to coat in the sauce.
Stir in the heavy cream and mustard, and cook until the sauce has thickened slightly.
Serve the meatballs hot, garnished with parsley.

title: Swedish Meatballs (Köttbullar)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine ground beef, pork, onion, garlic, egg, and 1/2 cup flour in a large bowl. Mix well.
Roll meat mixture into small balls, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place meatballs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
While meatballs are baking, melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add 2 tablespoons flour and whisk to make a roux, cooking for 1 minute.
Slowly add beef broth, whisking continuously.
Bring mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes or until thickened.
Add cooked meatballs to the sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve hot with lingonberry jam and boiled potatoes.

title: Norwegian Fattigmann (Poor Man's Cookies)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Whisk together flour and confectioners' sugar in a medium bowl.
Add softened butter and mix until a dough forms.
Beat in powdered sugar, eggs, vanilla extract, and salt.
Drop dough by tablespoonfuls onto a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until lightly golden.
Allow cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.

title: Danish Kransekage (Wreath Cake)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
Whisk together ground almonds and confectioners' sugar in a large bowl.
Add softened butter and mix until a dough forms.
Beat in egg whites, almond extract, and salt.
Drop dough by tablespoonfuls onto a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until lightly golden.
Allow cakes to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack.
Assemble the wreath by stacking the cakes and spreading marzipan in between.
Top with whipped cream and decorate with chopped almonds.

title: Finnish Karjalanpiirakka (Karelian Pasties)
ingredients: 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine flour, cold butter, and ice water in a large bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Roll out dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a spoonful of rye flour, caraway seeds, potatoes, and onion in the center of each dough circle.
Brush edges with beaten egg and fold dough in half to form a triangle.
Press edges to seal and crimp with a fork.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve with sour cream.

title: Icelandic Hangikjöt (Smoked and Cured Lamb)
instructions: Combine kosher salt, brown sugar, pink curing salt, black pepper, mustard seeds, coriander seeds, and dill seeds in a large bowl.
Rub the cure mixture all over the lamb, making sure to coat evenly.
Place the lamb on a wire rack set over a rimmed baking sheet or a tray.
Let the lamb cure in the refrigerator for 7-10 days, turning every day.
After curing, rinse the lamb under cold running water to remove excess cure.
Soak the lamb in water for 30 minutes to remove excess salt.
Smoke the lamb over low heat for 2-3 hours or until the internal temperature reaches 160°F (71°C).

title: Swedish Meatballs (Köttbullar)
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef, 1/2 pound ground pork
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, ground pork, onion, garlic, egg, flour, milk, melted butter, salt, pepper, and nutmeg. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into small meatballs, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter. Place the meatballs on a plate or tray and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat a couple of tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat. Roll the meatballs in flour to coat, shaking off excess.
When the oil is hot, add the meatballs and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes. Transfer the meatballs to a baking dish.
Pour the beef broth over the meatballs and transfer to the oven. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the meatballs are cooked through.
In a small bowl, whisk together heavy cream and Dijon mustard. Stir the cream mixture into the meatballs and serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.

title: Norwegian Fattigmann Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, confectioners' sugar, and salt.
Add the softened butter to the dry ingredients and mix until the dough comes together.
Beat in the granulated sugar and eggs until smooth.
Stir in the vanilla extract.
Using a piping bag or a plastic bag with a corner cut off, pipe the dough into long, thin strips, about 1/4 inch wide.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the edges are golden brown.
Dust with confectioners' sugar and serve.

title: Danish Rugbrød
instructions: In a large bowl, combine rye flour, all-purpose flour, brown sugar, caraway seeds, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together warm water and yeast. Let it sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
Add the yeast mixture and melted butter to the dry ingredients. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10-15 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1-2 hours or until doubled in size.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Punch down the dough and shape into a round or oblong loaf. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the bread is golden brown.

title: Finnish Karjalanpiirakka (Karelian Pasties)
ingredients: 1/4 cup cold unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
Filling ingredients: 1 cup rye flour, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, 1/2 cup milk, 1 egg, Salt to taste
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all-purpose flour, rye flour, and cold butter. Mix until the dough comes together.
Gradually add the warm water and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10-15 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4-6 equal pieces, depending on how large you want your pasties to be.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon or two of the filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the pasty.
Brush the tops with beaten egg and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Icelandic Hákarl (Fermented Shark)
instructions: Rinse the fermented shark under cold running water to remove excess salt.
Cut the shark into small cubes.
Serve the shark with a cube of ice and a shot of Brennivín (Icelandic schnapps) to help mask the smell and flavor.
Note: Hákarl is a traditional Icelandic dish, but it may not be suitable for everyone due to its strong smell and flavor.

title: Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef, 1/2 pound ground pork
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix the ground meats, onion, garlic, egg, flour, milk, salt, pepper, and nutmeg in a large bowl.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Use a small ice cream scoop or your hands to shape the mixture into meatballs.
Place the meatballs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Dot the top of each meatball with butter.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Serve with lingonberry jam and lingonberry sauce.

title: Norwegian Fattigmann (Poor Man's Cookies)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the flour and confectioners' sugar in a medium bowl.
Add the softened butter and mix until a dough forms.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla extract until smooth.
Drop the dough by tablespoonfuls onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until lightly golden.

title: Danish Rugbrød (Rye Bread)
instructions: Mix the flours, salt, sugar, and yeast in a large bowl.
Gradually add the warm water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Punch down the dough and shape into a round or oblong loaf.
Place the loaf on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until dark brown.

title: Finnish Karjalanpiirakka (Karelian Pasties)
ingredients: 1/4 cup cold unsalted butter, cut into small pieces
instructions: Mix the flours and cold butter in a medium bowl until a crumbly mixture forms.
Gradually add the ice-cold water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of mashed potatoes, grated carrots, and chopped dill in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops with beaten egg and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Icelandic Laufabrauð (Leaf Bread)
instructions: Mix the flours and softened butter in a medium bowl until a crumbly mixture forms.
Gradually add the ice-cold water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out intricate designs using a pastry cutter or a sharp knife.
Place the designs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with beaten egg and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 10-12 minutes or until lightly golden.

title: Swedish Meatballs (Köttbullar)
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef, 1/2 pound ground pork
1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley, salt, and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine beef, pork, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic, and milk. Mix well.
Shape into small meatballs and place on a baking sheet.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
While meatballs are baking, melt butter in a saucepan.
Add flour and whisk until smooth. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly add beef broth, whisking constantly. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 2-3 minutes or until sauce thickens.
Serve meatballs with the sauce.

title: Norwegian Fattigmann (Poor Man's Cookies)
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup confectioners' sugar
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine flour, confectioners' sugar, and baking powder in a bowl.
Add softened butter and mix until crumbly.
Beat in egg and milk until a dough forms.
Drop spoonfuls of dough onto the prepared baking sheet.
Bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown.
Drizzle with vanilla glaze (optional).

title: Danish Rugbrød (Rye Bread)
ingredients: 1 cup rye flour, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour
1/2 teaspoon salt, 1/4 teaspoon active dry yeast
1 cup warm water, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
instructions: Combine rye flour, all-purpose flour, caraway seeds, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
Add yeast and mix until combined.
Gradually add warm water and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover with a damp cloth.
Let rise in a warm place for 1-2 hours or until doubled in size.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Shape the dough into a round or oblong loaf.
Place on a baking sheet and bake for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Finnish Karjalanpiirakka (Karelian Pasties)
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter
Filling ingredients: 1 cup potato, 1/2 cup rice, 1/4 cup onion, 1/4 cup egg
instructions: Combine flour, cold butter, and ice water in a bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut into circles or use a cookie cutter.
Place a tablespoon of filling in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough in half and press edges to seal.
Brush with egg and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Icelandic Hangikjöt (Smoked and Braised Lamb Shanks)
ingredients: 2 tablespoons smoked paprika, 2 tablespoons olive oil
2 cloves garlic, minced, 1/4 cup red wine
1/4 cup lamb or beef broth, salt, and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C).
Season lamb shanks with salt, pepper, and smoked paprika.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shanks until browned on all sides.
Add brown sugar, garlic, red wine, and broth to the pot.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise for 2-3 hours or until the lamb is tender and falls off the bone.
Serve with the braising liquid.

title: Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef, 1/2 pound ground pork, 1 onion, finely chopped, 2 cloves garlic, minced, 1 egg, 1/2 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup milk, 1/4 cup beef broth, 2 tablespoons butter, melted, Salt and pepper, 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, 2 tablespoons butter, 1 cup heavy cream, 1 cup beef broth, 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard, Chopped fresh parsley, for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large mixing bowl, combine ground beef, ground pork, onion, garlic, egg, flour, milk, beef broth, and melted butter. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Shape the mixture into small meatballs, about 1 1/2 inches (3.8 cm) in diameter.
Place the meatballs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 12-15 minutes.
While the meatballs are baking, make the gravy. Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly pour in the heavy cream and beef broth, whisking constantly.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it thickens.
Stir in the Dijon mustard and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the meatballs with the gravy spooned over the top and garnished with chopped parsley.

title: Norwegian Fårikål
ingredients: 2 pounds lamb or mutton, cut into 2-inch (5 cm) pieces, 1 large onion, chopped, 2 cloves garlic, minced, 2 carrots, peeled and chopped, 2 potatoes, peeled and chopped, 2 cups lamb or beef broth, 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour, 2 tablespoons butter, Salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C).
In a large Dutch oven, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the lamb or mutton and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, garlic, carrots, and potatoes to the pot.
Pour in the lamb or beef broth and add the flour, thyme, and parsley.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2-3 hours, or until the meat is tender and the vegetables are cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with additional thyme and parsley if desired.

title: Danish Kransekage
ingredients: 1 cup almond paste, softened, 1 cup confectioners' sugar, 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened, 4 large egg whites, 2 teaspoons almond extract, 1 cup chopped almonds
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C).
In a large mixing bowl, combine the almond paste, confectioners' sugar, and butter.
Beat in the egg whites and almond extract until smooth.
Stir in the chopped almonds.
Drop the dough by tablespoonfuls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden.
Allow the cakes to cool completely on a wire rack.
Melt the chocolate chips in a double boiler or in the microwave in 30-second increments, stirring between each interval until smooth.
Dip the top of each cake into the melted chocolate and place on a serving plate.

title: Finnish Karjalanpiirakka (Karelian Pasties)
ingredients: 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, 1/4 cup cold water, 1 egg, beaten, 1/2 cup rye flour, 1/2 cup rice flour, 1/4 cup cold unsalted butter, 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese, 1/4 cup chopped fresh dill
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the all-purpose flour, cold butter, and water.
Mix until a dough forms, then turn it out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough in half and roll out each half into a thin sheet.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
In a small bowl, mix together the rye flour, rice flour, and cold butter until crumbly.
Spoon a small amount of the rye mixture onto one half of each dough circle, leaving a 1/2-inch (1.3 cm) border around the edges.
Top with a sprinkle of cheddar cheese and a few chopped fresh dill.
Fold the other half of the dough circle over the filling and press the edges together to seal.
Use a fork to crimp the edges and create a decorative border.

title: Icelandic Hákarl
ingredients: 1 pound fermented shark meat, sliced into thin pieces, 1/4 cup finely chopped onion, 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh parsley, 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh dill, 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, Salt and pepper
instructions: Rinse the shark meat under cold running water to remove excess salt.
Pat the shark meat dry with paper towels.
In a small bowl, mix together the chopped onion, parsley, and dill.
Add the butter to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Arrange the shark meat slices on a serving plate or platter.
Sprinkle the onion mixture over the top of the shark meat.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Hákarl at room temperature, garnished with crumbled Icelandic cheese and chopped chives if desired.

title: Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef, 1/2 pound ground pork, 1 onion, finely chopped, 2 cloves garlic, minced, 1 egg, 1/2 cup milk, 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice
2 tablespoons butter, 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1 cup beef broth, 1 cup heavy cream
instructions: Combine ground meats, onion, garlic, egg, milk, flour, salt, pepper, and allspice. Mix well and shape into meatballs.
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add meatballs and cook until browned on all sides.
Remove meatballs from skillet and set aside.
Add flour to skillet and whisk to combine. Cook for 1 minute.
Gradually add beef broth and heavy cream, whisking continuously.
Return meatballs to skillet and simmer until sauce thickens.

title: Swedish Meatballs
ingredients: 1 pound ground beef, 1/2 cup breadcrumbs, 1 onion, finely chopped, 2 cloves garlic, minced, 1 egg, 1/2 cup milk, 1 tablespoon all-purpose flour, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon black pepper, 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine ground beef, breadcrumbs, onion, garlic, egg, milk, flour, salt, pepper, and nutmeg in a large bowl.
Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Use your hands to shape mixture into small meatballs.
Place meatballs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add meatballs to skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Add beef broth, heavy cream, mustard, and Worcestershire sauce to skillet.
Simmer for 2-3 minutes or until sauce has thickened slightly.

title: Norwegian Fårikål (Lamb and Cabbage Stew)
