Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.

title: Tom Yum Goong
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Combine fish stock and water in a large saucepan.
Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to medium and add oil.
Saute chilies, garlic, and ginger until fragrant.
Add tom yum paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Add fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar, cilantro, lime leaves, and lemongrass.
Season with white pepper to taste.
Serve immediately.

title: Khao Soi
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Saute onions, garlic, and ginger until fragrant.
Add beef and cook until browned.
Add curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef broth, coconut milk, soy sauce, fish sauce, palm sugar, cumin, coriander, turmeric, and cayenne pepper.
Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add boiled egg noodles to the saucepan.
Toss to coat noodles with the curry sauce.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.

title: Massaman Curry
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Saute onions, garlic, and ginger until fragrant.
Add beef and cook until browned.
Add curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef broth, coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar, soy sauce, cumin, coriander, turmeric, and cayenne pepper.
Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add potatoes to the saucepan.
Simmer for an additional 10 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro, peanuts, and serve.

title: Satay
ingredients: 1 pound beef, chicken, or pork, sliced
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Thread beef, garlic, and ginger onto bamboo skewers.
Mix coconut milk, soy sauce, palm sugar, fish sauce, and lime juice in a bowl.
Brush mixture onto the skewers.
Grill the skewers for 5-7 minutes per side.
Serve with cilantro, peanuts, and lime leaves.

title: Kanom Buang
ingredients: 1 cup bean paste or sweetened red bean paste
instructions: Combine flour, coconut milk, sugar, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
Mix until a smooth batter forms.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup of the batter into the skillet.
Top with 1 tablespoon of bean paste.
Fold the batter over the filling to form a half-moon shape.
Fry until golden brown and serve with shredded coconut.

title: Khao Soi
ingredients: 2 cups braising liquid (chicken or beef stock)
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and cook the meat until browned.
Add garlic and ginger and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add the braising liquid, fish sauce, soy sauce, and palm sugar.
Simmer the mixture for 10 minutes.
Add the boiled noodles and cook for 2 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and crispy fried noodles.

title: Massaman Curry
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and cook the meat until browned.
Add onions, garlic, and ginger and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add the curry paste and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk, beef broth, fish sauce, and palm sugar.
Simmer the mixture for 10 minutes.
Garnish with chopped peanuts.

title: Satay
instructions: Marinate the meat in coconut milk, garlic, ginger, coriander powder, and cumin powder for 30 minutes.
Thread the meat onto skewers.
Grill the skewers until cooked through.
Serve with peanut sauce and garnish with chopped peanuts.

title: Tom Kha Kai
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and cook the chicken until browned.
Add garlic and ginger and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk, chicken broth, curry paste, fish sauce, and lime juice.
Simmer the mixture for 5 minutes.
Garnish with chopped cilantro.

title: Khao Niew Mamuang
instructions: Cook the sticky rice according to package instructions.
Mix palm sugar and coconut milk in a pan and heat until sugar dissolves.
Serve the sticky rice with mango slices and palm sugar sauce.
Garnish with chopped cilantro.

title: Khao Pad Sapparod (Stir-fried Rice with Vegetables)
ingredients: 2 cups cooked Thai jasmine rice, day-old
1 cup mixed vegetables (e.g., peas, carrots, corn)
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic; stir-fry until onion is translucent.
Add mixed vegetables; stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Push vegetables to one side of the wok.
Add cooked rice to the other side of the wok; stir-fry until combined.
Return vegetables to the wok; stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Season with soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar.
Serve hot garnished with cilantro.

title: Tom Yum Goong (Spicy Shrimp Soup)
ingredients: 1 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add garlic and ginger; stir-fry until fragrant.
Add curry paste; stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add chicken broth, water, and mushrooms; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; simmer for 5 minutes.
Add shrimp; cook until pink and cooked through.
Season with fish sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar.
Serve hot garnished with lime wedges and cilantro.

title: Khao Soi (Curried Noodle Soup)
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add garlic and ginger; stir-fry until fragrant.
Add curry paste; stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add beef broth and coconut milk; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; simmer for 10 minutes.
Add beef or pork; cook until cooked through.
Serve over egg noodles; garnish with crispy fried noodles and cilantro.

title: Massaman Curry (Rich Beef Curry)
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add garlic and ginger; stir-fry until fragrant.
Add curry paste; stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add beef broth and coconut milk; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; simmer for 10 minutes.
Add beef or pork; cook until cooked through.
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar.
Serve hot garnished with peanuts and cilantro.

title: Khao Niew Mamuang (Mango with Sticky Rice)
instructions: Rinse sticky rice in a fine mesh sieve until water runs clear.
Combine sticky rice and water in a saucepan; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; simmer for 15-20 minutes or until rice is cooked.
Combine coconut milk, sugar, and salt in a saucepan; heat over low heat.
Serve cooked sticky rice with coconut milk sauce and sliced mango.

title: Khao Soi
ingredients: 1 pound boiled egg noodles, 1/2 cup vegetable oil, 4 cloves garlic, minced, 2 medium onions, chopped, 2 pounds braised beef or pork, shredded, 2 cups braising liquid, 2 cups water, 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 2 tablespoons fish sauce, 1 tablespoon palm sugar, 1 teaspoon ground cumin, 1 teaspoon ground coriander, 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder, 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper, 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, 2 cups mixed vegetables (bean sprouts, cabbage, carrots, bok choy), 4 cups bean sprouts, 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro, 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint, 1/4 cup crispy fried noodles, 1/4 cup crispy fried shallots
2 cups mixed vegetables, 1 cup bean sprouts
1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro, 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint, 1/4 cup crispy fried noodles, 1/4 cup crispy fried shallots
instructions: Cook the egg noodles according to the package instructions.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and onions and cook until fragrant.
Add the braised beef or pork, braising liquid, water, soy sauce, fish sauce, palm sugar, cumin, coriander, turmeric powder, cayenne pepper, and black pepper. Bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the mixed vegetables and bean sprouts. Cook for an additional 5 minutes.
To serve, place the cooked noodles in a bowl and add the braised beef or pork mixture on top. Garnish with cilantro, mint, crispy fried noodles, and crispy fried shallots.

title: Khao Soi
ingredients: 1 pound braised beef or pork, sliced
2 cups braising liquid (beef or pork stock)
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add onions and cook until softened.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add braised beef or pork and cook until heated through.
Add braising liquid, coconut milk, curry paste, cumin, coriander, turmeric powder, salt, and pepper. Stir well.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-15 minutes.
Add cooked noodles to the pan and stir well.
Add bean sprouts and stir-fry until they are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with cilantro.

title: Miang Kham
instructions: Prepare all ingredients according to their individual needs.
To assemble the dish, place a small amount of sticky rice on a leaf.
Add a few pieces of each ingredient on top of the rice.
Drizzle with fish sauce and lime juice.
Serve immediately and eat with your hands.

title: Pad Thai
ingredients: 1 cup rice noodles, soaked in water
1 cup mixed vegetables (bean sprouts, carrots, green onions)
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions.
Heat oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic and stir-fry until softened.
Add mixed vegetables and cooked shrimp and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add tamarind paste, palm sugar, fish sauce, and soy sauce and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add cooked noodles and stir-fry until combined.
Transfer to a serving platter and garnish with peanuts, lime wedges, and cilantro.

title: Massaman Curry
ingredients: 1 cup beef or chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
2 potatoes, peeled and cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger and stir-fry until softened.
Add Massaman curry paste and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add coconut milk, broth, beef or chicken, potatoes, peanuts, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Season with salt to taste.
Garnish with cilantro leaves and serve with steamed rice.

title: Tom Yum Soup
ingredients: 4-6 dried red chilies, seeded and chopped
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chilies, garlic, and ginger and stir-fry until fragrant.
Add broth, water, mushrooms, and cooked chicken or shrimp.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Add fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar, and white pepper.
Season with salt to taste.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with lime wedges.

title: Satay
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs
instructions: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and thread onto skewers.
In a large bowl, whisk together coconut milk, oil, garlic, ginger, soy sauce, palm sugar, fish sauce, and white pepper.
Add chicken skewers to the marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat.
Grill chicken skewers for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve with peanut sauce, cucumber, carrots, and red bell pepper.

title: Khao Soi
ingredients: 2 cups braising liquid (beef or chicken broth, water, and spices)
1 pound braised beef or chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Cook noodles according to package instructions.
Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and stir-fry until softened.
Add curry paste and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add braising liquid, beef or chicken, and coconut milk.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Add cooked noodles and stir-fry until combined.
Season with cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, and salt to taste.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.

title: Khao Soi
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened.
Add garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add braised beef and cook for 2 minutes.
Add coconut milk and bring to a boil.
Add noodles, bean sprouts, cabbage, fish sauce, and lime juice.
Stir in cilantro and serve with crispy fried noodles and peanuts.

title: Khao Niew Mamuang
instructions: Cook sticky rice according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, combine coconut milk, palm sugar, and salt.
Bring to a boil and cook until thickened.
Serve sticky rice with mango slices, coconut milk mixture, and garnish with peanuts, sesame seeds, and lime juice.

title: Massaman Curry
ingredients: 2 pounds beef or chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened.
Add garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add Massaman curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add beef or chicken and cook until browned.
Add coconut milk, beef broth, fish sauce, and palm sugar.
Bring to a boil and cook until thickened.
Stir in peanuts and cilantro and serve.

title: Som Tam (Papaya Salad)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine papaya, peanuts, dried shrimp, and garlic.
Add fish sauce, lime juice, and palm sugar.
Toss to combine and adjust seasoning as needed.
Sprinkle with white pepper and serve.

title: Khanom Buang (Thai Crepes)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, water, sugar, salt, and baking powder.
Mix to form a smooth batter.
Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Pour in a small amount of batter and tilt to form a thin circle.
Add a small amount of coconut cream and sweetened red bean paste in the center.
Fold the crepe in half and cook until golden brown.
Serve with chopped peanuts.

title: Khao Niew Mamuang (Mango with Sticky Rice)
instructions: Rinse the glutinous rice thoroughly and soak it in water for 4 hours. Drain and cook in a steamer until fluffy.
In a saucepan, combine coconut milk, water, vegetable oil, salt, and sugar. Bring to a boil over medium heat.
Serve the sticky rice with sliced mango and coconut milk sauce.

title: Larb Moo (Spicy Minced Pork Salad)
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan and sauté the garlic and shallots until fragrant.
Add the minced pork and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, black pepper, cumin, paprika, and cayenne pepper. Stir to combine.
Mix in the cilantro, mint, mixed greens, and peanuts. Serve immediately.

title: Tom Yum Goong (Spicy Shrimp Soup)
ingredients: 500 grams large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Heat the oil in a pot and sauté the garlic, shallots, and lemongrass until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the water, coconut milk, ginger, fish sauce, lime juice, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and lime wedges. Serve immediately.

title: Khai Jiow (Thai-Style Omelette)
instructions: Beat the eggs in a bowl and set aside.
Heat the oil in a pan and sauté the cilantro, scallions, and ginger until fragrant.
Add the peanuts and diced chicken or pork and stir to combine.
Pour in the eggs and cook until the edges start to set.
Fold the omelette in half and cook for another minute. Serve hot.

title: Khao Pad (Thai-Style Fried Rice)
ingredients: 1 cup mixed vegetables (e.g. peas, carrots, corn)
1 cup diced cooked chicken or pork
instructions: Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add the mixed vegetables and cooked chicken or pork and stir to combine.
Push the ingredients to one side of the wok. Add a little more oil if necessary.
Pour in the beaten eggs and scramble them until cooked through.
Mix the eggs with the other ingredients. Add the cooked rice, soy sauce, fish sauce, and oyster sauce (if using). Stir-fry until everything is well combined. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Tom Yum Goong
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add garlic, lemongrass, and kaffir lime leaves, and cook until fragrant.
Add mixed seafood and cook until they start to change color.
Add mushrooms, tom yum paste, fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar, and white pepper.
Pour in water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in basil leaves and serve hot.

title: Massaman Curry with Beef
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until caramelized.
Add garlic, cinnamon, and cardamom, and cook until fragrant.
Add ginger and beef, and cook until the beef is browned.
Add Massaman curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper.
Season with salt to taste and serve hot.

title: Som Tam (Papaya Salad)
instructions: Shred papaya, carrots, and tomatoes into fine strips.
Heat a mortar and pestle over medium heat.
Add garlic and ginger, and pound until fragrant.
Add peanuts and pound until they are finely ground.
Add shredded vegetables and pound until they are well combined.
Add palm sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, white pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Season with salt to taste and serve hot.

title: Khao Soi (Curried Noodle Soup)
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until caramelized.
Add garlic, ginger, and beef or chicken, and cook until the meat is browned.
Add Khao Soi curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, and cayenne pepper.
Season with salt to taste and serve over egg noodles.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.

title: Khao Niew Mamuang (Mango with Sticky Rice)
instructions: Rinse sticky rice in a fine-mesh sieve until the water runs clear.
Combine sticky rice and water in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and creamy.
Stir in palm sugar, coconut milk, salt, cardamom, and cinnamon.
Serve with sliced mango and enjoy.

title: Khao Soi
ingredients: 2 tablespoons crispy fried noodles, for garnish
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and stir-fry until the onion is translucent.
Add the braised beef and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the braising liquid, coconut milk, curry paste, cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the cooked noodles to the wok and toss to combine.
Garnish with cilantro and crispy fried noodles.
Serve immediately.

title: Massaman Curry
ingredients: 2 pounds beef or chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the curry paste and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add the beef or chicken and stir-fry until browned.
Add the beef broth, coconut milk, potatoes, peanuts, fish sauce, palm sugar, cinnamon, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with cilantro.
Serve over steamed rice.

title: Tom Yum Goong
ingredients: 2 cups large shrimp, peeled and deveined
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine the water and coconut milk in a large pot.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add the mushrooms and shrimp and stir-fry until the shrimp are pink.
Add the garlic, lemongrass, and kaffir lime leaves and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add the Tom Yum paste, fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with cilantro.
Serve immediately.

title: Khao Niew Mamuang
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Combine the cooked sticky rice, coconut milk, palm sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Mix well to combine.
Serve the sticky rice mixture with sliced mango.
Garnish with cilantro.
Serve immediately.

title: Satay
ingredients: 1 pound pork or chicken, cut into thin strips
20 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: Combine the coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, ginger, coriander powder, cumin powder, turmeric powder, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Add the pork or chicken and mix well to combine.
Thread the meat onto the bamboo skewers.
Grill the satay over medium-high heat for 5-7 minutes per side.
Serve with peanut sauce and steamed rice.

title: Massaman Curry
ingredients: 1 pound beef or chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
2 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into bite-sized pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add garlic and ginger, cook until fragrant.
Add curry paste, cook for 1 minute.
Add beef broth, coconut milk, beef or chicken, potatoes, peanuts or cashews, fish sauce, brown sugar, cinnamon, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, simmer until potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro, if desired.

title: Khao Soi
ingredients: 1 pound braised beef or pork, sliced
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion, cook until softened.
Add garlic and ginger, cook until fragrant.
Add curry powder, cumin, coriander, turmeric powder, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, cook for 1 minute.
Add beef or pork broth and coconut milk, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, simmer until sauce thickens.
Cook egg noodles according to package instructions.
Combine noodles, braised beef or pork, bean sprouts, and chopped cabbage in a large bowl.
Pour sauce over the top, garnish with chopped cilantro and serve with lime wedges.

title: Som Tam (Papaya Salad)
ingredients: 2 cups long beans, cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Combine papaya, long beans, cherry tomatoes, peanuts or cashews, garlic, and ginger in a large bowl.
In a small bowl, mix together palm sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, and cayenne pepper.
Pour dressing over the papaya mixture, toss to combine.
Heat oil in a small pan over medium heat.
Add mixture, cook until slightly caramelized.
Season with salt to taste.

title: Khao Niew Mamuang (Mango with Sticky Rice)
instructions: Rinse rice thoroughly, soak in water for 4 hours or overnight.
Drain and cook rice according to package instructions.
Combine coconut milk, water, sugar, salt, and pandan extract in a saucepan.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, simmer until sauce thickens.
Serve sticky rice with sliced mango and garnish with fresh coconut flakes.

title: Satay
ingredients: 1 pound chicken or pork, cut into 1-inch pieces
Salt and black pepper, to taste
10 bamboo skewers, soaked in water for 30 minutes
instructions: In a large bowl, combine chicken or pork, coconut milk, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Thread pieces onto bamboo skewers.
Grill or broil satay until cooked through.
Serve with peanut sauce.

title: Khao Soi
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (bean sprouts, bok choy, carrots)
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Cook the egg noodles according to the package instructions.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the braised beef or pork and cook until heated through.
Add the mixed vegetables, beef broth, coconut milk, fish sauce, soy sauce, palm sugar, cumin, cinnamon, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Serve the khao soi hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and your choice of toppings.

title: Som Tam (Papaya Salad)
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (chili peppers, tomatoes, carrots, long beans)
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large mortar, pound the chilies, garlic, and ginger until well combined.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar, peanuts, cilantro, dried shrimp, and salt.
Pound the mixture until well combined.
Add the grated papaya and mixed vegetables.
Pound the mixture until the vegetables are well coated with the dressing.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the som tam at room temperature.

title: Massaman Curry
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
1 cup beef or chicken, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the beef or chicken broth, coconut milk, fish sauce, soy sauce, palm sugar, cinnamon, cumin, cardamom, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
Add the potatoes and cook until they are tender.
Add the beef or chicken and cook until heated through.
Serve the Massaman curry hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and your choice of toppings.

title: Larb Moo (Spicy Minced Pork Salad)
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (chili peppers, tomatoes, carrots, long beans)
Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: In a large mortar, pound the chilies, garlic, and ginger until well combined.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar, peanuts, cilantro, dried shrimp, and salt.
Pound the mixture until well combined.
Add the minced pork and pound until well combined.
Add the mixed vegetables and pound until well combined.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the larb moo at room temperature.

title: Khao Pad (Fried Rice)
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onions and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook until they are tender.
Push the vegetables to one side of the pan.
Add a little more oil to the other side of the pan, then pour in the beaten eggs.
Scramble the eggs until cooked through, then mix with the vegetables.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Add the soy sauce, oyster sauce, fish sauce, salt, and black pepper.
Stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, until the rice is well coated with the sauce.
Serve the khao pad hot.

title: Khao Soi
ingredients: 2 cups curried egg noodle, boiled and drained
instructions: Heat oil in a wok over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic, stir-fry until fragrant.
Add braised beef and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add braising liquid, soy sauce, fish sauce, palm sugar, cumin, coriander, turmeric powder, and cayenne pepper. Stir well.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add bean sprouts and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add fried noodles and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Serve hot, garnished with cilantro and a lime wedge on the side.

title: Nam Phrik Ong
ingredients: 2 cups fresh chilies, seeded and chopped
instructions: Combine chilies, garlic, and ginger in a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Heat a saucepan over low heat.
Add fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar, and water. Stir well.
Add blended chili mixture and stir well.
Simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in cilantro, basil, and black pepper.
Serve hot or at room temperature.

title: Kanom Buang (Thai Crepe)
instructions: Combine flour, cornstarch, and salt in a bowl.
Gradually add coconut milk, water, sugar, and pandan extract. Mix well.
Add eggs and melted butter. Mix until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour a small amount of batter into the pan and tilt to evenly coat the pan.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, until the edges start to curl.
Add filling and fold the crepe in half.
Cook for another minute and serve hot.

title: Miang Kham
instructions: Combine mixed greens, peanuts, dried shrimp, and fried shallots in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix palm sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, ginger, and black pepper.
Drizzle the dressing over the greens mixture and serve.

title: Khao Niew Mamuang
instructions: Combine sugar, coconut milk, sticky rice flour, salt, cardamom powder, and cinnamon in a bowl.
Mix until smooth.
Add melted butter and mix until well combined.
Serve the mixture over sliced mangoes.

title: Classic Cheeseburger
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Form the ground beef into 4 patties.
Grill the patties for 4-5 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Meanwhile, toast the hamburger buns on the grill.
Assemble the burgers with cheese, lettuce, tomato, and mayonnaise.

title: Chicken Pot Pie
ingredients: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a large skillet, sauté the chicken, carrots, potatoes, onion, and garlic until the vegetables are tender.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, chicken broth, and heavy cream.
Add the mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Season with thyme, salt, and pepper.
