Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan cheese.
Layer half the pasta in a baking dish, top with meat sauce, then the remaining pasta.
Pour the béchamel over the top and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30 minutes until golden.

title: Saganaki with Tomato and Feta
instructions: Heat olive oil in a wide frying pan over medium heat.
Sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes, oregano, and olives; cook until tomatoes soften.
Remove from heat and stir in crumbled feta cheese.
Drizzle with lemon juice and mix gently.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving hot.

title: Avgolemono Soup
instructions: Sauté chopped onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add diced chicken and cook until no longer pink.
Stir in rinsed rice and chicken broth; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer until rice is tender and chicken is cooked through.
In a separate bowl, whisk eggs and lemon juice together.
Remove soup from heat and slowly drizzle in the egg-lemon mixture while stirring constantly to thicken.
Season with salt and pepper, then serve immediately.

title: Koufeta (Fried Honey-Coated Almonds)
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°F (95°C) to keep almonds warm.
Toss almonds with flour and egg to coat lightly.
Fry almonds in hot oil until golden brown, then drain on paper towels.
In a small saucepan, combine honey, melted butter, sugar, and cinnamon over low heat.
Stir until sugar dissolves and mixture is smooth.
Toss warm fried almonds in the honey mixture until evenly coated.
Spread on a baking sheet and let cool completely before serving.

title: Fliki (Epirotic Buckwheat Pancakes)
instructions: Mix the flour, eggs, yogurt, salt, and a little water to form a smooth batter.
Let the batter rest for at least 2 hours at room temperature.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat.
Pour small amounts of batter into the skillet to form thin pancakes.
Cook until golden brown on both sides, flipping carefully.
Serve warm with honey or a dollop of yogurt.

title: Kotopoulo me Patates (Chicken with Potatoes)
ingredients: 1 kg potatoes, peeled and cut into large chunks
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Season the chicken pieces generously with salt, pepper, and garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and brown the chicken on all sides.
Remove chicken and set aside; add onion to the pot and sauté until soft.
Return chicken to the pot, add potatoes, tomatoes, and a bay leaf.
Cover with water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour.
Check occasionally and add more water if needed until potatoes are tender.

title: Gigantes (Giant Chickpeas)
ingredients: 1 kg dried giant chickpeas, soaked overnight
instructions: Drain the soaked chickpeas and place them in a pot with fresh water.
Bring to a boil, skim the foam, then simmer until chickpeas are very tender.
In a separate pan, sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until fragrant.
Add peeled tomatoes, oregano, and salt; cook down into a thick sauce.
Pour the sauce over the chickpeas, cover, and simmer gently for 30 minutes.
Serve hot, optionally with a drizzle of extra olive oil.

title: Tsoureki (Easter Bread)
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm milk and let it foam for 10 minutes.
Mix flour, eggs, honey, vanilla, orange zest, and olive oil into a dough.
Add the foamy yeast mixture and knead until smooth and elastic.
Let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour until doubled.
Fold in currants, walnuts, and egg whites gently.
Shape into a loaf, place in a greased pan, and let rise again for 45 minutes.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 35-40 minutes until golden.

title: Papoutsakia (Stuffed Peppers)
ingredients: 12 small green peppers, tops removed and seeded
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add ground lamb and cook until browned; mix in rice, parmesan, salt, and pepper.
Stuff each pepper generously with the meat mixture.
Place peppers in a baking dish and pour diced tomatoes and a little water over them.
Cover with foil and bake at 190°C (375°F) for 40 minutes.
Remove foil and bake for another 10 minutes until peppers are tender and sauce is reduced.

title: Kleftiko
ingredients: 1 whole lamb or goat, cleaned and cut into large pieces
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Season the meat generously with salt, pepper, and half of the olive oil.
Place the meat in a large clay pot or heavy pot with the sliced onions, garlic, thyme, bay leaves, and lemon halves.
Pour the white wine over the meat until it is nearly submerged.
Cover the pot tightly with foil and then the lid to trap the steam.
Cook over low heat for 3 to 4 hours until the meat is extremely tender and falling apart.
Remove the pot from heat, discard the lemon halves and herbs, and serve the meat with the cooking juices.

title: Kotopoulo me Patates
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Brown the chicken pieces on all sides, then remove them and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté the onions, carrots, and celery until softened.
Add the potatoes and cook for 2 minutes, stirring to coat with oil.
Return the chicken to the pot, add the chopped tomatoes, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour in the water or broth until the ingredients are just covered.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1 hour.
Check occasionally and add more water if necessary until the chicken and potatoes are tender.

title: Gemista
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Score the bottom of the tomatoes and carefully scoop out the insides with a spoon, leaving the shells intact.
In a bowl, mix the ground beef, rice, chopped onion, minced garlic, wine, tomato paste, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Stuff the tomato shells with the meat mixture and place them upright in a baking dish.
Pour the water and a splash of olive oil into the bottom of the dish.
Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake for 1 hour.
Remove the foil, stir the sauce in the dish, and bake uncovered for another 30 minutes until the sauce thickens.

title: Pastitsio
ingredients: 1 lb dried spaghetti or bucatini, broken in half
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Boil pasta in salted water according to package directions until al dente, then drain and set aside.
Brown the ground beef with diced onion in a large pot until no longer pink.
Stir in tomato sauce, water, tomato paste, oregano, salt, and pepper; simmer for 15 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, melted butter, eggs, and half of the Parmesan cheese.
Layer half the pasta in a greased baking dish, spread half the meat sauce over it.
Top with the remaining pasta, the rest of the meat sauce, and finally the milk-cheese mixture.
Sprinkle the remaining Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake for 40-45 minutes until the top is golden brown and bubbling.

title: Avgolemono Soup
ingredients: 1/4 cup long-grain white rice, cooked separately
instructions: Bring the chicken broth to a gentle simmer in a large pot.
In a separate bowl, whisk the egg yolks, lemon juice, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Slowly whisk about 1 cup of the hot broth into the egg yolk mixture to temper it.
Pour the tempered egg mixture back into the pot, stirring constantly to avoid curdling.
Reduce heat to low and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently until the soup thickens slightly.
Stir in the cooked rice and shredded chicken.
Drizzle with olive oil, garnish with fresh dill if desired, and serve immediately.

title: Tyropoula (Cycladic Cheese Pie)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, mix crumbled feta, ricotta, milk, and eggs until smooth.
Brush a baking dish with olive oil and line it with phyllo sheets.
Pour the cheese mixture into the dish.
Cover with remaining phyllo sheets, brushing each with oil.
Bake for 40-45 minutes until golden brown.
Let cool slightly before slicing.

title: Kotopoulo me Patates (Chicken with Potatoes)
instructions: Season chicken pieces with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Heat olive oil in a large pot and sear chicken until browned.
Remove chicken and sauté onions and garlic until soft.
Return chicken to the pot and add potatoes.
Pour in enough water to just cover ingredients and add lemon juice.
Simmer covered for 45 minutes until chicken and potatoes are tender.
Stir gently and serve hot.

title: Avgolemono Soup
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a simmer with cooked rice.
In a separate bowl, whisk eggs and lemon juice together.
Slowly ladle some hot broth into the egg mixture while whisking constantly.
Pour the tempered egg mixture back into the soup pot.
Reduce heat to low and stir gently until soup thickens.
Season with salt and white pepper.
Serve immediately garnished with fresh dill.

title: Gigandes me Plaki (Giant Beans with Tomato Sauce)
instructions: Soak giant beans overnight and drain.
Boil beans until nearly tender, about 20 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a pan and sauté onion and garlic.
Add chopped tomatoes, oregano, and bay leaf; simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the beans to the sauce and cook for another 10 minutes.
Season with salt and remove the bay leaf.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve warm.

title: Moussaka (Cycladic Style)
instructions: Fry eggplant slices in olive oil until golden and drain on paper towels.
In a pan, cook ground lamb with onions until browned.
Mix chopped tomatoes, flour, and oregano to make a thick sauce; add to meat.
Arrange potato slices in a baking dish, then eggplant slices.
Pour the meat sauce over the vegetables.
Whisk eggs with a little milk and pour over the top.
Sprinkle with grated feta and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 40 minutes.
Let rest for 15 minutes before slicing.

title: Kleftiko (Slow-Roasted Lamb)
instructions: Score the lamb leg deeply and stuff the cavity with lemon halves, bay leaves, and half the garlic.
Rub the outside of the lamb generously with olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Place the lamb in a large heavy roasting pan and surround it completely with potatoes, tomatoes, onion, and remaining garlic.
Pour the rest of the olive oil over everything to submerge the ingredients slightly.
Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F (175°C) for 3 hours, then remove foil and bake for 1 hour until the meat is falling off the bone.

title: Gigantes Plaki (Baked Giant Beans)
instructions: Soak the beans in plenty of cold water for at least 12 hours, then drain and rinse.
Boil the beans in fresh water with a pinch of salt until they are very tender but not mushy (about 45 minutes).
Heat olive oil in a large pot, sauté onion and garlic until soft, then add oregano, salt, and pepper.
Stir in the cooked beans, chopped tomatoes, and bay leaf; cook on low heat for 15 minutes to let flavors meld.
Transfer mixture to a baking dish, drizzle generously with more olive oil, and bake at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes until golden.

title: Dakos (Cretan Wheat Rusk Salad)
ingredients: 2 cups homemade wheat rusks (or coarse wheat flakes)
1 pint ripe tomatoes, cut into wedges
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Arrange toasted wheat rusks on a platter to form a base.
Toss tomatoes, cucumber, onion, olives, and feta with olive oil, vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour the tomato mixture evenly over the wheat rusks.
Allow the salad to sit for 10 minutes so the vegetables soften slightly and the rusks absorb the juices.
Serve immediately as a light summer meal or appetizer.

title: Tomato and Okra Soup (Avgolemono with Okra)
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent, then add okra and cook until edges turn golden.
Stir in grated tomatoes, wine, broth, and bay leaf; simmer for 20 minutes until okra is tender.
In a separate bowl, whisk egg yolks with lemon juice until smooth.
Remove soup from heat and slowly whisk in the egg-lemon mixture to thicken without curdling.
Season with salt and white pepper, then serve hot.

title: Tzatziki with Cretan Twist
ingredients: 1 large cucumber, grated and squeezed dry
instructions: Grate cucumber, place in a clean cloth, and squeeze out all excess water.
In a large bowl, mix yogurt, squeezed cucumber, olive oil, crushed garlic, oregano, dill, lemon juice, and salt.
Taste and adjust seasoning; chill for at least 1 hour to let flavors meld.
Just before serving, stir in the halved cherry tomatoes and crumbled feta cheese gently.
Serve cold with warm pita bread and grilled meats.

title: Tiropita (Cheese Pie)
instructions: Mix flour and water to form a stiff dough, then wrap and let rest for 30 minutes.
Combine cheeses, eggs, oregano, and half the melted butter to make the filling.
Roll dough thinly into a large square and spread the cheese mixture over it.
Fold the dough over the filling in a triangle shape and brush with olive oil.
Bake at 200°C for 35 minutes until golden brown and crisp.

title: Kotopoulo Tierno (Roast Chicken)
ingredients: 1 whole chicken, about 2kg, cut into pieces
instructions: Season the chicken pieces with salt, pepper, oregano, and crushed garlic.
Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe pan over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken pieces until golden brown on all sides.
Add the onion quarters and lemon wedges to the pan.
Transfer to the oven at 190°C and roast for 1 hour 15 minutes, basting occasionally.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.

title: Baklava with Walnuts
instructions: Layer 4 sheets of phyllo dough, brushing each with melted butter and oil.
Sprinkle a thin layer of chopped walnuts over the dough.
Repeat the layering of dough and butter until 8 sheets are used.
Cut the pastry into diamond shapes without cutting all the way through.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until deep golden brown.
Meanwhile, mix sugar, water, honey, and cinnamon to make the syrup.
Pour the hot syrup over the baked baklava immediately after removing from the oven.

title: Kleftiko (Slow-Roasted Lamb)
instructions: Rub the lamb thoroughly with olive oil, salt, pepper, and oregano.
Stuff the lemon wedges, onion chunks, and garlic head into the cavity of the lamb.
Wrap the lamb tightly in aluminum foil.
Place the wrapped lamb in a pot of cold water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 3 hours until tender.
Remove from water, unwrap, and let rest for 15 minutes before carving.

title: Spanakopita (Spinach Pie)
ingredients: 500g frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
instructions: Sauté the chopped onion and garlic in half the olive oil until soft.
Mix the sautéed onions, spinach, both cheeses, eggs, oregano, and remaining oil.
Place 4 sheets of phyllo on a tray, brushing each with olive oil.
Spread the filling evenly over the phyllo layers.
Cover with another 4 sheets of oiled phyllo.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until the top is golden and crispy.

title: Spanakopita
ingredients: 4 cups fresh spinach, chopped and squeezed dry
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Mix spinach, feta, eggs, dill, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Brush a baking sheet with olive oil and place one phyllo sheet on top.
Spread the spinach mixture evenly over the phyllo.
Cover with the second phyllo sheet and brush with oil.
Cut into squares and bake for 30 minutes until golden brown.

title: Dolmades
instructions: Sauté onion in olive oil until soft.
Add tomato paste, oregano, salt, and pepper; cook for 2 minutes.
Mix the rice, onion mixture, and a little water in a bowl.
Wipe grape leaves and place a spoonful of filling in the center of each.
Roll the leaves tightly and place them in a pot seam-side down.
Cover with water and simmer for 1 hour until tender.

title: Kleftiko
instructions: Place lamb, potatoes, lemon halves, garlic, thyme, salt, and pepper in a large pot.
Pour olive oil over the ingredients and seal the pot tightly with foil.
Cook in a low oven at 300°F (150°C) for 3 hours.
Open the pot, remove the foil, and let it rest for 10 minutes.
Serve hot with the cooking juices.

title: Tiropita
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Mix ricotta, feta, eggs, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt, and half the olive oil in a bowl.
Brush one phyllo sheet with oil and place it on a baking tray.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the phyllo.
Cover with the second phyllo sheet and brush with the remaining oil.
Bake for 25 minutes until crispy and golden.

title: Avgolemono Soup
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: Heat the chicken broth in a pot and add the rice; simmer for 5 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk eggs, lemon juice, and butter until smooth.
Remove the soup from heat and temper the egg mixture by adding a ladle of hot broth.
Pour the tempered mixture back into the pot, stirring constantly.
Season with salt and white pepper, then serve hot with dill.

title: Kleftiko (Lamb Braised in Vinegar and Herbs)
ingredients: 1 whole lamb, halved and cut into large pieces
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Season the lamb pieces generously with salt, pepper, and dried oregano.
Heat olive oil in a large heavy pot and sear the lamb until browned on all sides.
Add the garlic heads, lemon halves, bay leaves, and cloves to the pot.
Pour in the red wine vinegar and beef stock to barely cover the meat.
Cover the pot tightly with foil and a lid, then place it in a preheated 160°C (325°F) oven.
Braise for 3 to 4 hours until the meat falls off the bone.
Remove the pot from the oven, discard the lemon and bay leaves, and slice the tender meat.
Serve the meat with the rich braising liquid and roasted potatoes.

title: Koulouri (Sesame Ring Buns)
instructions: Dissolve the yeast and sugar in the warm water and let sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
Mix the flour and salt in a large bowl, then add the yeast mixture and olive oil.
Knead the dough by hand for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover the bowl with a damp cloth and let the dough rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 12 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a rope and shape it into a ring, sealing the ends together.
Roll the rings in sesame seeds to coat them completely.
Let the rings rise again for 30 minutes.
Heat vegetable oil in a deep pan to 175°C (350°F) and fry the rings in batches for 3-4 minutes until golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.

title: Avgolemono (Egg-Lemon Soup with Rice)
ingredients: 1 lemon, zested and juiced (separate the juice)
Salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: Rinse the rice thoroughly until the water runs clear.
In a pot, sauté the rice in olive oil for 2 minutes until slightly toasted.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt until pale and frothy.
Remove the soup from the heat and let it cool slightly so it is not boiling.
Slowly drizzle the egg-lemon mixture into the hot soup while stirring constantly to avoid curdling.
Season with white pepper and salt to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve immediately in warm bowls.

title: Horta (Wild Greens with Lemon and Garlic)
ingredients: 500 grams mixed wild greens (dandelion, sorrel, or chard)
instructions: Wash the wild greens thoroughly to remove all dirt and sand.
Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and add the greens.
Cook the greens for 3-4 minutes until they wilt, then drain well in a colander.
While the greens are still warm, toss them in a large bowl with the sliced garlic and olive oil.
Squeeze the fresh lemon juice over the mixture and mix well.
Let the flavors meld for 10 minutes before serving.
Garnish with fresh mint if desired and serve as a side dish.

title: Fava (Pureed Yellow Split Peas)
ingredients: Salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: Rinse the split peas until the water runs clear and soak them in water for 2 hours.
In a large pot, sauté the onions and garlic in olive oil until soft and translucent.
Add the soaked peas, stock, oregano, and bay leaf to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for about 1 hour until the peas are very soft and mushy.
Remove the bay leaf and puree the mixture in a blender or food processor until completely smooth.
Return the puree to the pot and stir in an additional 2 tablespoons of olive oil.
Season generously with salt and white pepper to taste.
Simmer gently for another 10 minutes to blend the flavors, then ladle into bowls.
Serve warm or cold with lemon wedges on the side.

title: Corfiot Moussaka
ingredients: 1 cup sour cream mixed with 1 egg
instructions: Fry eggplant slices in olive oil until golden and drain on paper towels.
Sauté onions and garlic, then add lamb and cook until browned.
Stir in tomato sauce and simmer for 15 minutes.
Layer eggplant and meat sauce in a baking dish, repeating layers.
Top with the sour cream and egg mixture, then sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until bubbly and golden.

title: Pastitsio with Lamb
ingredients: 1/4 cup butter, 2 tbsp flour, 2 cups milk for béchamel
instructions: Boil pasta tubes in salted water until al dente and drain.
Brown the ground lamb with onions and add tomato sauce; simmer.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk to make smooth béchamel.
Mix half the béchamel with the pasta and spread in a baking dish.
Spread the meat sauce over the pasta.
Cover with remaining béchamel and sprinkle cheese on top.
Bake at 190°C for 30 minutes until the top is golden brown.

title: Kalamarakia Tomatini
ingredients: Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Clean squid thoroughly, removing beaks and ink sacs, keeping tentacles intact.
Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add squid tentacles and rings, cooking for 3 minutes.
Pour in wine and let it reduce by half.
Add tomatoes, oregano, salt, and pepper; simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve hot with crusty bread to soak up the sauce.

title: Korakia (Fried Cheese Balls)
instructions: Mix cheese, eggs, breadcrumbs, and oregano into a firm dough.
Roll small portions into balls about 2 cm in diameter.
Dip each ball in flour, then egg wash, then breadcrumbs.
Heat oil to 170°C and fry balls in batches until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm as a meze.

title: Fava with Tomatoes and Onions
ingredients: 4 large ripe tomatoes, peeled and chopped
instructions: Rinse fava beans and mash them slightly with a fork or potato masher.
In a pot, sauté onions and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes until soft.
Stir in mashed fava beans, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Cook for another 5 minutes until thickened.
Serve warm or at room temperature, garnished with parsley.

title: Butter Chicken
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, and red chili powder for 30 minutes.
Heat butter in a pan and cook chicken until golden brown and cooked through.
Remove chicken and set aside. In the same pan, sauté tomato puree until oil separates.
Stir in cashew paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Add heavy cream, water, and salt; simmer until sauce thickens.
Return chicken to the pan and coat with sauce.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with naan or rice.

title: Lamb Rogan Josh
ingredients: 1 lb lamb shoulder, cut into cubes
instructions: Fry lamb cubes in ghee until well-browned and set aside.
In the same pot, fry onions until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and spices (chili, coriander, turmeric); cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in yogurt and cook until the raw smell disappears.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.
Pour in water, bring to a boil, then add the fried lamb.
Simmer covered on low heat for 1.5 hours until lamb is tender.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with rice.

title: Biryani (Hyderabadi Style)
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, soaked for 30 minutes
1 tsp saffron strands soaked in 2 tbsp warm milk
instructions: Fry chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, and spices until cooked; set aside.
Par-boil rice in salted water until 70% cooked; drain and keep aside.
Layer fried chicken, potatoes, peas, and half the fried onions at the bottom of a heavy pot.
Add whole spices and remaining onions on top.
Pour hot milk with saffron over the layer.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat for 15 minutes (dum cooking).
Gently mix the par-boiled rice into the pot, ensuring layers are intact.
Drizzle butter and garnish with mint and coriander before serving.

title: Dal Makhani
ingredients: 1 cup black lentils (urad dal), soaked overnight
1/2 cup red kidney beans, soaked overnight
instructions: Pressure cook soaked lentils and kidney beans with water and turmeric until very soft.
Heat butter in a pan and sauté cumin seeds and onions until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in tomato puree and cook until the oil separates.
Add the cooked lentil mixture, cashew paste, and water; simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and garam masala; cook on low heat for 15 minutes.
Adjust salt and consistency with water if needed.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot with naan.

title: Haleem
ingredients: 1 cup wheat flour, soaked for 6 hours
1 cup lentils (chana dal and moong dal), soaked for 6 hours
1 lb beef, cut into small pieces
instructions: Cook wheat, lentils, and beef with water and spices in a pressure cooker until very soft.
Grind the cooked mixture into a smooth, thick paste.
In a large pot, heat ghee and sauté onions until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the ground wheat-beef-lentil paste and simmer for 30 minutes.
Gradually add water to achieve a porridge-like consistency.
Stir in vermicelli, poppy seeds, and roasted gram flour.
Cook on low heat for 1 hour, stirring frequently, until creamy.
Season with salt and serve hot with pickles or yogurt.

title: Chicken Biryani
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, soaked for 30 minutes
1 kg chicken pieces, marinated with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, and spices
1 cup basmati rice, cooked in water with whole spices
1 large onion, thinly sliced and fried until golden
instructions: Cook the marinated chicken in a pot with water, salt, and whole spices until 70% done.
Rinse the soaked rice, cook it in a separate pot with water and whole spices until 70% done.
Layer the partially cooked chicken and potatoes in a heavy-bottomed pot.
Spread the partially cooked rice over the chicken layer.
Sprinkle fried onions, mint, coriander, saffron milk, and ghee over the rice.
Seal the pot tightly and cook on low heat (dum) for 40 minutes.

title: Lamb Rogan Josh
ingredients: 1 kg lamb shoulder, cut into 2-inch cubes
instructions: Marinate the lamb cubes with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, and half the spices for 2 hours.
Heat oil in a heavy pot and add asafoetida, green cardamom, bay leaves, and cinnamon sticks.
Fry the marinated lamb until browned on all sides.
Add turmeric, chili powder, and remaining spices; sauté for 2 minutes.
Pour in water to cover the meat and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 1.5 hours until the lamb is tender.
Stir in mint leaves and cook for 5 more minutes before serving.

title: Sri Lankan Pol Sambol
ingredients: 3 cups raw jackfruit, peeled and sliced into 1/2-inch pieces
1/2 cup raw jackfruit, peeled and sliced into 1/2-inch pieces
1/2 cup raw jackfruit, peeled and sliced into 1/2-inch pieces
1/2 cup raw jackfruit, peeled and sliced into 1/2-inch pieces
1/2 cup raw jackfruit, peeled and sliced into 1/2-inch pieces
1/2 cup raw jackfruit, peeled and sliced into 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Boil the raw jackfruit pieces in water with salt until tender.
While the jackfruit is boiling, prepare the sambol mixture.
In a bowl, combine grated coconut, lime juice, chili powder, salt, and roasted cumin powder.
Once the jackfruit is tender, drain and cut into small cubes.
Toss the jackfruit cubes with the sambol mixture.
Serve immediately as a side dish.

title: Nepali Dal Bhat
instructions: Wash the lentils and rice thoroughly.
In a pressure cooker, sauté cumin seeds, onions, ginger, and chilies in mustard oil.
Add tomatoes, turmeric, and salt; cook until tomatoes soften.
Add the rinsed lentils and 2 cups of water; cook under pressure for 3-4 whistles.
In a separate pot, cook the rice with 2 cups of water until fluffy.
Serve the hot dal and rice together with pickles and fresh coriander.

title: Bangladeshi Shukto
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (eggplant, okra, beans, pumpkin), cut into chunks
instructions: Boil the mixed vegetables in water with turmeric and salt until tender.
In a pan, heat mustard oil and add asafoetida, mustard seeds, and cumin seeds.
Add sliced onions and cook until golden brown.
Stir in the boiled vegetables, green chilies, and grated coconut.
Simmer for 10 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 tsp kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves), crushed
instructions: Toss chicken pieces with ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, red chili powder, garam masala, yogurt, and salt; marinate for 30 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp butter in a deep pan over medium heat; cook chicken until browned and cooked through, then remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add remaining butter and sauté tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add tomato puree, water, and simmer for 15 minutes until thickened.
Stir in heavy cream and crushed kasuri methi; cook for 2 more minutes.
Return chicken to the pan; simmer for 5 minutes until flavors meld.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with naan or rice.

title: Biryani
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, soaked for 30 minutes
1.5 lbs boneless chicken, cut into pieces
instructions: Parboil rice in salted water until 70% cooked; drain and set aside.
Heat ghee in a large pot; sauté onions until golden brown, then remove half for garnish.
Add garlic, ginger, turmeric, chili powder, and salt to the pot; cook for 1 minute.
Add chicken, yogurt, and spices; cook until chicken is half-done.
Add broth, bay leaf, cinnamon, cardamom, and cloves; simmer until chicken is cooked.
Layer peas and carrots over the chicken.
Spread parboiled rice evenly over the vegetables.
Sprinkle remaining fried onions, mint, and cilantro on top.
Cover the pot tightly with foil and a lid; cook on low heat for 15 minutes (dum cooking).
Fluff the biryani gently with a fork before serving.

title: Chole (Chickpea Curry)
ingredients: 2 cups dried chickpeas, soaked overnight and drained
instructions: Boil soaked chickpeas with turmeric until tender; drain and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan; fry chopped onions until golden brown.
Add garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, chili, garam masala, and turmeric; sauté for 1 minute.
Stir in tomato paste and blended tomatoes; cook until oil separates.
Add water and salt; simmer for 10 minutes.
Add cooked chickpeas; cook for another 5 minutes until the gravy thickens.
Garnish with cilantro and a squeeze of lemon juice.
Serve hot with naan or roti.

title: Dal Tadka
ingredients: 1 cup yellow split lentils (toor dal), rinsed
instructions: Boil lentils with turmeric and salt until soft; drain excess water if needed.
In a separate pan, heat ghee; add cumin seeds, mustard seeds, and asafoetida until sizzling.
Add chopped onions, garlic, and ginger paste; cook until onions are soft.
Stir in chili powder, coriander powder, and cooked lentils.
Add water or broth; simmer for 10 minutes until the dal is thick and creamy.
Sprinkle garam masala and fresh cilantro; serve hot with rice or roti.

title: Lamb Rogan Josh
ingredients: 1.5 lbs lamb shoulder, cut into 2-inch cubes
instructions: Marinate lamb with half the yogurt, turmeric, and salt for 30 minutes.
Heat ghee in a heavy pot; fry lamb until browned on all sides; remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onions until golden; add garlic and ginger paste.
Add cumin, chili, garam masala, fennel, and whole spices; cook for 1 minute.
Stir in tomato paste and remaining yogurt; cook until smooth.
Return lamb to the pot; add water or broth and simmer for 1.5 hours until tender.
Adjust salt; garnish with cilantro and mint.
Serve with steamed rice or naan.

title: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken thighs, cut into pieces
instructions: Marinate chicken with ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, chili powder, yogurt, and salt for 1 hour.
Heat butter in a pan and cook chicken until browned; remove and set aside.
In the same pan, sauté onions until golden.
Add tomato puree, simmer for 10 minutes until oil separates.
Stir in cream, garam masala, and salt.
Return chicken to the pan and simmer for 15 minutes until thickened.

title: Biryani
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, soaked for 30 minutes
500g lamb or chicken, cut into pieces
3 cloves, 4 cardamom pods, 2 bay leaves, 4 green cardamom pods
instructions: Boil meat with yogurt, half the onions, spices, and whole spices until 70% cooked.
Parboil rice in salted water until 70% done.
Layer rice over the meat in a heavy-bottomed pot.
Sprinkle remaining onions, mint, coriander, and ghee over the top.
Seal the pot tightly and cook on low heat (dum) for 20 minutes.

title: Lentil Dal (Dal Tadka)
instructions: Cook lentils in water with turmeric and chili powder until soft.
In a separate pan, heat ghee and add cumin seeds and asafoetida.
Sauté onions until golden, then add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomatoes and cook until mushy.
Pour the cooked lentil mixture into the onion-tomato base.
Simmer for 5 minutes and garnish with coriander.

title: Sri Lankan String Hoppers with Coconut Curry
instructions: Mix rice flour, salt, sugar, and water to form a smooth batter.
Steam the batter in a string hopper maker for 10 minutes.
Grate fresh coconut and mix with water, turmeric, and chilies.
Boil water in a pot and add mustard and cumin seeds.
Pour coconut mixture into the boiling water to cook the curry.
Serve hot string hoppers with the coconut curry.

title: Samosa
instructions: Mix flour, salt, and oil to form a stiff dough; rest for 30 minutes.
Sauté onions, cumin, turmeric, chili powder, and coriander.
Add mashed potatoes, peas, and garam masala to the mixture.
Roll dough into thin circles and place filling in the center.
Fold and seal the edges to form a cone shape.
Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown.

title: Aloo Gobi
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add potatoes, cauliflower, turmeric, and salt; stir well.
Cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Sprinkle garam masala and coriander leaves, then mix and serve.

title: Chicken Biryani
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken pieces, marinated with yogurt and spices
2 cups basmati rice, soaked and parboiled
Spices: biryani masala, cumin, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon
instructions: Layer parboiled rice over marinated chicken in a heavy-bottomed pot.
Top with sliced onions, green chilies, coriander, mint, and whole spices.
Drizzle ghee over the top layer.
Cover tightly with foil and then the lid.
Cook on low heat for 20 minutes using the dum method.
Fluff gently with a fork and serve hot.

title: Rajma Chawal
ingredients: 1 cup dried kidney beans, soaked overnight
instructions: Boil soaked kidney beans until soft and mash them slightly.
Sauté cumin seeds and onions in oil until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook until fragrant.
Stir in tomatoes, spices, and mashed beans; cook until the gravy thickens.
Serve the thick bean curry with steamed basmati rice.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves.

title: Hoppers (Appalam)
ingredients: 1/2 cup water, plus more as needed
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, salt, turmeric, water, sesame seeds, and cumin seeds in a blender.
Blend until a smooth, thin batter forms, adding water if necessary.
Heat a non-stick pan and drizzle oil to grease.
Pour a ladleful of batter into the center, tilting the pan to spread it into a bowl shape.
Cook on medium heat until the edges lift and the bottom is golden brown.
Flip carefully and cook the other side until done; serve warm.

title: Momo (Nepalese Dumplings)
ingredients: Vegetable oil for sealing and frying
instructions: Mix meat, cabbage, carrots, ginger-garlic paste, soy sauce, and pepper to make filling.
Knead flour and water to form a smooth dough; rest for 30 minutes.
Roll dough into thin circles and place filling in the center.
Fold the dough over the filling to seal, creating a half-moon shape.
Steam the momos for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Serve hot with a spicy dipping sauce and garnish with coriander.

title: Chicken Biryani
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, soaked for 30 minutes
500g chicken pieces, marinated with yogurt and spices
instructions: Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot and sauté onions until golden brown.
Add tomatoes, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, red chili powder, and garam masala; cook until oil separates.
Add marinated chicken and cook until it changes color.
Drain the soaked rice and add to the pot with 4 cups of water and salt; bring to a boil.
Layer the boiled potatoes and mint-coriander mixture over the rice.
Cover tightly with a lid and cook on low heat for 15-20 minutes until rice is tender.

title: Aloo Gobi
ingredients: 1 medium cauliflower head, cut into florets
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan and add cumin seeds; let them sizzle.
Add onions, garlic, and ginger; sauté until onions turn translucent.
Add turmeric and red chili powder; stir well.
Add cauliflower florets and cook for 5 minutes.
Add cubed potatoes and 1/2 cup water; cover and cook until potatoes are tender.
Stir in coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Lamb Rogan Josh
instructions: Heat ghee in a pot and add fennel and cumin seeds; toast until fragrant.
Add onions, garlic, and ginger; cook until golden.
Add lamb cubes, chili powder, and turmeric; stir to coat with spices.
Add yogurt and mix well to avoid lumps; cook until oil separates.
Add water and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 1.5 hours until lamb is tender.
Garnish with mint and coriander before serving.

title: Kottu Roti
ingredients: 4 flat rotis, cut into small pieces
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a wok and add cumin seeds; let them crackle.
Add garlic, ginger, and onions; sauté until soft.
Add chicken slices and cook until browned; add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add shredded cabbage and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Push ingredients to the side, pour beaten eggs into the center, and scramble.
Add roti pieces and toss everything together until well mixed and heated through.
Garnish with coriander and mint; serve immediately.

title: Dal Tadka
ingredients: 1 cup yellow lentils (toor dal), rinsed and soaked for 30 minutes
instructions: Boil lentils with water and salt until soft and mushy; mash slightly.
Heat ghee in a separate pan and add cumin seeds; let them sizzle.
Add onions, garlic, and ginger; cook until golden.
Add turmeric and red chili powder; stir well.
Pour the tempered mixture over the cooked lentils and mix thoroughly.
Garnish with coriander and cilantro stems; serve with rice or roti.

title: Chicken Biryani
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, soaked for 30 minutes
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, spices, ginger, garlic, half the onions, salt, and lemon juice for at least 2 hours.
Pressure cook the marinated chicken with water until tender, then set aside.
Drain the soaked rice and parboil it in salted water until 70% cooked.
Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pot and sauté remaining onions until golden brown.
Add whole spices (cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, bay leaves) and fry for 1 minute.
Layer the parboiled rice over the chicken in the pot.
Sprinkle fresh herbs and remaining spices over the rice.
Seal the pot tightly with dough or a tight lid and cook on low heat for 20 minutes (dum).

title: Aloo Gobi
ingredients: 2 medium cauliflower heads, cut into florets
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds and bay leaf; let them splutter.
Add chopped onions and sauté until translucent.
Add ginger and garlic, cook for another minute until fragrant.
Stir in turmeric, coriander powder, and salt; cook for 30 seconds.
Add cauliflower florets and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add potato cubes and mix well.
Add 1 cup of water, cover, and cook on medium heat until vegetables are tender.
Stir in garam masala, garnish with coriander, and serve hot.

title: Lamb Rogan Josh
ingredients: 1 kg lamb shoulder, cut into cubes
instructions: Heat ghee in a pot and fry fenugreek seeds until they turn dark brown.
Add lamb cubes and fry until the meat changes color.
Add onions, garlic, ginger, and bay leaf; cook until onions are soft.
Add whole spices (cardamom, cloves, cinnamon) and fry for 1 minute.
Add powdered spices (chili, turmeric, cumin, coriander, garam masala) and mix well.
Stir in yogurt gradually and cook until the oil separates from the gravy.
Add 2 cups of water, bring to a boil, then simmer covered for 1.5 hours until lamb is tender.
Garnish with fresh coriander before serving.

title: Dal Tadka
ingredients: 1 cup yellow split lentils (toor dal), rinsed
instructions: Wash lentils thoroughly and cook in 3 cups of water with turmeric and salt until soft and mushy.
While lentils cook, heat ghee in a separate pan.
Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add cumin seeds and bay leaf, followed by chopped onions and green chilies.
Sauté until onions are golden brown.
Add ginger, garlic, and tomatoes; cook until tomatoes are soft.
Pour the cooked lentils into the tempering mixture and mix well.
Garnish with coriander leaves and cilantro stems before serving.

title: Kothu Paratha
ingredients: 1/4 cup oil or water, as needed
instructions: Mix flour, salt, baking powder, and 1/4 cup water to form a soft dough; knead and rest for 20 minutes.
In a wok, heat 2 tbsp oil and sauté onions, tomatoes, green chilies, ginger-garlic paste, and spices until soft.
Add beaten eggs to the mixture and scramble until fully cooked.
Stir in coriander leaves and set aside.
Roll out small balls of dough into thin circles.
Place a rolled dough on a hot griddle and cook until bubbles form on one side.
Flip and spread the egg mixture over the paratha.
Fold the paratha into quarters, then roll it tightly to break it apart.
Heat oil in the wok, add the rolled paratha, and fry until crispy and golden brown, flipping occasionally.

title: Biryani
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, soaked for 30 minutes
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, half the spices, salt, and half the onions for 1 hour.
Boil water with whole spices and add rice; cook until 70% done.
Sauté remaining onions in ghee until golden brown.
Add tomato puree and remaining spices to the onions, cook until oil separates.
Layer half the rice in a heavy-bottomed pot, add marinated chicken, then the rest of the rice.
Drizzle ghee over the top and seal the pot tightly.
Cook on low heat for 20 minutes (dum cooking), then serve hot with mint and coriander.

title: Aloo Gobi
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add asafoetida, cumin seeds, and onions; cook until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and green chilies, sauté for 1 minute.
Stir in tomatoes, turmeric, and cumin powder; cook until tomatoes soften.
Add potatoes and cauliflower, mix well, and add water to cover halfway.
Cover and cook on medium heat until vegetables are tender.
Add garam masala and salt, stir gently, and cook for 5 more minutes.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot.

title: Lamb Rogan Josh
ingredients: 1 lb lamb shoulder, cut into cubes
instructions: Marinate lamb with yogurt, ground fennel, half the spices, and salt for 2 hours.
Heat oil in a pot and add whole spices; fry until fragrant.
Add marinated lamb and sear until browned; add ginger-garlic paste.
Stir in onions and cook until soft, then add tomato puree.
Add remaining spices and water to cover the meat; simmer for 1.5 hours until tender.
Adjust seasoning with salt and garam masala.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve with naan or rice.

title: Kottu Roti
instructions: Chop all ingredients into bite-sized pieces.
Heat a wok or flat griddle over high heat and add oil.
Sauté onions, bell peppers, carrots, and tomatoes until soft.
Add ginger-garlic paste, soy sauce, salt, and pepper; stir-fry for 2 minutes.
Add chicken or eggs and cook until cooked through.
Toss in the cut-up roti pieces and fry until crispy and well-mixed.
Garnish with fresh coriander and serve immediately.

title: Pulihora (Tamarind Rice)
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, washed and drained
instructions: Cook rice in salted water until fluffy; drain and let it cool slightly.
In a bowl, mix tamarind pulp, water, and curd to make a paste.
Heat oil in a pan and add mustard seeds, urad dal, chana dal, and green chili.
When spluttering, add asafoetida and sesame seeds; fry until golden.
Pour the hot tempering over the cooked rice and mix well.
Gradually add the tamarind-curd mixture while stirring to avoid lumps.
Let it sit for 10 minutes before serving, garnished with coriander.

title: Aloo Gobi
ingredients: 1 large cauliflower head, cut into florets
instructions: Heat ghee in a large pan over medium heat and add cumin seeds.
Once sizzling, add sliced onions and green chilies; sauté until onions turn golden brown.
Add potatoes and cauliflower florets, stirring to coat with spices.
Sprinkle turmeric and red chili powder, mix well, and add 1 cup of water.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 15-20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Stir in garam masala and salt to taste.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.

title: Biryani (Hyderabadi Style)
ingredients: 500g chicken or mutton, cut into pieces
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, half the spices, salt, and half the mint and coriander for 30 minutes.
In a heavy-bottomed pot, heat oil and fry onions until golden brown.
Add cumin seeds, cardamom, and cloves; sauté for 1 minute.
Add marinated chicken, turmeric, red chili powder, and biryani masala; cook until meat is 70% done.
Drain soaked rice and layer it over the chicken in the pot.
Sprinkle remaining mint and coriander over the rice.
Drizzle ghee over the top and cover tightly with a lid.
Cook on low heat for 15-20 minutes until rice is fully cooked and aromatic.
Fluff gently with a fork before serving.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 500g chicken breast or thigh, boneless and skinless, cut into cubes
instructions: Marinate chicken cubes with yogurt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, red chili powder, garam masala, and salt; refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Preheat oven broiler or grill; cook marinated chicken until charred and cooked through.
In a saucepan, melt butter and sauté onions until soft.
Add pureed tomatoes, ketchup, and remaining spices; simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in cooked chicken and cream; cook on low heat for 5 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with naan or rice.

title: Litti Chokha
instructions: Mix whole wheat flour with water to form a stiff dough; knead until smooth.
For chokha: mash boiled potatoes with onions, green chilies, cumin, coriander, turmeric, red chili powder, salt, and mustard oil.
Shape dough into small round balls and flatten slightly.
Wrap each ball around a generous amount of potato mixture and seal tightly.
Roast wrapped balls over hot charcoal or in a tandoi until charred and crisp.
Serve hot with a side of plain yogurt or fresh cilantro.

title: Dal Tadka
instructions: Rinse lentils and cook in 3 cups of water with turmeric until soft and mushy; reserve 1/2 cup of cooking liquid.
In a separate pan, heat oil and add cumin seeds, mustard seeds, and dried red chilies.
Add ginger and garlic; sauté until fragrant.
Add sliced onions and cook until golden brown.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.
Stir in coriander powder, red chili powder, and salt; mix well.
Add cooked lentils and reserved cooking liquid; simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with rice or roti.

title: Aloo Gobi
instructions: Heat ghee or oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onions, garlic, and ginger; sauté until onions turn golden brown.
Add all the spice powders and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add potatoes and cauliflower florets, tossing to coat with spices.
Add a splash of water, cover, and cook on low heat for 15-20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Stir in salt to taste and cook for another 5 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot.

title: Biryani
ingredients: 500g chicken or lamb, cut into pieces
Whole spices: bay leaves, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon
instructions: Parboil rice with salt, whole spices, and a little oil until 70% cooked.
In a separate pot, brown the meat with onions, yogurt, and half of the whole spices.
Add garlic, ginger, turmeric, chili powder, and biryani masala; cook until meat is tender.
Layer half of the rice over the meat mixture.
Sprinkle half of the mint, coriander, and saffron milk over the rice.
Top with remaining meat, rice, and ghee.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat for 15-20 minutes (dum cooking).
Fluff gently with a fork and serve.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 kg chicken breast or thighs, cut into cubes
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, garam masala, cayenne, and lemon juice for at least 1 hour.
Roast or grill the marinated chicken until cooked and charred.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions until soft and golden.
Add tomato puree, cook until the oil separates from the sauce.
Stir in heavy cream and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the grilled chicken pieces to the sauce.
Simmer for 10 minutes until flavors meld.
Season with salt and garnish with cilantro.

title: Lemon Rice
instructions: Cook rice with water and salt until fluffy and drained well.
Heat ghee or oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add urad dal and chana dal; cook until golden.
Add green chilies, ginger, and curry leaves; sauté for 30 seconds.
Add grated coconut and lemon juice; stir well.
Toss the cooked rice with the tempering mixture.
Serve hot as a side dish.

title: Dal Makhani
ingredients: 1 cup whole black lentils (urad dal), soaked overnight
1 cup red kidney beans (rajma), soaked overnight
1 teaspoon kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves), crushed
instructions: Pressure cook soaked lentils and beans with turmeric and a little water until soft (about 25-30 minutes).
In a separate pan, heat ghee and sauté onions until golden brown.
Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates.
Stir in cumin seeds, chili powder, and garam masala; cook for 1 minute.
Add the cooked lentil mixture to the pan.
Simmer on low heat for 30-40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in butter, heavy cream, and crushed kasuri methi.
Simmer for another 10 minutes until creamy and rich.
Serve hot with naan or rice.

title: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, red chili powder, and garam masala for at least 1 hour.
Heat oil in a pan, add cumin seeds, then add onion and sauté until golden.
Add marinated chicken and cook until the chicken is sealed and lightly browned.
In a separate pan, melt butter and add tomato puree; cook until oil separates.
Stir in heavy cream and simmer for 5 minutes.
Combine the chicken mixture with the tomato-cream sauce.
Sprinkle kasuri methi and simmer on low heat for 15 minutes until chicken is tender.
Serve hot with naan or basmati rice.

title: Biryani
ingredients: 1 lb boneless chicken, cut into pieces
instructions: Wash and soak rice in water for 30 minutes, then drain.
Marinate chicken with yogurt, turmeric, red chili powder, garam masala, coriander powder, salt, half the ginger-garlic paste, and half the sliced onions.
In a pot, heat ghee and sauté remaining onions until golden brown.
Add chicken marinade and cook until chicken is half-done.
Add tomatoes, spices, cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, and bay leaves; cook until oil separates.
In a separate pan, boil water with whole spices, salt, and milk; add rice and parboil until 70% cooked.
Layer the parboiled rice over the chicken mixture.
Sprinkle mint, coriander, and remaining sliced onions on top.
Seal the pot tightly and cook on low heat for 15-20 minutes to steam.
Fluff with a fork before serving.

title: Litti Chokha
ingredients: 2 cups cooked red beans or lentils, mashed
instructions: Mash potatoes, eggplant, and lentils with salt, turmeric, chili powder, and coriander to make the chokha.
Mix whole wheat flour and besan with salt, cumin seeds, green chilies, oil, and ghee to form a stiff dough.
Divide dough into small balls, flatten slightly, and fill each with a portion of chokha.
Wrap the filled dough tightly to seal the chokha inside.
Roast the wrapped dough over an open flame or in a tandoor until golden brown and crispy.
Serve hot with extra chokha on the side.

title: Kottu Roti
ingredients: 200g oyster mushrooms or button mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Chop rotis into small pieces and keep them aside.
In a wok, heat oil and sauté cumin seeds and curry leaves.
Add chicken and mushrooms; cook until chicken is half-done.
Add onions, tomatoes, green chilies, turmeric, salt, and soy sauce; stir-fry until onions are translucent.
Add chopped rotis and spring onions; toss continuously to mix.
Drizzle a little oil to prevent sticking and keep stirring.
Add beaten egg if desired and scramble until cooked.
Season with garam masala and sugar to taste.
Serve immediately while hot and crispy.

title: Pani Puri
instructions: Mix puri flour, water, salt, and oil to form a soft dough; let it rest for 30 minutes.
Roll small balls from the dough, flatten, and cut into small circles with a glass.
Fry the puris in hot oil until puffed and crisp; set aside.
Prepare filling by mixing mashed potatoes, boiled chickpeas, chopped onions, tomatoes, mint, coriander, and chaat masala.
Make tamarind water by soaking tamarind in warm water, then strain and add salt, green chilies, and cumin powder.
Fill each puri with a small amount of the potato-chickpea mixture.
Just before serving, add a few drops of tamarind water into the puris.
Serve immediately with extra chutney on the side.

title: Chicken Biryani
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, soaked for 30 minutes
1 kg chicken pieces, marinated with yogurt and spices
instructions: Cook rice in salted water until 70% done, then drain and set aside.
Sauté sliced onions in ghee until golden brown.
Add crushed garlic, cinnamon, turmeric, and garam masala, then add marinated chicken.
Cook chicken on low heat until partially cooked.
Layer the par-cooked rice over the chicken.
Sprinkle mint, coriander, and a little yogurt on top.
Cover the pot tightly and cook on very low heat (dum) for 20 minutes.

title: Aloo Gobi
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds.
Add chopped onions and sauté until golden.
Add ginger, garlic, green chilies, and tomatoes; cook until tomatoes soften.
Stir in turmeric, coriander powder, and salt.
Add cauliflower florets and potatoes, mixing well.
Cover and cook on low heat for 15 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Sprinkle garam masala and fresh coriander leaves before serving.

title: Sri Lankan Kottu Roti
instructions: Heat mustard oil in a large wok (karai) and add mustard and cumin seeds.
Add sliced meat and cook until browned.
Add onions, green chilies, and curry powder; sauté until fragrant.
Stir in cabbage, carrots, and tomatoes; cook until vegetables soften.
Push ingredients to the side of the wok and scramble the eggs.
Add chopped rotis and toss everything together vigorously.
Finish with coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Nepali Dal Bhat
ingredients: Pickles and fried onions for garnish
instructions: Cook rice in water with salt until fluffy and set aside.
Boil lentils with turmeric and cumin until soft and mushy.
In a separate pan, sauté onions in ghee until golden.
Add ginger, garlic, tomatoes, and spices; cook until oil separates.
Mix the cooked lentils with the spiced onion mixture.
Garnish with cilantro and mint leaves.
Serve the dal with the rice, pickles, and fried onions on the side.

title: Pakistani Karahi
ingredients: 1 kg goat or lamb meat, cut into cubes
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed karahi and add meat.
Cook meat on high heat, stirring frequently until water evaporates.
Add sliced onions and sauté until browned.
Add ginger, green chilies, turmeric, coriander powder, and chili powder.
Stir in chopped tomatoes and cook until they turn soft.
Add garam masala, salt, and a splash of water to create a gravy.
Simmer on low heat for 10 minutes until meat is tender and oil floats.
Garnish with coriander, mint, and lemon wedges before serving.

title: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, turmeric, chili powder, and ginger-garlic paste for 2 hours.
Cook marinated chicken in a pan with oil until browned, then remove.
Sauté onions in butter until golden brown.
Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates.
Stir in cashew paste and simmer for 5 minutes.
Return chicken to the pan, add cream, garam masala, and kasuri methi.
Simmer on low heat for 15 minutes until gravy thickens.

title: Biryani (Hyderabadi Style)
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, soaked for 30 minutes
1 tsp saffron strands soaked in warm milk
instructions: Cook rice in salted water until 70% done, then drain.
Brown meat in ghee with whole spices, yogurt, and half the biryani masala.
Layer rice and meat in a heavy-bottomed pot.
Sprinkle fried onions, herbs, and saffron milk over the layers.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat (dum) for 20 minutes.
Fluff gently with a fork before serving.

title: Lentil Soup (Dal Tadka)
ingredients: 1 cup yellow split lentils (moong dal), rinsed
instructions: Cook lentils with water and turmeric until soft and mushy.
Sauté onions in ghee until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, and spices; cook until oil separates.
Mix the spiced onion mixture into the lentils.
Temper remaining ghee with cumin seeds and asafoetida.
Pour tempered oil over the soup and garnish with cilantro.

title: Crispy Samosas
instructions: Mix flour, salt, and oil to form a stiff dough; set aside.
Sauté onion, peas, and spices in oil; mix with mashed potatoes.
Roll dough into thin circles and cut in half to make cones.
Fill cones with potato mixture and pinch edges to seal.
Deep fry in hot oil until golden brown and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with chutney.

title: Coconut Rice (Thalipeeth style)
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, soaked for 30 minutes
instructions: Cook rice with water and turmeric until fluffy.
Mix grated coconut, peanuts, urad dal, and sesame seeds.
Sauté coconut mixture in ghee with cumin seeds and asafoetida until fragrant.
Fold the cooked rice into the spiced coconut mixture.
Stir in coriander leaves and salt.
Serve warm as a side dish.

title: Chicken Biryani
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice, soaked and drained
1 kg chicken pieces, marinated with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, red chili powder, and salt
1 tsp saffron strands, soaked in 2 tbsp warm milk
3 tbsp biryani masala or garam masala
instructions: Fry chicken pieces in half the ghee with whole spices until golden brown; remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté sliced onions until golden, then add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add marinated chicken, remaining ghee, biryani masala, and fried onions; cook on high heat for 5 minutes.
Layer the soaked rice over the chicken mixture, pressing gently to create an even layer.
Drizzle the saffron milk, remaining milk, slit green chilies, and coriander-mint mix over the rice.
Cover the pot tightly with aluminum foil, then a lid, and cook on very low heat for 20-25 minutes.

title: Aloo Gobi
ingredients: 500 g potatoes, cut into small cubes
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pot and temper with cumin seeds.
Add chopped onions, green chilies, ginger, and garlic; sauté until onions turn golden.
Add turmeric, coriander powder, and salt; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add cauliflower florets and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until the edges start to brown.
Add potato cubes, toss to coat with spices, and add 1/2 cup water.
Cover and cook on medium heat for 15-20 minutes until potatoes and cauliflower are tender.
Sprinkle garam masala, fresh coriander, and cilantro; stir well and serve hot.

title: Lamb Rogan Josh
ingredients: 1 kg lamb shoulder, cut into 2-inch cubes
instructions: Heat oil in a pot and fry the lamb pieces until they are lightly browned; remove and set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onions, ginger, garlic, and whole spices until onions are soft and golden.
Add yogurt and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly to prevent curdling.
Stir in tomato puree, turmeric, Kashmiri red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt; cook until oil separates.
Return the fried lamb to the pot, add 1/2 cup water, cover, and simmer on low heat for 1.5 hours until meat is tender.
Stir in fresh cilantro and mint leaves just before serving.

title: Dal Tadka
ingredients: 1 cup yellow split lentils (moong dal), rinsed
instructions: Wash the lentils and cook them in 2 cups of water with a pinch of salt until soft and mushy; keep aside.
Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds, mustard seeds, and asafoetida; let them splutter.
Add sliced onions and green chilies; sauté until golden brown.
Add chopped tomatoes, grated ginger, turmeric, red chili powder, and coriander powder; cook until tomatoes are soft.
Pour in the cooked dal, stir well, and add water if needed to adjust consistency.
Simmer for 5 minutes, then sprinkle garam masala and fresh cilantro; serve with rice.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 kg chicken thighs, boneless and skinless, cut into pieces
instructions: Mix yogurt, lemon juice, oil, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, cumin, coriander, paprika, garam masala, cayenne, and salt; marinate chicken for at least 2 hours.
Preheat oven broiler or grill; cook chicken pieces until charred and cooked through; set aside.
In a large pan, melt butter and sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until fragrant and translucent.
Add crushed tomatoes, sugar, and salt; simmer for 10 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Stir in heavy cream and cook for another 2 minutes until smooth.
Add the cooked chicken pieces to the sauce, toss to coat, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with naan or rice.

title: Aloo Gobi
instructions: Heat ghee in a pan and add cumin seeds and asafoetida until they sizzle.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add garlic, ginger, and cook for another minute.
Stir in turmeric, coriander powder, and red chili powder.
Add cauliflower and potatoes, mix well to coat with spices.
Add 1 cup water, cover, and simmer on low heat for 20 minutes until vegetables are tender.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Biryani
ingredients: 1/2 tsp saffron strands soaked in 2 tbsp warm water
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, spices, garlic, ginger, mint, coriander, and half the sliced onions for 2 hours.
Wash rice until water runs clear, then soak for 30 minutes.
Boil the remaining onions with whole spices, bay leaves, and cardamom until soft.
Fry the marinated chicken in ghee until golden brown and set aside.
Cook the soaked rice in salted water with ghee until 70% done.
Layer the fried chicken at the bottom of a heavy-bottomed pot.
Add the partially cooked rice over the chicken.
Pour the saffron-infused water over the rice and sprinkle with remaining onions.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat for 15 minutes (dum cooking).

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds.
Add onions and cook until translucent, then add garlic and ginger.
Add tomato puree and cook until oil separates.
Stir in coriander powder, turmeric, and red chili powder.
Add chicken pieces and cook until lightly browned.
Pour in yogurt and stir well to avoid curdling.
Add water and salt, bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes until chicken is tender.
Sprinkle garam masala and garnish with coriander and mint before serving.

title: Lamb Rogan Josh
instructions: Marinate lamb with yogurt, spices, garlic, ginger, and half the mint for 2 hours.
Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds and asafoetida.
Add onions and cook until golden brown.
Add garlic, ginger, and cook for another minute.
Stir in coriander powder, turmeric, and Kashmiri chili powder.
Add marinated lamb and cook until browned.
Pour in water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 1.5 hours until lamb is tender.
Add remaining mint and coriander, garnish with mint and coriander before serving.

title: Fish Curry
instructions: Marinate fish with yogurt, spices, garlic, ginger, and half the herbs for 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a pan and add cumin seeds.
Add onions and cook until translucent, then add garlic and ginger.
Stir in coriander powder, turmeric, and red chili powder.
Add fish pieces and cook until lightly browned.
Pour in water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 10-15 minutes until fish is cooked through.
Add remaining herbs and garnish with coriander and mint before serving.

title: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
ingredients: 1 kg boneless chicken pieces, cut into bite-sized chunks
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, and red chili powder for at least 1 hour.
Heat 2 tablespoons of butter in a heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat.
Cook the marinated chicken until browned and cooked through, about 10-12 minutes.
Remove chicken and set aside.
In the same pan, melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter and add tomato puree.
Simmer the tomato mixture for 5 minutes until it thickens slightly.
Add chicken broth, fresh cream, and the cooked chicken back into the pan.
Stir in kasuri methi and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes until the gravy is creamy and the chicken is tender.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve hot with naan or rice.

title: Lamb Biryani
ingredients: 1 kg lamb shoulder, cut into 2-inch cubes
3 cups basmati rice, soaked for 30 minutes
1/2 tsp saffron strands soaked in 2 tbsp warm milk
1 cup fresh mint and coriander leaves, chopped
instructions: Pressure cook the lamb with onions, garlic, ginger, cumin, bay leaf, green chilies, yogurt, turmeric, salt, and water until tender (about 2-3 whistles).
Drain the soaked rice and boil it in water with a pinch of salt until 70% cooked.
Heat ghee in a large pot and sauté the sliced onions until golden brown.
Layer the cooked lamb mixture at the bottom of the pot.
Spread the partially cooked rice evenly over the meat.
Sprinkle the chopped mint and coriander leaves over the rice.
Drizzle the saffron-infused milk and a little ghee over the top.
Cover the pot tightly with a lid and seal the edges with dough if possible.
Cook on low heat for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld (dum cooking).
Open the pot, gently mix the layers, and serve hot with raita.

title: Hoppers (Appa)
ingredients: Water as needed for batter consistency
instructions: Mix rice flour, all-purpose flour, besan, salt, sugar, mustard seeds, green chili, and curry leaves in a bowl.
Gradually add water while whisking to create a thin, runny batter similar to pancake batter.
Heat a non-stick griddle or specific hopper pan over medium heat and grease lightly with oil.
Pour a ladleful of batter into the center of the pan, tilting it to form a bowl shape.
Cook until the edges set and the bottom is lightly golden brown.
Flip the hopper carefully using a spatula or by tilting the pan.
Cook the other side until golden brown spots appear.
Remove and serve hot with spicy coconut sambol or curry.

title: Momo (Nepali Dumplings)
ingredients: 250 g all-purpose flour, plus extra for dusting
1 cup spinach or cabbage, finely chopped
instructions: Mix flour and water to form a smooth dough; knead and let rest for 30 minutes.
Combine chicken mince, ginger-garlic paste, soy sauce, pepper, chili powder, salt, chopped greens, and sesame oil in a bowl.
Divide the dough into small balls and roll each into a thin circular wrapper.
Place a spoonful of filling in the center of each wrapper.
Fold the wrapper over the filling and pinch the edges to seal tightly.
Heat oil in a deep pan for frying or steam the momos in a steamer for 10-12 minutes.
If frying, cook momos on medium heat until golden brown and crispy on all sides.
Serve immediately with chili vinegar sauce, pickled ginger, and fresh cilantro.

title: Kottu Roti
ingredients: 4 large flatbreads (rotis), cut into small pieces
200 g chicken or beef, thinly sliced
instructions: Heat a large flat griddle (tawa) or wok over high heat and add oil.
Add cumin seeds and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
Add the sliced meat and stir-fry until cooked through.
Add curry powder, turmeric, salt, and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Add the shredded cabbage, carrots, spring onions, and green chilies.
Toss quickly to mix and cook the vegetables until tender-crisp, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cut rotis to the pan and break them up slightly with the spatula.
Chop the vegetables and meat together with the rotis vigorously using the spatula to create a textured mix.
Stir in the fresh coriander leaves and toss everything together for the last minute.
Serve hot with lemon wedges and pickled vegetables.

title: Ghavi Pulao
ingredients: 1 kg lamb shoulder, cut into large chunks
1 kg chicken, cut into large pieces
1 cup green peas, fresh or frozen
instructions: Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pot and fry the meat chunks until golden brown.
Add onions, garlic, ginger, bay leaves, and fenugreek seeds; sauté until onions turn soft.
Stir in tomato puree, yogurt, turmeric, and red chili powder; cook until oil separates.
Add the soaked rice, carrots, and peas to the pot.
Pour in the water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low.
Cover the pot tightly and cook on very low heat for 25-30 minutes until rice is tender.
Serve hot with fresh coriander and mint leaves.

title: Nihari
ingredients: 1 kg beef shank or brisket, cut into 2-inch pieces
1 kg lamb neck, cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: In a large pot, heat ghee and fry the meat pieces until well browned on all sides.
Add chopped onions, garlic, and ginger; cook until onions are soft and golden.
Stir in yogurt and tomato puree, ensuring no lumps form.
Add garam masala, turmeric, red chili powder, bay leaves, and cinnamon stick.
Pour in water, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to the lowest setting.
Cover the pot and simmer for at least 4 hours, adding water if necessary, until meat is falling apart.
Season with salt, remove whole spices, and serve with naan or roti.

title: Mandi Chicken
ingredients: 1 whole chicken (approx. 1.5 kg), cut into serving pieces
2 tbsp red food coloring (optional, for traditional look)
Fresh cilantro and lemon wedges for garnish
instructions: Marinate the chicken pieces with turmeric, red chili powder, and half of the crushed coriander seeds for at least 2 hours.
Heat oil in a heavy pot and add cumin seeds and bay leaves.
Add onions, garlic, and ginger; sauté until onions are translucent.
Add the marinated chicken and fry until the exterior is browned.
Stir in tomato puree, red food coloring, remaining coriander seeds, and salt; cook until oil separates.
Add water, cover the pot tightly, and cook on low heat for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with naan or rice.

title: Karahi Chicken
ingredients: 500g chicken thighs, bone-in, cut into bite-sized pieces
instructions: Heat oil in a large karahi or deep skillet and add bay leaves and cumin seeds.
Add chicken pieces and fry until they turn golden brown on all sides.
Add sliced onions, garlic, and ginger; cook until onions become soft and slightly brown.
Stir in yogurt and tomato puree, ensuring the mixture is smooth and no lumps remain.
Add red chili powder, turmeric, garam masala, salt, and green chilies.
Cover and cook on medium-low heat for 15-20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and oil floats.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with naan or phulka.

title: Shami Kebabs
ingredients: 2 tbsp fresh coriander leaves, finely chopped
2 tbsp fresh mint leaves, finely chopped
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the minced meat, chickpeas, onions, garlic, ginger, yogurt, tomato puree, and all spices.
Add chopped coriander and mint leaves; mix thoroughly until a firm dough forms.
Shape the mixture into oval patties using your hands, ensuring they are flat and even.
Heat oil in a deep pan or kadhai over medium heat.
Fry the kebabs in batches, turning occasionally, until they are golden brown and cooked through on both sides.
Drain on paper towels to remove excess oil.
Serve hot with mint chutney and naan.

title: Shorshe Ilish (Hilsa Fish in Mustard)
ingredients: 1 whole Hilsa fish, cleaned and scaled
instructions: Clean the Hilsa fish thoroughly and make two deep cuts on each side.
Dry fry the mustard seeds until they start to pop, then remove half.
Heat oil in a pan, add the reserved mustard seeds, green chilies, onions, and tomatoes.
Cook until the onions turn golden brown and oil separates.
Add the fresh mustard paste and salt, stir for a minute.
Place the fish gently into the gravy and cover the pan.
Cook on low heat for 15-20 minutes until the fish is tender.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with steamed rice.

title: Dal Puli (Spiced Lentil Curry)
ingredients: 1 cup red lentils, washed and soaked
instructions: Soak the lentils for 30 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a pot, add cumin seeds and let them sizzle.
Add chopped onions and cook until soft and golden.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, and chili powder.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they become mushy.
Pour in the soaked lentils and add water.
Bring to a boil, then lower heat and simmer until lentils are soft and mushy.
Adjust salt and consistency with water if needed.
Garnish with coriander leaves and serve with roti or rice.

title: Bhorta (Mashed Eggplant)
instructions: Grill or roast the eggplant halves until the skin is charred and flesh is soft.
Let the eggplant cool slightly, then peel off the skin.
Mash the soft flesh inside the shells until smooth.
Heat mustard oil in a small pan, add mustard seeds.
When seeds pop, add chopped garlic and green chili, fry for 30 seconds.
Stir the fried spices into the mashed eggplant.
Add salt and mix well.
Serve immediately as a side dish with rice or fish.

title: Chingri Malai Curry (Shrimp in Cream Sauce)
ingredients: 1 pound medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add diced onions and cook until translucent.
Stir in ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, and garam masala.
Add tomato puree and cook until the oil separates.
Pour in the heavy cream and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add shrimp to the sauce and cook for 3-4 minutes until they turn pink.
Season with salt to taste.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot.

title: Pitha (Banana Pancakes)
instructions: In a bowl, mix mashed bananas, sugar, and cardamom powder.
Add flour, baking powder, and salt to the banana mixture.
Gradually add milk and ghee/oil to form a thick, pourable batter.
Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
Pour a ladleful of batter onto the hot surface.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface, then flip.
Cook the other side until golden brown.
Serve warm with sugar syrup or honey.

title: Kottu Roti
ingredients: 2 cups flat rice, fried crispy and chopped
1 cup mixed vegetables, chopped (carrots, beans, corn)
instructions: Heat oil in a wok over high heat and add cumin seeds and curry leaves.
Add onions and sauté until golden brown.
Add mixed vegetables and cook for 2 minutes.
Push vegetables to the side, pour beaten eggs into the center, and scramble quickly.
Add chopped crispy rice and grated coconut, tossing everything together vigorously.
Season with salt and serve immediately with chutney.

title: Hoppers (Appa)
instructions: Mix rice flour, methi, salt, and warm water to form a smooth batter without lumps.
Let the batter rest for 30 minutes.
Heat a round non-stick pan over medium heat and grease with butter.
Pour a ladle of batter into the center of the pan.
Using a fork or chopsticks, continuously whisk the batter from the center outward to create a bowl shape.
Cook until the edges lift and the center is set, then flip and cook the other side.
Serve hot with egg or fish curry.

title: Pol Sambol
instructions: Grate the ripe mango and fresh coconut into a small bowl.
Add the slit green chilies to the mixture.
Squeeze lime juice over the ingredients.
Add salt and a pinch of jaggery powder if desired.
Mix thoroughly until the flavors are well combined.
Serve as a side dish with rice and curry.

title: String Hoppers (String Appa)
instructions: Combine rice flour, salt, and oil in a bowl.
Gradually add warm water while kneading to form a soft, smooth dough.
Let the dough rest for 20 minutes.
Grease a round non-stick pan with butter and place a small ball of dough in the center.
Flatten the dough gently with your fingers to spread it into a thin, round layer.
Cook over medium heat until the bottom is golden and the top is dry.
Flip carefully and cook the other side until golden brown.
Stack the cooked hoppers and serve with egg or fish curry.

title: Rice and Beans (Thalappilla Sam)
ingredients: 2 cups red kidney beans, soaked overnight
instructions: Drain the soaked beans and boil them in salted water until half-cooked.
In a large pot, heat coconut oil and sauté onions until translucent.
Add ginger, green chilies, and curry leaves, cooking for 1 minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add the half-cooked beans and turmeric powder, stirring well.
Add the rinsed rice and mix gently to coat with the spice mixture.
Add enough water to cover the rice by one inch and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until the rice and beans are fully cooked and water is absorbed.

title: Sarson da Saag with Makki di Roti
instructions: Boil chopped mustard greens in water until soft, then blend into a coarse paste.
Heat ghee in a pan, add the paste and salt, cook stirring frequently until oil separates.
Sprinkle amchur and mix well.
Mix corn flour with water to form a soft dough.
Roll small portions of dough into thick round rotis.
Cook rotis on a hot tawa until golden brown spots appear.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, turmeric, and red chili powder for 2 hours.
Roast marinated chicken on a hot grill or tawa until cooked through and charred.
In a pan, melt butter and sauté tomato puree until oil separates.
Add heavy cream and simmer gently.
Add roasted chicken pieces and cook for 5 minutes to infuse flavors.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves before serving.

title: Dal Makhani
instructions: Soak black lentils, red lentils, and kidney beans separately for at least 8 hours.
Pressure cook all legumes with salt and a bay leaf until very soft.
In a heavy-bottomed pot, heat butter and sauté onions until golden brown.
Add cumin seeds, green chilies, and the cooked legumes to the pot.
Simmer on low heat with a lid for 2 hours, adding a little water if needed.
Stir in cream and garam masala, cook uncovered for 10 minutes until creamy.

title: Aloo Gobi
instructions: Heat oil in a pan and sauté onions until translucent.
Add garlic, ginger, turmeric, and red chili powder, cook for 1 minute.
Add cauliflower florets and cook covered for 5 minutes.
Add potato cubes and salt, cover and cook for 15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
